                raise ValueError("unknown source generation")
            repository_id = row["repository_id"]
            if status == "completed":

                    """

                    WHERE repository_id=%s AND generation_id<>%s AND status='completed'

                    """

                    ORDER BY completed_at DESC NULLS LAST OFFSET %s

"""Small async Perma API client for the Xavi archive gateway.

This module is intentionally thin: Xavi owns auth and policy, Perma owns capture.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from typing import Any

import httpx


class PermaConfigError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when required Perma configuration is missing."""


def _clean_base_url(value: str) -> str:
    value = (value or "").strip().rstrip("/")
    if not value:
        raise PermaConfigError("PERMA_API_BASE is not configured")
    return value


class PermaClient:
    def __init__(self, api_base: str | None = None, api_key: str | None = None, timeout: float = 45.0) -> None:
        self.api_base = _clean_base_url(api_base or os.environ.get("PERMA_API_BASE", "https://api.perma.cc/v1"))
        self.api_key = (api_key or os.environ.get("PERMA_API_KEY", "")).strip()
        self.timeout = timeout
        if not self.api_key:
            raise PermaConfigError("PERMA_API_KEY is not configured")

    def _headers(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return {
            "Authorization": f"ApiKey {self.api_key}",
            "Accept": "application/json",
        }

    def _url(self, path: str) -> str:
        path = path.strip()
        if not path.startswith("/"):
            path = "/" + path
        return self.api_base + path

    async def request_json(self, method: str, path: str, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        headers = self._headers()
        extra_headers = kwargs.pop("headers", None) or {}
        headers.update(extra_headers)
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=self.timeout, follow_redirects=True) as client:
            resp = await client.request(method, self._url(path), headers=headers, **kwargs)
        if resp.status_code >= 400:
            raise httpx.HTTPStatusError(
                f"Perma API error {resp.status_code}: {resp.text[:500]}",
                request=resp.request,
                response=resp,
            )
        if not resp.content:
            return {}
        return resp.json()

    async def create_archive(self, url: str, title: str | None = None, folder: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {"url": url}
        if title:
            payload["title"] = title
        if folder is not None:
            payload["folder"] = folder
        return await self.request_json("POST", "/archives/", json=payload, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})

    async def get_archive(self, guid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return await self.request_json("GET", f"/archives/{guid}/")

    async def get_capture_job(self, guid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return await self.request_json("GET", f"/capture_jobs/{guid}/")
EOF

"""Draft FastAPI router for Xavi-owned Perma archive endpoints.

Mount target, after code review/tests:
    /xavi/archive

Browser-facing path through nginx:
    /xavi-api/xavi/archive/*
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import httpx
from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, HttpUrl

from api.auth import require_admin

from .perma_client import PermaClient, PermaConfigError

router = APIRouter(prefix="/xavi/archive", tags=["xavi-archive"])


class CaptureRequest(BaseModel):
    url: HttpUrl
    title: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=512)
    folder: int | None = None
    index_after_capture: bool = False


def _client() -> PermaClient:
    try:
        return PermaClient()
    except PermaConfigError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail=str(exc)) from exc


def _perma_error(exc: Exception) -> HTTPException:
    if isinstance(exc, httpx.HTTPStatusError):
        status = exc.response.status_code
        detail = exc.response.text[:1000]
        return HTTPException(status_code=502, detail={"perma_status": status, "perma_detail": detail})
    return HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=str(exc))


@router.get("/health")
async def health(request: Request) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require_admin(request)
    try:
        c = _client()
        return {"ok": True, "service": "xavi-archive", "perma_api_base": c.api_base, "api_key_configured": bool(c.api_key)}
    except HTTPException:
        raise


@router.post("/captures")
async def create_capture(request: Request, body: CaptureRequest) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require_admin(request)
    try:
        archive = await _client().create_archive(str(body.url), title=body.title, folder=body.folder)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise _perma_error(exc) from exc
    guid = archive.get("guid")
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "archive": archive,
        "guid": guid,
        "index_after_capture": body.index_after_capture,
        "next": {
            "status": f"/xavi-api/xavi/archive/captures/{guid}" if guid else None,
            "index": f"/xavi-api/xavi/archive/captures/{guid}/index" if guid else None,
        },
    }


@router.get("/captures/{guid}")
async def capture_status(request: Request, guid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require_admin(request)
    c = _client()
    archive: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    job: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    errors: list[str] = []
    try:
        archive = await c.get_archive(guid)
    except Exception as exc:
        errors.append(f"archive: {exc}")
    try:
        job = await c.get_capture_job(guid)
    except Exception as exc:
        errors.append(f"capture_job: {exc}")
    if archive is None and job is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail={"errors": errors})
    return {"ok": True, "guid": guid, "archive": archive, "capture_job": job, "errors": errors}


@router.post("/captures/{guid}/index")
async def index_capture(request: Request, guid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require_admin(request)
    # Placeholder for the next patch: download WACZ/WARC, extract text/metadata,
    # persist an archive record, and enqueue Xavi sear-data / chronicle / WG-RNN witnesses.
    return {
        "ok": False,
        "guid": guid,
        "status": "not_implemented_yet",
        "planned_steps": [
            "download WACZ/WARC from Perma",
            "extract canonical text, screenshot metadata, headers, and source URL",
            "write archive object into Xavi chronicle/sear-data",
            "emit WG-RNN external_action witness for capture and indexing",
        ],
    }


@router.get("/captures/{guid}/download-url")
async def download_url(request: Request, guid: str, file_format: str = Query(default="wacz", pattern="^(warc|wacz)$")) -> dict[str, Any]:
    require_admin(request)
    archive = await _client().get_archive(guid)
    key = "wacz_download_url" if file_format == "wacz" else "warc_download_url"
    return {"ok": True, "guid": guid, "file_format": file_format, "download_url": archive.get(key), "archive": archive}
EOF

# Implementation Plan

## Phase 0 - scaffold
- Create `/var/www/xavi/perma` integration root.
- Draft Xavi FastAPI gateway code.
- Keep secrets out of files.
- Do not expose Perma directly.

## Phase 1 - Xavi API wrapper
- Move/review `gateway/router.py` into the active Xavi FastAPI tree or package it on the Python path.
- Mount router at `/xavi/archive`.
- Require ConcreteCMS/Xavi-authenticated admin access via `require_admin`.
- Add tests for configured/unconfigured Perma, create capture, status, and error mapping.

## Phase 2 - self-host Perma privately
- Clone Perma source into `perma-src`.
- Review Perma compose services and remap ports away from active Xavi ports.
- Run Perma/Scoop on container-only or 127.0.0.1-only networking.
- Create a service account/API key inside Perma and inject it with `PERMA_API_KEY`.

## Phase 3 - archive indexing
- Download WACZ/WARC artifacts from Perma.
- Extract canonical page text, screenshot metadata, HTTP metadata, and source URL.
- Store archive metadata in PostgreSQL when available; keep local files under `archives/`.
- Push extracted text to Xavi sear-data and chronicle surfaces.
- Emit WG-RNN witnesses for capture, indexing, and model-consumption steps.

## Phase 4 - AUI/manager UI
- Add an archive panel: capture URL, show job status, index artifact, and search archived corpus.
- Browser calls only `/xavi-api/xavi/archive/*`.
- Never expose `PERMA_API_KEY` to browser JS.

- index endpoint returns explicit not-implemented until extractor lands

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import re
import time
import uuid
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from typing import Any

_SESSION_RE = re.compile(r"^mcp_[0-9a-f]{32}\.[0-9a-f]{24}$")
_SAFE_ID_RE = re.compile(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.:@+-]+")


def _digest(value: Any) -> str:
    raw = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), default=str).encode("utf-8")
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def _slug(value: str, fallback: str) -> str:
    out = _SAFE_ID_RE.sub("-", str(value or "").strip()).strip("-")
    return (out or fallback)[:96]


def _sig(raw: str, secret: str) -> str:
    return hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), raw.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()[:24]


def issue_session_id(secret: str) -> str:
    raw = uuid.uuid4().hex
    return f"mcp_{raw}.{_sig(raw, secret)}"


def valid_session_id(value: str | None, secret: str) -> bool:
    if not value or not _SESSION_RE.fullmatch(value):
        return False
    raw, supplied = value[4:].split(".", 1)
    return hmac.compare_digest(supplied, _sig(raw, secret))


def issue_connection_id() -> str:
    return "conn_" + uuid.uuid4().hex


def stable_agent_id(*, client_name: str, device_id: str = "", account_scope: str = "", explicit_agent_id: str = "") -> str:
    if explicit_agent_id:
        return "agent:" + _slug(explicit_agent_id, "mcp-client")
    label = _slug(client_name, "mcp-client")
    fingerprint = hashlib.sha256(f"{label}\n{device_id}\n{account_scope}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:20]
    return f"agent:{label}:{fingerprint}"


def issue_work_id() -> str:
    return "work_" + uuid.uuid4().hex


def issue_delegation_id() -> str:
    return "dlg_" + uuid.uuid4().hex


def issue_lease_id() -> str:
    return "lease_" + uuid.uuid4().hex


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ChatIdentity:
    agent_id: str
    session_id: str
    connection_id: str
    client_name: str
    device_id_digest: str
    account_scope_digest: str
    created_at_ms: int
    resumed: bool = False
    parent_session_id: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def public_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Delegation:
    delegation_id: str
    work_id: str
    delegator_session_id: str
    delegate_session_id: str | None
    objective: str
    parent_work_id: str | None = None
    required_capabilities: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    resource_hints: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at_ms: int = 0
    status: str = "queued"

    def public_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResourceLease:
    lease_id: str
    work_id: str
    session_id: str
    resource_type: str
    resource_id: str
    quantity: float
    unit: str
    expires_at_ms: int
    exclusive: bool = False
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def public_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def new_chat_identity(*, secret: str, client_name: str, device_id: str = "", account_scope: str = "", explicit_agent_id: str = "", candidate_session_id: str | None = None, parent_session_id: str | None = None, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> ChatIdentity:
    resumed = valid_session_id(candidate_session_id, secret)
    session_id = str(candidate_session_id) if resumed else issue_session_id(secret)
    return ChatIdentity(
        agent_id=stable_agent_id(client_name=client_name, device_id=device_id, account_scope=account_scope, explicit_agent_id=explicit_agent_id),
        session_id=session_id,
        connection_id=issue_connection_id(),
        client_name=_slug(client_name, "mcp-client"),
        device_id_digest=_digest(device_id or "unknown-device"),
        account_scope_digest=_digest(account_scope or "unknown-account"),
        created_at_ms=int(time.time() * 1000),
        resumed=resumed,
        parent_session_id=parent_session_id,
        metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
    )


def new_delegation(*, delegator_session_id: str, objective: str, delegate_session_id: str | None = None, work_id: str | None = None, parent_work_id: str | None = None, required_capabilities: list[str] | tuple[str, ...] | None = None, resource_hints: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Delegation:
    objective = str(objective or "").strip()
    if not objective:
        raise ValueError("objective is required")
    return Delegation(
        delegation_id=issue_delegation_id(),
        work_id=work_id or issue_work_id(),
        delegator_session_id=delegator_session_id,
        delegate_session_id=delegate_session_id,
        objective=objective,
        parent_work_id=parent_work_id,
        required_capabilities=tuple(sorted(set(required_capabilities or []))),
        resource_hints=dict(resource_hints or {}),
        created_at_ms=int(time.time() * 1000),
    )


def new_resource_lease(*, work_id: str, session_id: str, resource_type: str, resource_id: str, quantity: float, unit: str, ttl_seconds: int, exclusive: bool = False, metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> ResourceLease:
    resource_type = _slug(resource_type, "resource")
    resource_id = _slug(resource_id, "default")
    quantity = float(quantity)
    ttl_seconds = int(ttl_seconds)
    if quantity <= 0:
        raise ValueError("quantity must be > 0")
    if ttl_seconds <= 0:
        raise ValueError("ttl_seconds must be > 0")
    return ResourceLease(
        lease_id=issue_lease_id(), work_id=work_id, session_id=session_id,
        resource_type=resource_type, resource_id=resource_id, quantity=quantity,
        unit=_slug(unit, "unit"), expires_at_ms=int(time.time() * 1000) + ttl_seconds * 1000,
        exclusive=bool(exclusive), metadata=dict(metadata or {}),
    )


def identity_trace(identity: ChatIdentity, *, work_id: str | None = None, delegation_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body = {"agent_id": identity.agent_id, "session_id": identity.session_id, "connection_id": identity.connection_id, "work_id": work_id, "delegation_id": delegation_id}
    return body | {"trace_digest": _digest(body)}
PY

    def setUp(self): self.secret = "test-secret-not-production"

    def test_distinct_chats_get_distinct_sessions_and_connections(self):
        a = new_chat_identity(secret=self.secret, client_name="ChatGPT", device_id="desktop-A")
        b = new_chat_identity(secret=self.secret, client_name="ChatGPT", device_id="desktop-A")
        self.assertEqual(a.agent_id, b.agent_id)
        self.assertNotEqual(a.session_id, b.session_id)
        self.assertNotEqual(a.connection_id, b.connection_id)
        self.assertTrue(valid_session_id(a.session_id, self.secret))

    def test_reconnect_resumes_session_but_rotates_connection(self):
        first = new_chat_identity(secret=self.secret, client_name="ChatGPT", device_id="desktop-A")
        second = new_chat_identity(secret=self.secret, client_name="ChatGPT", device_id="desktop-A", candidate_session_id=first.session_id)
        self.assertTrue(second.resumed)
        self.assertEqual(first.session_id, second.session_id)
        self.assertEqual(first.agent_id, second.agent_id)
        self.assertNotEqual(first.connection_id, second.connection_id)

    def test_delegation_records_lineage_and_capabilities(self):
        parent = new_chat_identity(secret=self.secret, client_name="ChatGPT", device_id="desktop-A")
        child = new_chat_identity(secret=self.secret, client_name="ChatGPT", device_id="desktop-A")
        d = new_delegation(delegator_session_id=parent.session_id, delegate_session_id=child.session_id, objective="Implement a non-overlapping test lane", parent_work_id="work_parent", required_capabilities=["python", "tests", "python"], resource_hints={"cpu_threads": 4, "memory_mb": 2048})
        self.assertEqual(d.required_capabilities, ("python", "tests"))
        self.assertTrue(d.work_id.startswith("work_"))
        self.assertTrue(d.delegation_id.startswith("dlg_"))

    def test_resource_lease_describes_gpu_allocation(self):
        ident = new_chat_identity(secret=self.secret, client_name="ChatGPT")
        d = new_delegation(delegator_session_id=ident.session_id, objective="GPU validation")
        gpu = new_resource_lease(work_id=d.work_id, session_id=ident.session_id, resource_type="gpu", resource_id="rtx2070", quantity=1, unit="device", ttl_seconds=60, exclusive=True)
        self.assertEqual(gpu.resource_type, "gpu")
        self.assertTrue(gpu.exclusive)

    def test_trace_binds_chat_work_and_delegation(self):
        ident = new_chat_identity(secret=self.secret, client_name="ChatGPT")
        d = new_delegation(delegator_session_id=ident.session_id, objective="Trace me")
        trace = identity_trace(ident, work_id=d.work_id, delegation_id=d.delegation_id)
        self.assertEqual(trace["session_id"], ident.session_id)
        self.assertTrue(trace["trace_digest"].startswith("sha256:"))

import json, os, re, urllib.request, zipfile
REPORT='/var/www/xavi/updates/richard_harrison_ia_scan.json'
ZIP='/var/www/xavi/updates/richard_harrison_vetted_archive_torrents.zip'
INV='/var/www/xavi/updates/richard_harrison_torrent_inventory_reviewed.tsv'
VETTED={
'Jeanne Eagels':'jeanne-eagels-1957lagrimas-de-triunfo',
'The Invincible Gladiator':'AteneaFilmsPublicDomainTheInvincibleGladiator',
'Challenge of the Tiger':'challenge-of-the-tiger-1980',
'Ninja Terminator':'NINJATERMINATORDVD',
'Ninja the Protector':'ninja-the-protector-1986',
'Ninja Champion':'NinjaChampion1985',
'Ninja Thunderbolt':'ninja-thunderbolt',
'The Ninja Squad':'TheNinjaSquad',
'Ninja Hunt':'ninja-hunt-1987-cg',
'Golden Ninja Warrior':'GoldenNinjaWarriorDVD',
'Ninja Kill':'NINJAKILL',
'Ninja Powerforce':'NinjaPowerforce',
'Scorpion Thunderbolt':'Scorpion_Thunderbolt_1988',
'Ninja Strike Force':'ninja-strike-force-vhs-rip',
}
EXCLUDED_CLEAR={
'Marco Polo':'wrong same-name item (2008 music video)',
'The Boxer Rebellion':'wrong same-name item (5-minute independent video)',
'Hands of Death':'wrong film (1974 feature, not 1988 Harrison title)',
}
d=json.load(open(REPORT,encoding='utf-8'))
# Resolve metadata and torrent names for vetted IDs.
meta={}
for title,ident in VETTED.items():
    req=urllib.request.Request('https://archive.org/metadata/'+ident,headers={'User-Agent':'Xavi-Harrison-Vetted-Bundle/1.0'})
    j=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30)); m=j.get('metadata') or {}
    tor=[]
    for f in j.get('files') or []:
        n=str(f.get('name','')); fmt=str(f.get('format','')).lower()
        if n.lower().endswith('.torrent') or 'bittorrent' in fmt:
            tor.append(n)
    if not tor:
        raise RuntimeError('no torrent file for '+ident)
    # Prefer archive-generated torrent.
    tor.sort(key=lambda n:(0 if n.endswith('_archive.torrent') else 1,len(n)))
    tname=tor[0]
    turl='https://archive.org/download/'+ident+'/'+urllib.parse.quote(tname)
    meta[title]={'identifier':ident,'ia_title':m.get('title'),'date':m.get('date'),'licenseurl':m.get('licenseurl'),'torrent_name':tname,'torrent_url':turl}

manifest=['title\tyear\tidentifier\tia_title\tarchive_license_metadata\ttorrent_file']
added=[]
with zipfile.ZipFile(ZIP,'w',compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for r in d['results']:
        title=r['title']
        if title not in VETTED: continue
        v=meta[title]
        req=urllib.request.Request(v['torrent_url'],headers={'User-Agent':'Xavi-Harrison-Vetted-Bundle/1.0'})
        data=urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30).read(3*1024*1024)
        if not data or data[:1] not in (b'd',b'l'):
            raise RuntimeError('invalid torrent bytes for '+title)
        safe=re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+','_',f"{r['year']}_{title}_{v['identifier']}.torrent")
        z.writestr(safe,data)
        manifest.append('\t'.join(str(x or '').replace('\t',' ').replace('\n',' ') for x in [title,r['year'],v['identifier'],v['ia_title'],v['licenseurl'],safe]))
        added.append(title)
    z.writestr('manifest.tsv','\n'.join(manifest)+'\n')
    z.writestr('README.txt',
      'This bundle contains only Internet Archive items manually matched to the requested Richard Harrison feature films and carrying explicit Public Domain Mark or Creative Commons metadata on the Archive item.\n'
      'Archive metadata is evidence of how the uploader/item is labeled, not an independent legal determination of copyright status.\n'
      'Items with unclear rights metadata, trailers/clips, wrong-year films, and same-name false positives are excluded.\n')

# Build reviewed inventory: no direct torrent URLs for unclear-rights candidates.
with open(INV,'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write('title\tyear\tstatus\tidentifier\tia_title\trights_note\tdetails_url\n')
    for r in d['results']:
        title=r['title']; cs=r.get('candidates') or []
        if title in VETTED:
            v=meta[title]
            vals=[title,r['year'],'VETTED_ARCHIVE_PD_OR_CC',v['identifier'],v['ia_title'],v['licenseurl'],'https://archive.org/details/'+v['identifier']]
        elif title in EXCLUDED_CLEAR:
            vals=[title,r['year'],'REJECTED_FALSE_MATCH','','',EXCLUDED_CLEAR[title],'']
        elif any(c.get('torrent_available') for c in cs):
            # Pick best candidate, but expose only details page for manual rights review.
            c=max((c for c in cs if c.get('torrent_available')),key=lambda x:x.get('score',0))
            vals=[title,r['year'],'ARCHIVE_CANDIDATE_RIGHTS_UNCLEAR',c.get('identifier'),c.get('ia_title'),'No explicit PD/CC metadata verified; torrent URL intentionally omitted',c.get('details_url')]
        elif cs:
            c=max(cs,key=lambda x:x.get('score',0))
            vals=[title,r['year'],'ARCHIVE_CANDIDATE_NO_TORRENT',c.get('identifier'),c.get('ia_title'),'No verified Archive torrent','']
        else:
            vals=[title,r['year'],'NO_ARCHIVE_MATCH','','','No plausible Internet Archive movie match found','']
        f.write('\t'.join(str(x or '').replace('\t',' ').replace('\n',' ') for x in vals)+'\n')
print('vetted_titles',len(added))
print('titles='+' | '.join(added))
print('zip',ZIP)
print('inventory',INV)
print('zip_size',os.path.getsize(ZIP))
PY

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from psycopg.types.json import Jsonb

from .auth import Authenticated, UserContext, _decode_bearer
from .db import connection

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/chat", tags=["chat"])


class DirectCreate(BaseModel):
    user_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    username: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=190)
    display_name: str = Field(default="", max_length=190)


class GroupCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=190)
    participants: list[DirectCreate] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=100)


class MessageCreate(BaseModel):
    body: str = Field(default="", max_length=8000)
    kind: str = Field(default="text", pattern="^(text|image|file)$")
    reply_to_message_id: int | None = None
    attachment: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class MessageEdit(BaseModel):
    body: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=8000)


class ReactionUpdate(BaseModel):
    emoji: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=32)
    active: bool = True


class SettingsUpdate(BaseModel):
    availability: str | None = Field(default=None, pattern="^(online|away|busy|offline)$")
    allow_direct_messages: bool | None = None
    read_receipts: bool | None = None
    sound_enabled: bool | None = None
    footer_enabled: bool | None = None
    chat_heads_enabled: bool | None = None
    compact_mode: bool | None = None


def _user_from_token(token: str) -> UserContext:
    claims = _decode_bearer(token)
    scope_value = claims.get("scope", "")
    scopes = frozenset(str(x) for x in claims.get("scopes", []) if x)
    if isinstance(scope_value, str):
        scopes |= frozenset(scope_value.split())
    groups = frozenset(str(x) for x in claims.get("groups", []) if x)
    username = str(claims.get("preferred_username") or "").strip()
    if not username:
        raise ValueError("JWT username claim is missing")
    return UserContext(
        user_id=str(claims["sub"]),
        username=username,
        email=str(claims.get("email")) if claims.get("email") else None,
        groups=groups,
        scopes=scopes,
        claims=claims,
    )


def _ensure_settings(cur: Any, user: UserContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cur.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO fusion.chat_user_setting (user_id, username)
        VALUES (%s, %s)
        ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET username = EXCLUDED.username
        RETURNING user_id, username, availability, allow_direct_messages,
                  read_receipts, sound_enabled, footer_enabled,
                  chat_heads_enabled, compact_mode, last_seen_at, updated_at
        """,
        (user.user_id, user.username),
    )
    return cur.fetchone()


def _require_participant(cur: Any, conversation_id: UUID, user: UserContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT p.*, c.kind, c.title, c.created_by_id
        FROM fusion.chat_participant p
        JOIN fusion.chat_conversation c ON c.id = p.conversation_id
        WHERE p.conversation_id = %s AND p.user_id = %s
        """,
        (conversation_id, user.user_id),
    )
    row = cur.fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="conversation membership is required")
    return row


def _member_ids(conversation_id: UUID) -> list[str]:
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("SELECT user_id FROM fusion.chat_participant WHERE conversation_id = %s", (conversation_id,))
        return [str(row["user_id"]) for row in cur.fetchall()]


def _message_payload(cur: Any, message_id: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT m.id, m.conversation_id, m.sender_id, m.sender_username,
               CASE WHEN m.deleted_at IS NULL THEN m.body ELSE '' END AS body,
               m.kind, m.reply_to_message_id,
               CASE WHEN m.deleted_at IS NULL THEN m.attachment ELSE '{}'::jsonb END AS attachment,
               m.created_at, m.edited_at, m.deleted_at,
               COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('emoji', r.emoji, 'user_id', r.user_id) ORDER BY r.created_at)
                         FROM fusion.chat_reaction r WHERE r.message_id = m.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS reactions
        FROM fusion.chat_message m WHERE m.id = %s
        """,
        (message_id,),
    )
    row = cur.fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="message not found")
    return row


def _conversation_payload(cur: Any, conversation_id: UUID, user_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT c.id, c.kind, c.title, c.created_by_id, c.created_by_username,
               c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.last_message_id, p.role,
               p.last_read_message_id, p.muted_until, p.archived
        FROM fusion.chat_conversation c
        JOIN fusion.chat_participant p ON p.conversation_id = c.id AND p.user_id = %s
        WHERE c.id = %s
        """,
        (user_id, conversation_id),
    )
    row = cur.fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="conversation not found")
    cur.execute(
        """SELECT user_id, username, display_name, role, joined_at, last_read_message_id
           FROM fusion.chat_participant WHERE conversation_id = %s ORDER BY joined_at""",
        (conversation_id,),
    )
    row["participants"] = list(cur.fetchall())
    row["last_message"] = _message_payload(cur, int(row["last_message_id"])) if row["last_message_id"] else None
    cur.execute(
        """SELECT count(*) AS count FROM fusion.chat_message
           WHERE conversation_id = %s AND id > %s AND sender_id <> %s AND deleted_at IS NULL""",
        (conversation_id, int(row["last_read_message_id"] or 0), user_id),
    )
    row["unread_count"] = int(cur.fetchone()["count"])
    return row


def _list_conversations(user: UserContext) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            """
            SELECT c.id FROM fusion.chat_conversation c
            JOIN fusion.chat_participant p ON p.conversation_id = c.id
            WHERE p.user_id = %s AND p.archived = false
            ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
            """,
            (user.user_id,),
        )
        return [_conversation_payload(cur, row["id"], user.user_id) for row in cur.fetchall()]


class ChatHub:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.connections: dict[str, set[WebSocket]] = defaultdict(set)
        self.users: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def connect(self, user: UserContext, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:
        await websocket.accept(subprotocol="xavi-chat-v1")
        async with self.lock:
            self.connections[user.user_id].add(websocket)
            self.users[user.user_id] = {"user_id": user.user_id, "username": user.username, "online": True}
        await self.broadcast_all({"type": "presence", "user": self.users[user.user_id]})

    async def disconnect(self, user: UserContext, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:
        async with self.lock:
            sockets = self.connections.get(user.user_id)
            if sockets:
                sockets.discard(websocket)
                if not sockets:
                    self.connections.pop(user.user_id, None)
                    self.users[user.user_id] = {"user_id": user.user_id, "username": user.username, "online": False}
        if user.user_id not in self.connections:
            with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
                cur.execute("UPDATE fusion.chat_user_setting SET last_seen_at = now() WHERE user_id = %s", (user.user_id,))
                conn.commit()
            await self.broadcast_all({"type": "presence", "user": self.users[user.user_id]})

    async def send_users(self, user_ids: list[str], payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        targets: list[WebSocket] = []
        async with self.lock:
            for user_id in set(user_ids):
                targets.extend(self.connections.get(user_id, set()))
        for websocket in targets:
            try:
                await websocket.send_json(payload)
            except Exception:
                pass

    async def broadcast_all(self, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        async with self.lock:
            targets = [ws for sockets in self.connections.values() for ws in sockets]
        for websocket in targets:
            try:
                await websocket.send_json(payload)
            except Exception:
                pass

    async def conversation(self, conversation_id: UUID, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        await self.send_users(_member_ids(conversation_id), payload)


hub = ChatHub()


@router.get("/bootstrap")
def bootstrap(user: Authenticated) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        settings = _ensure_settings(cur, user)
        conn.commit()
    return {
        "user": {"id": user.user_id, "username": user.username, "email": user.email, "is_admin": user.is_admin},
        "settings": settings,
        "conversations": _list_conversations(user),
        "online": list(hub.users.values()),
        "socket": {"url": "/api/v1/chat/ws", "protocol": "xavi-chat-v1"},
    }


@router.get("/conversations")
def conversations(user: Authenticated) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return _list_conversations(user)


@router.post("/direct", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_direct(payload: DirectCreate, user: Authenticated) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if payload.user_id == user.user_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="a direct conversation requires another user")
    direct_key = ":".join(sorted([user.user_id, payload.user_id]))
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("SELECT 1 FROM fusion.chat_block WHERE (blocker_id=%s AND blocked_id=%s) OR (blocker_id=%s AND blocked_id=%s)", (user.user_id, payload.user_id, payload.user_id, user.user_id))
        if cur.fetchone():
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="direct messaging is blocked")
        cur.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO fusion.chat_conversation (kind, direct_key, created_by_id, created_by_username)
            VALUES ('direct', %s, %s, %s)
            ON CONFLICT (direct_key) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = fusion.chat_conversation.updated_at
            RETURNING id
            """,
            (direct_key, user.user_id, user.username),
        )
        conversation_id = cur.fetchone()["id"]
        for uid, username, display, role in [
            (user.user_id, user.username, user.username, "owner"),
            (payload.user_id, payload.username, payload.display_name or payload.username, "member"),
        ]:
            cur.execute(
                """INSERT INTO fusion.chat_participant (conversation_id,user_id,username,display_name,role)
                   VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) ON CONFLICT (conversation_id,user_id) DO UPDATE
                   SET username=EXCLUDED.username, display_name=EXCLUDED.display_name""",
                (conversation_id, uid, username, display, role),
            )
        result = _conversation_payload(cur, conversation_id, user.user_id)
        conn.commit()
    await hub.send_users([user.user_id, payload.user_id], {"type": "conversation.created", "conversation_id": str(conversation_id)})
    return result


@router.post("/groups", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_group(payload: GroupCreate, user: Authenticated) -> dict[str, Any]:
    unique = {p.user_id: p for p in payload.participants if p.user_id != user.user_id}
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            """INSERT INTO fusion.chat_conversation (kind,title,created_by_id,created_by_username)
               VALUES ('group',%s,%s,%s) RETURNING id""",
            (payload.title.strip(), user.user_id, user.username),
        )
        conversation_id = cur.fetchone()["id"]
        members = [(user.user_id, user.username, user.username, "owner")] + [(p.user_id, p.username, p.display_name or p.username, "member") for p in unique.values()]
        for uid, username, display, role in members:
            cur.execute("INSERT INTO fusion.chat_participant (conversation_id,user_id,username,display_name,role) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)", (conversation_id, uid, username, display, role))
        result = _conversation_payload(cur, conversation_id, user.user_id)
        conn.commit()
    await hub.send_users([x[0] for x in members], {"type": "conversation.created", "conversation_id": str(conversation_id)})
    return result


@router.get("/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages")
def messages(conversation_id: UUID, user: Authenticated, before: int | None = None, limit: int = Query(default=60, ge=1, le=200)) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        _require_participant(cur, conversation_id, user)
        params: list[Any] = [conversation_id]
        condition = ""
        if before is not None:
            condition = "AND m.id < %s"
            params.append(before)
        params.append(limit)
        cur.execute(
            f"""SELECT m.id FROM fusion.chat_message m WHERE m.conversation_id=%s {condition}
                ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT %s""",
            tuple(params),
        )
        ids = [int(row["id"]) for row in cur.fetchall()]
        return [_message_payload(cur, mid) for mid in reversed(ids)]


@router.post("/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def send_message(conversation_id: UUID, payload: MessageCreate, user: Authenticated) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body = payload.body.strip()
    if not body and not payload.attachment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="message text or an attachment is required")
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        _require_participant(cur, conversation_id, user)
        if payload.reply_to_message_id:
            cur.execute("SELECT 1 FROM fusion.chat_message WHERE id=%s AND conversation_id=%s", (payload.reply_to_message_id, conversation_id))
            if cur.fetchone() is None:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="reply target is not in this conversation")
        cur.execute(
            """INSERT INTO fusion.chat_message (conversation_id,sender_id,sender_username,body,kind,reply_to_message_id,attachment)
               VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) RETURNING id""",
            (conversation_id, user.user_id, user.username, body, payload.kind, payload.reply_to_message_id, Jsonb(payload.attachment)),
        )
        message_id = int(cur.fetchone()["id"])
        cur.execute("UPDATE fusion.chat_conversation SET last_message_id=%s,updated_at=now() WHERE id=%s", (message_id, conversation_id))
        cur.execute("UPDATE fusion.chat_participant SET last_read_message_id=%s WHERE conversation_id=%s AND user_id=%s", (message_id, conversation_id, user.user_id))
        result = _message_payload(cur, message_id)
        conn.commit()
    await hub.conversation(conversation_id, {"type": "message.created", "conversation_id": str(conversation_id), "message": result})
    return result


@router.patch("/messages/{message_id}")
async def edit_message(message_id: int, payload: MessageEdit, user: Authenticated) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("SELECT conversation_id,sender_id FROM fusion.chat_message WHERE id=%s AND deleted_at IS NULL", (message_id,))
        row = cur.fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="message not found")
        member = _require_participant(cur, row["conversation_id"], user)
        if row["sender_id"] != user.user_id and member["role"] not in {"owner", "admin"} and not user.is_admin:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="message edit is not permitted")
        cur.execute("UPDATE fusion.chat_message SET body=%s,edited_at=now() WHERE id=%s", (payload.body.strip(), message_id))
        result = _message_payload(cur, message_id)
        conn.commit()
    await hub.conversation(row["conversation_id"], {"type": "message.updated", "conversation_id": str(row["conversation_id"]), "message": result})
    return result


@router.delete("/messages/{message_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
async def delete_message(message_id: int, user: Authenticated) -> None:
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("SELECT conversation_id,sender_id FROM fusion.chat_message WHERE id=%s AND deleted_at IS NULL", (message_id,))
        row = cur.fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="message not found")
        member = _require_participant(cur, row["conversation_id"], user)
        if row["sender_id"] != user.user_id and member["role"] not in {"owner", "admin"} and not user.is_admin:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="message deletion is not permitted")
        cur.execute("UPDATE fusion.chat_message SET body='',attachment='{}'::jsonb,deleted_at=now() WHERE id=%s", (message_id,))
        conn.commit()
    await hub.conversation(row["conversation_id"], {"type": "message.deleted", "conversation_id": str(row["conversation_id"]), "message_id": message_id})


@router.post("/messages/{message_id}/reaction")
async def reaction(message_id: int, payload: ReactionUpdate, user: Authenticated) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("SELECT conversation_id FROM fusion.chat_message WHERE id=%s", (message_id,))
        row = cur.fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="message not found")
        _require_participant(cur, row["conversation_id"], user)
        if payload.active:
            cur.execute("INSERT INTO fusion.chat_reaction (message_id,user_id,emoji) VALUES (%s,%s,%s) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING", (message_id, user.user_id, payload.emoji))
        else:
            cur.execute("DELETE FROM fusion.chat_reaction WHERE message_id=%s AND user_id=%s AND emoji=%s", (message_id, user.user_id, payload.emoji))
        result = _message_payload(cur, message_id)
        conn.commit()
    await hub.conversation(row["conversation_id"], {"type": "message.updated", "conversation_id": str(row["conversation_id"]), "message": result})
    return result


@router.post("/conversations/{conversation_id}/read")
async def mark_read(conversation_id: UUID, user: Authenticated) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        _require_participant(cur, conversation_id, user)
        cur.execute("SELECT COALESCE(max(id),0) AS id FROM fusion.chat_message WHERE conversation_id=%s", (conversation_id,))
        message_id = int(cur.fetchone()["id"])
        cur.execute("UPDATE fusion.chat_participant SET last_read_message_id=%s WHERE conversation_id=%s AND user_id=%s", (message_id, conversation_id, user.user_id))
        conn.commit()
    await hub.conversation(conversation_id, {"type": "conversation.read", "conversation_id": str(conversation_id), "user_id": user.user_id, "message_id": message_id})
    return {"read": True, "message_id": message_id}


@router.patch("/settings")
def update_settings(payload: SettingsUpdate, user: Authenticated) -> dict[str, Any]:
    values = payload.model_dump(exclude_none=True)
    allowed = {"availability", "allow_direct_messages", "read_receipts", "sound_enabled", "footer_enabled", "chat_heads_enabled", "compact_mode"}
    values = {k: v for k, v in values.items() if k in allowed}
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        _ensure_settings(cur, user)
        if values:
            assignments = ",".join(f"{key}=%s" for key in values)
            cur.execute(f"UPDATE fusion.chat_user_setting SET {assignments},updated_at=now() WHERE user_id=%s", (*values.values(), user.user_id))
        cur.execute("SELECT * FROM fusion.chat_user_setting WHERE user_id=%s", (user.user_id,))
        row = cur.fetchone()
        conn.commit()
        return row


@router.post("/blocks/{blocked_id}")
def block_user(blocked_id: str, user: Authenticated) -> dict[str, bool]:
    if blocked_id == user.user_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="cannot block yourself")
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("INSERT INTO fusion.chat_block (blocker_id,blocked_id) VALUES (%s,%s) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING", (user.user_id, blocked_id))
        conn.commit()
    return {"blocked": True}


@router.delete("/blocks/{blocked_id}")
def unblock_user(blocked_id: str, user: Authenticated) -> dict[str, bool]:
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("DELETE FROM fusion.chat_block WHERE blocker_id=%s AND blocked_id=%s", (user.user_id, blocked_id))
        conn.commit()
    return {"blocked": False}


@router.websocket("/ws")
async def websocket_chat(websocket: WebSocket) -> None:
    protocols = list(websocket.scope.get("subprotocols") or [])
    token = next((value for value in protocols if value != "xavi-chat-v1"), "")
    try:
        user = _user_from_token(token)
    except Exception:
        await websocket.close(code=4401, reason="invalid Concrete CMS token")
        return
    await hub.connect(user, websocket)
    try:
        await websocket.send_json({"type": "socket.ready", "user_id": user.user_id, "online": list(hub.users.values())})
        while True:
            event = await websocket.receive_json()
            event_type = str(event.get("type") or "")
            if event_type == "ping":
                await websocket.send_json({"type": "pong", "at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})
                continue
            if event_type == "typing":
                try:
                    conversation_id = UUID(str(event.get("conversation_id")))
                except Exception:
                    continue
                with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
                    try:
                        _require_participant(cur, conversation_id, user)
                    except HTTPException:
                        continue
                await hub.conversation(conversation_id, {"type": "typing", "conversation_id": str(conversation_id), "user_id": user.user_id, "username": user.username, "active": bool(event.get("active", True))})
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass
    finally:
        await hub.disconnect(user, websocket)
PY

    start=s.find(decorator)

    for pat in ['\n@', '\n# ──', '\n# ══']:

    if curl -fsS --max-time 2 "http://127.0.0.1:${port}/" >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -sS --max-time 2 "http://127.0.0.1:${port}/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=1; break; fi
    sleep 0.5
  done
  [ "$ok" = 1 ] || { echo "backend $port failed readiness" >&2; exit 1; }
  echo "backend_${port}=ready"
done

# Upstream pool: least_conn keeps concurrent long MCP operations spread out.
cat > /tmp/xavi_dev_mcp_pool.conf <<'EOF'
upstream xavi_dev_mcp_pool {
    least_conn;
    server 127.0.0.1:8092 max_fails=2 fail_timeout=10s;
    server 127.0.0.1:8093 max_fails=2 fail_timeout=10s;
    server 127.0.0.1:8094 max_fails=2 fail_timeout=10s;
    keepalive 32;
}
EOF
sudo install -m 0644 /tmp/xavi_dev_mcp_pool.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/xavi-dev-mcp-pool.conf

# Change only direct adapter proxy targets; leave runtime/code-interpreter routes alone.
for f in /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/api.xavi.app.conf /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/dev.xavi.app.conf; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  sudo cp -a "$f" "$f.pre-mcp-pool-20260807"
  sudo sed -i 's#proxy_pass http://127\.0\.0\.1:8092/#proxy_pass http://xavi_dev_mcp_pool/#g' "$f"
done

sudo nginx -t
sudo systemctl reload nginx

echo '== pool listeners =='
ss -ltnp | grep -E ':8092|:8093|:8094' || true
echo '== unit state =='
systemctl --user is-active xavi-dev-mcp-adapter.service xavi-dev-mcp-adapter@8093.service xavi-dev-mcp-adapter@8094.service
echo '== nginx pool =='
grep -R -n -E 'xavi_dev_mcp_pool|127\.0\.0\.1:809[234]' /etc/nginx/conf.d/xavi-dev-mcp-pool.conf /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/api.xavi.app.conf /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/dev.xavi.app.conf

    if re.search(r'(KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD)', k, re.I):
        safe='REDACTED'
    print(f'{k} line {n}: {safe!r}')

print('\n== URL validation ==')
for k,(n,v) in sorted(env.items()):
    if any(tok in k.upper() for tok in ['URL','URI','HOST','BASE','DOMAIN']) or 'UPSTREAM' in k.upper():

argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/xavi-geo-search/v2
mkdir -p docs
cat > docs/fusion-os-desktop-shell.md <<'DOC'
# Fusion OS desktop shell

This document describes the browser desktop shell delivered by the `xavi_fusion_os` Concrete package. The deployed package version documented here is **0.11.5**.

The shell deliberately borrows mature desktop interaction patterns while retaining browser-native behavior. The application launcher is called the **Fusion Launcher**. It is not labelled as a Start menu. Browser right-click remains available to the browser, so Fusion application and tray menus open with **left click**, keyboard menu keys, or touch interaction.

## Source locations

```text
data/cms/packages/xavi_fusion_os/
├── blocks/xavi_fusion_taskbar/
├── css/fusion-os.css
├── js/fusion-os.js
├── js/messenger.js
├── src/Xavi/FusionOS/
└── controller.php
```

Application bundles and sources are stored beneath:

```text
data/cms/application/files/xavi_fusion_apps/
├── bundles/
└── sources/
```

## Taskbar block

The `xavi_fusion_taskbar` block portal-mounts the desktop shell outside Concrete edit mode. It can target:

- the browser viewport;
- the closest Concrete area; or
- the first element matching a configured CSS selector.

It can dock to the left, bottom, top, or right edge. Block settings include panel and icon size, Launcher alignment, layout-space reservation, auto-hide, compact mode, clock visibility, Launcher search, Launcher keyboard shortcut, Fusion Channel, synchronization scope, and managed-window behavior.

### Appearance

The taskbar editor provides these presets:

- Classic black, the default;
- Graphite;
- Ubuntu aubergine;
- Light;
- Glass;
- Custom colors.

The default presentation is a black background with white text, a one-pixel border, and a one-pixel edge radius. Editors may configure background, text, accent and border colors, radius, border width, opacity, font family, and additional inline CSS declarations.

The retired Fusion connection-status marker and its editor control have been removed. The right side of the taskbar is reserved for the application tray, its overflow control, and the clock.

## Managed windows

`window.XaviFusionOS` maintains the application registry and managed-window registry. Registered applications can be opened in draggable, resizable windows with minimize, maximize, restore, activate, and close behavior. Window geometry and state are browser-local.

The taskbar shows open windows separately from application tray items. Tray icons represent app-owned background state and commands; they are not substitutes for open-window task buttons.

## Fusion Launcher

The Launcher opens from the `@@@` taskbar control or the configured keyboard shortcut. Its interface consists of:

- an application search field;
- an **Apps** list, sortable by name or category;
- spatial application tiles;
- top-level groups and nested groups;
- a compact action rail;
- a vertically scrollable tile viewport;
- a user-resizable Launcher frame.

The UI does not display instructional filler such as drag directions or click instructions. That information belongs in accessible labels, tooltips, or documentation rather than permanent layout text.

### Click and menu behavior

For Launcher application items:

- left click opens the Fusion action menu;
- double click opens the application;
- keyboard activation and menu keys are supported;
- browser right-click is not intercepted.

Menus are capability-driven and may include open, tile size, group movement, taskbar actions, app settings, jump-list tasks, package controls, or other application-specific commands.

### Tile sizes and coordinates

Supported footprints are:

| Size | Grid footprint |
|---|---:|
| Small | 1 × 1 |
| Medium | 2 × 2 |
| Wide | 4 × 2 |
| Large | 4 × 4 |

Settled `tileX`, `tileY`, size, and group membership are authoritative. During drag, the client constructs a reversible candidate layout. The source location becomes available, occupied items temporarily move aside, and the destination vacancy is shown before release. The complete affected arrangement is persisted atomically when the drop commits.

This model replaced the earlier occupied-cell rejection behavior. It preserves deliberate gaps without treating the Launcher as an unrestricted pixel canvas.

### Browser-proven coordinate fixes

The 0.8.28 browser audit found that legacy `!important` span rules were discarding stored grid start lines. Tile rendering now uses authoritative CSS variables for both start line and span. The drag ghost also uses an explicit fixed-position origin, preventing its static-position origin from offsetting it outside the visible Launcher.

### Drag behavior

Tile drag supports:

- a movement threshold before drag begins;
- pointer capture;
- full-footprint ghost and preview geometry;
- nearest complete opening selection;
- occupied-item preview reflow;
- cross-group movement;
- vertical edge scrolling;
- cancellation and rollback;
- atomic persistence of all affected items.

Dragging one tile over another does **not** implicitly create a nested group. Ordinary drag always means spatial placement and reflow.

## Groups

Fusion exposes one user concept: **groups**.

- Top-level groups organize regions of Launcher tiles.
- Nested groups contain selected applications and open inline when clicked.
- Existing internal compatibility names may still use category or folder terminology in storage and routes, but the UI presents groups.

### Top-level group behavior

Top-level groups support:

- inline title editing;
- untitled groups;
- a hover-revealed drag handle;
- rigid whole-group movement while preserving internal coordinates;
- divider targets for creating a new group through spatial dragging;
- collapse state;
- locked layout state;
- grid dimensions, accent and background settings;
- sandboxed group automation hooks.

### Explicit nested grouping

A grouping button beside the group-edit pencil enters selection mode. Two or more applications may be selected and grouped deliberately. The same mode supports removing children or dissolving the nested group.

Outside grouping mode, clicking a nested group opens or closes its inline child panel. This explicit workflow replaced center-dwell drag grouping because implicit capture interfered with ordinary tile rearrangement.

## Application tray

The taskbar notification area is implemented as a spatial application tray with two surfaces:

1. the visible taskbar tray;
2. the overflow flyout containing hidden tray icons.

There are no Show, Hide, Pin, Unpin, Move left, Move right, Move up, or Move down management commands. Placement is the control:

- drag within the visible tray to reorder visible icons;
- drag within overflow to reorder hidden icons;
- drag from overflow into the tray to make an icon visible at that location;
- drag from the tray into overflow to hide it at that overflow location.

Dragging from the visible tray opens the overflow surface automatically. Window-level pointer tracking preserves the drag when an icon is reparented between surfaces. Coordinate-based insertion follows the icon's visible position. Empty-drop markers appear only on genuinely empty surfaces so occupied tray geometry remains stable during drag.

### Tray tooltips

Tray and overflow tiles are icon-only. Hover text contains the application name and, when useful, its badge value. It does not state “In overflow” or “Shown on taskbar”; the icon's location already communicates that state.

### App-owned left-click menus

Left clicking a tray icon opens commands supplied by that application. Tray placement controls are never inserted into this menu.

Applications without custom commands receive one app-named open command, such as `Open Calculator`. Applications may expose live state through dynamic actions, checked commands, disabled commands, separators, badges, settings links, or app-specific tasks.

Messenger currently exposes:

- Open Chat;
- Open unread when unread conversations exist;
- Online, Away, Busy, and Offline availability choices;
- Messenger settings;
- Messenger administration for administrators;
- a live unread badge.

Exactly one availability item is checked. Messenger's action provider is recalculated from current state when the tray registry is rendered.

## Tray application API

Applications can register a tray item directly:

```js
window.XaviFusionOS.registerNotificationItem('example:status', {
  appID: 'example-app',
  title: 'Example',
  icon: 'EX',
  badge: '',
  defaultPinned: false,
  getActions: ({item, app, windows}) => [
    {
      id: 'open-app',
      title: 'Open Example',
      run: () => window.XaviFusionOS.openBuiltin('example-app')
    },
    {separator: true},
    {
      id: 'enabled',
      title: 'Enabled',
      checked: true,
      run: () => toggleExampleState()
    },
    {
      id: 'settings',
      title: 'Example settings',
      run: () => openExampleSettings()
    }
  ]
});
```

Other registry methods are:

```js
window.XaviFusionOS.updateNotificationItem(id, patch);
window.XaviFusionOS.unregisterNotificationItem(id);
window.XaviFusionOS.notificationItems();
window.XaviFusionOS.activateNotificationItem(id, actionID);
```

Action fields are:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Stable action identifier |
| `title` | Visible command label |
| `run` | Command handler |
| `enabled` | Whether the command can run |
| `checked` | Optional boolean menu state |
| `separator` | Render a menu separator |
| `danger` | Mark a destructive command |

`getActions` is optional and is evaluated against current app and window state. Static `actions` remain supported.

`defaultPinned` is retained only as a first-seen default and migration compatibility field. It is not exposed as a user command. Once an item has been seen, the user's drag placement controls its location.

Applications registered through `registerApp()` automatically receive a tray registry entry unless tray integration is disabled. App jump-list tasks may also be exposed through the app-owned menu.

## Browser-local state

The shell currently stores these browser-local preferences:

| Key | Contents |
|---|---|
| `xaviFusionNotificationArea` | `{order, tray, seen}` for tray and overflow placement |
| `xaviFusionLauncherSize` | User-resized Launcher width and height |
| `xaviFusionLauncherAppSort` | `name` or `category` |

Older notification state containing `pinned` is migrated to `tray` automatically.

Launcher tile and group state is persisted through authenticated Fusion Launcher routes. Current routes use `/xavi-fusion/api/launcher`; legacy route and database names remain compatibility aliases where required for existing installations.

## Accessibility and input

The shell provides:

- accessible names for Launcher items and tray icons;
- button and menu roles;
- checked state for stateful commands;
- keyboard focus and spatial tile navigation;
- `Space`, `Enter`, Context Menu, and `Shift+F10` handling where appropriate;
- reduced-motion behavior;
- mouse, pointer, and touch-compatible drag thresholds.

Right-click remains browser-native by design.

## Application bundles and Messenger

Self-contained `.xaviapp` bundles are installed through the taskbar block editor or from the configured application source directory. Enabled apps are profile-scoped. The Messenger app is integrated with the Fusion OS application registry, managed windows, Launcher, unread badges, and app-owned tray commands.

See [Fusion application bundles](fusion-application-packages.md) for packaging and installation details.

## Browser verification

Source validation is necessary but not sufficient for the desktop shell. Releases are checked in authenticated Chromium with Playwright.

The browser gates cover:

- real rendered grid coordinates;
- full tile, ghost, and preview geometry;
- occupied-tile reflow and atomic restoration;
- explicit nested group creation and dissolution;
- group open and close behavior;
- Launcher resize and accessibility;
- icon-only overflow geometry;
- app-owned tray menus;
- overflow-to-tray dragging;
- visible-tray reordering;
- tray-to-overflow dragging;
- local-state migration and restoration;
- zero JavaScript page errors.

The current 0.11.4 spatial-tray gate passed all assertions. Version 0.11.5 changes only stale taskbar-editor terminology and removal of the retired status option; the verified tray implementation is unchanged.

A separate existing request remains outside the tray and Launcher work:

```text
PUT /xavi-fusion/api/workspace/primary → 403
```

The browser release gates allow only that known failure and continue to require zero JavaScript page errors.

## Revision history

### 0.8.5–0.8.27

- Expanded taskbar editor, appearance controls, themes, docking, drag thresholds, pointer capture, full-footprint hit boxes, nearest complete opening selection, and the `@@@` Launcher control.
- Established authenticated browser testing rather than relying on source inspection alone.

### 0.8.28

- Made stored tile grid starts authoritative through CSS variables.
- Corrected the fixed drag-ghost origin.

### 0.8.29

- Removed recursive Messenger app registration caused by an incorrect app-list API check.
- Added the public `listApps()` compatibility bridge.

### 0.8.30–0.8.31

- Coalesced application-registry refreshes.
- Preserved an open Launcher across delayed taskbar redraws.
- Deferred redraw while a Launcher drag is active.

### 0.9.0–0.9.5

- Adopted Fusion Launcher terminology.
- Added candidate-layout reflow, atomic multi-item persistence, vertical viewport scrolling, group movement, divider-created groups, nested groups, inline naming, keyboard navigation, resize persistence, capability menus, and accessibility.
- Removed the visible Fusion status marker.
- Added transient application-registry retries.

### 0.10.0

- Disabled implicit drag-to-group capture.
- Added the explicit group-selection editor beside the pencil.
- Unified top-level and nested organization under the group concept.
- Added the application tray registry and removed the obsolete Fusion marker.

### 0.10.1–0.10.4

- Replaced text-heavy tray rows with compact mini-tiles.
- Moved tray commands into left-click item menus.
- Corrected zero-sized icon spans in Chromium.
- Removed redundant location labels and item-menu headers.

### 0.11.0–0.11.4

- Replaced pin/show/hide management with a spatial tray and overflow model.
- Added dynamic app-owned action providers.
- Added Messenger state, availability, unread, settings, and administration actions.
- Moved cross-surface pointer tracking to the window.
- Corrected dynamic provider window context.
- Added coordinate-based visible-tray ordering.
- Stabilized occupied tray geometry during drag.

### 0.11.5

- Removed the retired Fusion connection-status option from taskbar add/edit forms.
- Replaced the last stale “Start button” help text with “Launcher button”.

A Fusion application moves through these layers:

4. **Activate** — the verified files are stored under a versioned application root and the installation record is written to the Fusion application registry.
5. **Authorize** — `requiredGroup`, global enablement, the profile's `app:access` scope, and profile enablement determine whether the application is returned to that user.
6. **Load** — the browser requests `/xavi-fusion/api/app-packages`, attaches declared styles, imports the versioned entry module, and verifies that the module registered the declared custom element.
7. **Register** — Fusion OS registers the app with the Launcher, managed-window system, app menu, and application tray registry.
8. **Run** — opening the app creates its custom element inside a managed Fusion window and passes the versioned app attributes.
9. **Enrich** — the app may add live badges, checked state, settings, availability, background tasks, or other app-owned tray actions after registration.

- the application tray registry;
- profile and dashboard application-management pages.

The server-derived runtime specification includes the ID, titles, description, icon, category, custom-element component, versioned base/manifest/module/style URLs, capabilities, dimensions, safe element attributes, profile enablement, and compatibility state.

### Launcher placement is separate from installation

An installed and enabled app is discoverable in the Apps list. Whether it also has a tile, which group owns that tile, its tile size, and its `tileX`/`tileY` coordinates are Launcher-layout concerns persisted by the Launcher service. They are not encoded by the ZIP's file order.

Ordinary tile dragging performs spatial reflow. Nested groups are created through the explicit group-selection interface, not by dropping one app on another.

### Managed-window behavior

Opening a packaged app creates the declared custom element inside a Fusion-managed window. Initial width and height come from the normalized manifest. Fusion owns activation, task switching, minimize, maximize, restore, close, and browser-local window geometry. The package owns the content inside its element.

### Automatic application tray entry

`registerApp()` creates `app:<app-id>` in the notification/tray registry unless `notificationArea: false` is supplied by a runtime app specification. Version-1 bundle manifests do not currently declare that runtime function-bearing field, so normal bundles receive an automatic tray item.

The automatic menu contains one app-named open command, for example `Open Calculator`. Any runtime `jumpList` tasks and app-provided notification actions are merged by stable action ID. An app may override the generic `open-app` action with a more specific label such as Messenger's `Open Chat`.

Tray **placement is user-controlled**:

- drag within the visible tray to reorder;
- drag within overflow to reorder hidden icons;
- drag overflow → tray to show an icon at that position;
- drag tray → overflow to hide it at that position.

Applications must not add Pin, Unpin, Show, Hide, Move left, Move right, Move up, or Move down commands. The icon's physical location is the placement control.

### Add package-owned tray actions after registration

The package loader imports the module before it performs the app registration. Therefore, a module that wants to enrich its automatic tray item should wait until the app exists, then update `app:<app-id>`.

```js
const APP_ID = 'example-app';
const TRAY_ID = `app:${APP_ID}`;

function installTrayActions() {
  const fusion = window.XaviFusionOS;
  if (!fusion?.apps?.().some(app => app.id === APP_ID)) return false;

  const patch = {
    badge: unreadCount() > 0 ? String(unreadCount()) : '',
    getActions: () => [
      {
        id: 'open-app',
        title: 'Open Example',
        run: () => fusion.openBuiltin(APP_ID)
      },
      ...(unreadCount() > 0 ? [{
        id: 'open-unread',
        title: `Open unread (${unreadCount()})`,
        run: openFirstUnread
      }] : []),
      {separator: true},
      {
        id: 'enabled',
        title: 'Background processing',
        checked: backgroundEnabled(),
        run: toggleBackground
      },
      {
        id: 'settings',
        title: 'Example settings',
        run: openSettings
      }
    ]
  };

  try {
    fusion.updateNotificationItem(TRAY_ID, patch);
  } catch {
    fusion.registerNotificationItem(TRAY_ID, {
      appID: APP_ID,
      title: 'Example',
      icon: 'EX',
      ...patch
    });
  }
  return true;
}

queueMicrotask(installTrayActions);
window.addEventListener('xavi:package-apps-loaded', installTrayActions);
window.addEventListener('xavi:apps-changed', installTrayActions);
```

`getActions` is evaluated from current state whenever the shell enumerates tray commands. Actions support:

| Field | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `id` | Stable merge and dispatch identifier |
| `title` | Visible command text |
| `run` | Function invoked by the shell |
| `enabled` | Disable the command without removing it |
| `checked` | Render a checked/unchecked state command |
| `separator` | Add a separator |
| `danger` | Mark a destructive action |

`updateNotificationItem()` dispatches `xavi:notification-items-changed`; it does not re-register the application. Avoid calling `registerApp()` from an `xavi:apps-changed` listener unless the app is genuinely absent, or the listener can recurse.

### Runtime `registerApp()` fields

Built-in or non-bundle runtime applications may call `registerApp(id, spec)` directly. Important fields include:

| Field | Shell behavior |
|---|---|
| `title`, `shortTitle`, `description`, `icon`, `category` | Launcher, menu, window, and tray presentation |
| `component`, `attrs` | Custom element instantiated in the managed window |
| `width`, `height` | Initial window dimensions |
| `tileSize`, `supportedTileSizes` | Launcher sizing capabilities |
| `capabilities` | Capability-driven application menu behavior |
| `liveCapable`, `liveText` | Live tile/state presentation |
| `jumpList` | App tasks merged into the app-owned tray/action menu |
| `notificationArea` | Tray title, icon, badge, actions, dynamic action provider, first-seen default, or `false` |
| `targetType` | Application target classification |

For installed `.xaviapp` packages, the loader supplies the safe declarative subset. Function-bearing behavior is added by the imported module through the public runtime APIs.

### Messenger as the reference integration

Messenger demonstrates the complete pattern:

- a self-contained application package and custom element;
- optional `fusionBackend: "messenger"` provisioning;
- automatic Launcher and managed-window registration;
- an automatic `app:messenger` tray item;
- unread badge updates;
- Open Chat and Open unread commands;
- checked Online, Away, Busy, and Offline state;
- profile settings and administrator actions;
- one-time visible-tray default followed by user-owned drag placement.

### Compatibility fields

Database/profile fields named `pinned`, `startPinned`, `taskbarPinned`, and internal settings named `startMenuEnabled` remain for installed-site compatibility. They must not be interpreted as the current tray interaction model:

- Launcher tile/group placement is owned by Launcher state;
- visible tray membership is owned by browser-local `{order, tray, seen}` state;
- users change tray placement by dragging;
- the UI is called the Fusion Launcher.

New code and documentation should use Launcher, group, tray, and overflow terminology even where legacy route or storage aliases remain.

#!/usr/bin/env bash

  if podman container exists "$c"; then
    podman start "$c" >/dev/null || true
  else
    (cd "$d" && podman compose -f docker-compose.yaml up -d)
  fi
done

# Wait for representative nodes to answer HTTP.
for p in 8885 8888 8892 8896 8900 8904; do
  ok=0
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do
    if curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:$p/" --max-time 5 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ok=1
      break
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ]; then
    echo "SearXNG node $p did not become ready" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

# Verify SearXNG containers can reach the Gluetun HTTP proxy ports.
# Use TCP connect only here, not api.ipify, so startup does not fail because
# a remote IP-check service is slow.
for p in 8480 8481 8482 8483; do
  ok=0
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do
    if podman exec searxng8885 sh -lc "python - <<PY
import socket
s = socket.socket()

s.connect(('host.containers.internal', $p))
s.close()
PY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ok=1
      break
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ]; then
    echo "Proxy port $p was not reachable from searxng8885" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
EOF

  local name="$1" limit="${2:-60}" i state

    [[ "$state" == "running" ]] && return 0

set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/var/www/xavi/xavi-man-app
TUI="$ROOT/xavi_man/tui.py"
STAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
BACK=/datastore2/xavi/data/xavi-man/recovery/$STAMP
mkdir -p "$BACK"
cp -a "$TUI" "$BACK/tui.py.before"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/var/www/xavi/xavi-man-app/xavi_man/tui.py')
s=p.read_text()
# Ensure threading support.
if 'import threading\n' not in s:
    s=s.replace('import json\n', 'import json\nimport threading\n', 1)
# Add background refresh state to __init__ before desktop construction.
old='''        self.status = urwid.Text("Ready", align="left")
        self.summary = urwid.Text("")
        self.desktop = self._build_desktop()
        self.loop = urwid.MainLoop(self.desktop, PALETTE, unhandled_input=self._key)
'''
new='''        self.status = urwid.Text("Ready", align="left")
        self.summary = urwid.Text("Backend state will load after the menu opens.")
        self._refresh_thread: threading.Thread | None = None
        self._refresh_result: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        self._refresh_error: str | None = None
        self._refresh_lock = threading.Lock()
        self.desktop = self._build_desktop()
        self.loop = urwid.MainLoop(self.desktop, PALETTE, unhandled_input=self._key)
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('init marker not found')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
# Remove pre-loop refresh call from desktop construction.
s=s.replace('''        self._refresh_summary()
        return frame
''','''        return frame
''',1)
# Replace synchronous summary refresh with background worker methods.
start=s.index('    def _refresh_summary(self) -> None:\n')
end=s.index('    def _show_window(', start)
new_methods='''    def _refresh_summary(self) -> None:
        """Request a refresh without blocking the Urwid UI thread."""
        self._start_background_refresh()

    def _start_background_refresh(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        if self._refresh_thread is not None and self._refresh_thread.is_alive():
            return
        self.status.set_text("Pooling backend state in background…")
        self.summary.set_text("Loading containers, services, projects and health…")
        with self._refresh_lock:
            self._refresh_result = None
            self._refresh_error = None

        def worker() -> None:
            try:
                result = self.backend.state(max_age=0)
                with self._refresh_lock:
                    self._refresh_result = result
            except Exception as exc:
                with self._refresh_lock:
                    self._refresh_error = str(exc)

        self._refresh_thread = threading.Thread(target=worker, name="xavi-man-state-pool", daemon=True)
        self._refresh_thread.start()
        self.loop.set_alarm_in(0.10, self._collect_background_refresh)

    def _collect_background_refresh(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        thread = self._refresh_thread
        if thread is not None and thread.is_alive():
            self.loop.set_alarm_in(0.15, self._collect_background_refresh)
            return
        with self._refresh_lock:
            state = self._refresh_result
            error = self._refresh_error
            self._refresh_result = None
            self._refresh_error = None
        if error:
            self.status.set_text("Background refresh failed")
            self.summary.set_text(f"Status refresh failed: {error}")
            return
        if state is None:
            self.status.set_text("Ready")
            return
        doctor = state.get("doctor", {})
        self.summary.set_text(
            f"Containers {len(state.get('containers', []))}   Services {len(state.get('services', []))}   "
            f"Projects {len(state.get('projects', []))}   Doctor {'PASS' if doctor.get('ok') else 'ATTENTION'}   "
            f"Issues {doctor.get('issue_count', 0)}"
        )
        self.status.set_text("Ready — backend state pooled")

'''
s=s[:start]+new_methods+s[end:]
# Start background pooling only after the event loop has begun.
old='''    def run(self) -> None:
        self.loop.run()
'''
new='''    def run(self) -> None:
        # Paint the Program Manager first. Backend discovery begins only after
        # Urwid has entered its event loop, and it runs off the UI thread.
        self.loop.set_alarm_in(0.05, self._start_background_refresh)
        self.loop.run()
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('run marker not found')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
python3 -m compileall -q "$ROOT/xavi_man"
echo '== no pre-loop scan proof =='
nl -ba "$TUI" | sed -n '34,115p'
echo '== run path =='
nl -ba "$TUI" | sed -n '270,290p' || true
# Install per-user command. This takes effect immediately if ~/.local/bin is on PATH,
# and is also usable by absolute path regardless of current shell PATH.
mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"
cat > "$HOME/.local/bin/xavi-man" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
exec /var/www/xavi/xavi-man "$@"
EOF
chmod 0755 "$HOME/.local/bin/xavi-man"
printf 'path_has_local_bin='; case ":$PATH:" in *":$HOME/.local/bin:"*) echo yes;; *) echo no;; esac
printf 'command_abs='; "$HOME/.local/bin/xavi-man" --help | head -1
printf 'backup=%s\n' "$BACK"
fix_xavi_man_nonblocking_startup_0808.description: Remove all backend scans from xavi-man TUI construction, render Program Manager immediately, start state pooling in a daemon thread only after Urwid event loop begins, update summary asynchronously without blocking UI, and install a user xavi-man command wrapper.
