import json, subprocess, urllib.request

def env(name):
 out=subprocess.check_output(['podman','inspect','duotronic-runtime','--format','{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}'],text=True)
 for line in out.splitlines():
  k,_,v=line.partition('=')
  if k==name:return v
 return ''
key=env('XAVI_MCP_API_KEY');assert key
base='http://127.0.0.1:8080/xavi-runtime/mcp'
headers={'X-Xavi-Mcp-Key':key,'Content-Type':'application/json'}
def get(path):
 req=urllib.request.Request(base+path,headers={'X-Xavi-Mcp-Key':key})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r:return json.load(r)
def call(tool,args):
 body=json.dumps({'tool':tool,'args':args,'request_id':'coord-wgrnn-live'}).encode()
 req=urllib.request.Request(base+'/call',data=body,headers=headers,method='POST')
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=60) as r:return json.load(r)['result']
names=[row['name'] for row in get('/tools')['tools']]
assert names[:14]==[
 'coordination.begin','coordination.status','coordination.plan','coordination.claim','coordination.preflight','coordination.heartbeat','coordination.event','coordination.search','coordination.release','coordination.finish',
 'coordination.learning_status','coordination.learning_context','coordination.learning_replay_verify','coordination.learning_promote'
],names[:14]
project='coordination-wgrnn-live-test'
common={'project_key':project,'session_id':'coord-wgrnn-live-agent','agent_id':'coord-wgrnn-live-agent','client_name':'live-test','user_agent':'bounded-test','device_id_digest':'sha256:test'}
resource='path:/tmp/xavi-coordination-wgrnn-live/test.txt'
begin=call('coordination.begin',{**common,'title':'WG-RNN bridge live test','objective':'Learn from a failure and a verified successful fix','resources':[resource],'lease_seconds':600})
work_id=str(begin['work']['work_id'])
failed=call('coordination.event',{**common,'work_id':work_id,'event_type':'tool_failed','summary':'Write failed because the target parent directory did not exist','resources':[resource],'payload':{'tool_name':'dev_rpc','status':'error','api_token':'supersecret','failure_class':'missing_parent'}})
fe=failed['event'];assert fe['learning']['ingested'] is True,fe
assert fe['payload']['api_token']=='[REDACTED]',fe['payload']
succeeded=call('coordination.event',{**common,'work_id':work_id,'event_type':'tool_succeeded','summary':'Created the parent directory, wrote atomically, and verified the resulting file','resources':[resource],'payload':{'tool_name':'dev_rpc','status':'ok','test_result':'PASS','authorization':'Bearer should-not-persist'}})
se=succeeded['event'];assert se['learning']['ingested'] is True,se
assert se['payload']['authorization']=='[REDACTED]',se['payload']
promote_slot=int(se['learning']['slot_id'])
original_update=se['learning']['update_id']
status=call('coordination.learning_status',{**common,'include_slots':True,'limit':20})
assert status['available'] and len(status['recent_links'])>=2,status
context=call('coordination.learning_context',{**common,'query':'dev_rpc write missing parent directory atomic verified file','resources':[resource],'top_k':8})
assert context['available'] and context['count']>=1,context
assert any(lesson['source_event']['event_type'] in {'tool_failed','tool_succeeded'} for lesson in context['lessons'])
verified=call('coordination.learning_replay_verify',{**common,'work_id':work_id})
assert verified['verified'],verified
promoted=call('coordination.learning_promote',{**common,'work_id':work_id,'slot_id':promote_slot,'reason':'The successful sequence is backed by a passing live test and linked source event','approved_by':'integration-test'})
assert promoted['promotion']['promoted'] is True,promoted
again=call('coordination.event',{**common,'work_id':work_id,'event_type':'tool_succeeded','summary':'Repeated the verified atomic write sequence successfully','resources':[resource],'payload':{'tool_name':'dev_rpc','status':'ok','test_result':'PASS'}})
ae=again['event'];assert ae['learning']['ingested'] is True,ae
assert int(ae['learning']['slot_id']) != promote_slot,(ae['learning'],promote_slot)
status2=call('coordination.learning_status',{**common,'include_slots':True,'limit':30})
slot={row['slot_id']:row for row in status2['snapshot']['slots']}[promote_slot]
assert slot['trust_status']=='promoted' and slot['update_id']==original_update,slot
verified2=call('coordination.learning_replay_verify',{**common,'work_id':work_id})
assert verified2['verified'],verified2
call('coordination.finish',{**common,'work_id':work_id,'status':'completed','summary':'WG-RNN coordination bridge live test passed','close_session':True})

import json, os, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

def container_env(name):
 import subprocess
 out=subprocess.check_output(['podman','inspect','duotronic-runtime','--format','{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}'],text=True)
 for line in out.splitlines():
  key,sep,value=line.partition('=')
  if key==name:return value
 return ''
key=container_env('XAVI_MCP_API_KEY')
assert key, 'runtime MCP key unavailable'
base='http://127.0.0.1:8080/xavi-runtime/mcp'
headers={'X-Xavi-Mcp-Key':key,'Content-Type':'application/json'}
def get(path):
 req=urllib.request.Request(base+path,headers={'X-Xavi-Mcp-Key':key})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r:return json.load(r)
def call(tool,args):
 body=json.dumps({'tool':tool,'args':args,'request_id':'coord-live-test'}).encode()
 req=urllib.request.Request(base+'/call',data=body,headers=headers,method='POST')
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r:return json.load(r)['result']
tools=get('/tools')['tools']
names=[row['name'] for row in tools]
assert names[:10]==['coordination.begin','coordination.status','coordination.plan','coordination.claim','coordination.preflight','coordination.heartbeat','coordination.event','coordination.search','coordination.release','coordination.finish'],names[:10]
common={'project_key':'coordination-live-test','client_name':'live-test','user_agent':'bounded-test','device_id_digest':'sha256:test'}
a={**common,'session_id':'live-test-agent-a','agent_id':'agent-a'}
b={**common,'session_id':'live-test-agent-b','agent_id':'agent-b'}
resource='path:/tmp/xavi-coordination-live'
child=resource+'/child.txt'
ra=call('coordination.begin',{**a,'title':'Coordination live test A','objective':'Hold parent resource','resources':[resource],'lease_seconds':600})
assert ra['claim']['allowed'] is True,ra
work_a=str(ra['work']['work_id'])
rb=call('coordination.begin',{**b,'title':'Coordination live test B','objective':'Attempt child resource','resources':[child],'lease_seconds':600})
assert rb['claim']['allowed'] is False and rb['claim']['conflicts'],rb
work_b=str(rb['work']['work_id'])
released=call('coordination.release',{**a,'work_id':work_a,'resources':[resource]})
assert released['count']>=1,released
claimed=call('coordination.claim',{**b,'work_id':work_b,'resources':[child],'lease_seconds':600,'purpose':'Claim after release'})
assert claimed['allowed'] is True,claimed
call('coordination.event',{**b,'work_id':work_b,'event_type':'test_passed','summary':'Prefix overlap conflict and release/reclaim passed','resources':[child],'payload':{'result':'PASS'}})
searched=call('coordination.search',{**b,'query':'Prefix overlap conflict','limit':20})
assert searched['count']>=1,searched
board=call('coordination.status',{**b,'resources':[child],'limit':50})
assert any(row['resource_key']==child for row in board['active_claims']),board
call('coordination.finish',{**a,'work_id':work_a,'status':'completed','summary':'Agent A test complete','close_session':True})
call('coordination.finish',{**b,'work_id':work_b,'status':'completed','summary':'Agent B test complete','close_session':True})
print('tools_first=PASS')
print('parent_child_conflict=PASS')
print('release_reclaim=PASS')
print('search_memory=PASS')
print('work_a='+work_a)
print('work_b='+work_b)
PY

import django
django.setup()
from django.db import transaction
from users.models import User
from files.models import Media
with transaction.atomic():
    legacy = User.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=1)
    if legacy.username not in {"tbi", "admin"}:
        raise SystemExit("unexpected legacy username")
    duplicate = User.objects.select_for_update().filter(username="admin").exclude(pk=legacy.pk).first()
    if duplicate is not None:
        if Media.objects.filter(user=duplicate).exists() or duplicate.playlists.exists():
            raise SystemExit("refusing merge: duplicate admin owns content")
        if duplicate.is_superuser or duplicate.is_staff or duplicate.is_manager or duplicate.is_editor or duplicate.advancedUser:
            raise SystemExit("refusing merge: duplicate admin has elevated privileges")
        duplicate.delete()
    legacy.username = "admin"
    legacy.is_active = True
    legacy.is_approved = True
    legacy.set_unusable_password()
    legacy.save()
print("id="+str(legacy.id))
print("username="+legacy.username)
print("superuser="+str(legacy.is_superuser))
print("staff="+str(legacy.is_staff))
print("media="+str(Media.objects.filter(user=legacy).count()))
print("password_usable="+str(legacy.has_usable_password()))
print("user_count="+str(User.objects.count()))
PY'

argv:
set -euo pipefail
SRC=/var/www/xavi/games
DST=/datastore2/games
STAMP=20260809T0930
BACKUP=/var/www/xavi/games.root-before-datastore2-$STAMP

echo '=== preflight ==='
test -d "$SRC" && test ! -L "$SRC"
test ! -e "$DST"
test ! -e "$BACKUP"
df -h / /datastore2

echo '=== stop Eye on Chess if anything is running ==='
running=$(podman ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep '^eyeonchess-' || true)
if [ -n "$running" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$running" | xargs -r podman stop -t 10; fi

echo '=== copy games source ==='
mkdir -p "$DST"
rsync -aHAX --numeric-ids --info=stats2 "$SRC/" "$DST/"

echo '=== source integrity dry-run ==='
changes=$(mktemp)
rsync -aHAXcn --numeric-ids --itemize-changes "$SRC/" "$DST/" > "$changes"
if [ -s "$changes" ]; then echo 'checksum verification failed:'; cat "$changes"; rm -f "$changes"; exit 20; fi
rm -f "$changes"

echo '=== migrate existing persistent volumes into datastore2 tree ==='
DATA="$DST/chess/eye-on-chess/data"
mkdir -p "$DATA" "$DATA/certbot"
copy_volume(){
  vol="$1"; rel="$2"; target="$DATA/$rel"
  mkdir -p "$target"
  if podman volume exists "$vol"; then
    src=$(podman volume inspect "$vol" --format '{{.Mountpoint}}')
    podman unshare rsync -aHAX --numeric-ids "$src/" "$target/"
    echo "$vol -> $target ($(du -sh "$target" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'))"
  fi
}
copy_volume eyeonchess-pgdata postgres
copy_volume eyeonchess-redis-data redis
copy_volume eyeonchess-prometheus-data prometheus
copy_volume eyeonchess-loki-data loki
copy_volume eyeonchess-grafana-data grafana
copy_volume eyeonchess-certbot-certs certbot/certs
copy_volume eyeonchess-certbot-webroot certbot/webroot

echo '=== atomic compatibility symlink ==='
mv "$SRC" "$BACKUP"
ln -s "$DST" "$SRC"
test -L "$SRC"
test -f "$SRC/chess/eye-on-chess/package.json"

echo '=== verify old source equals datastore source via symlink target ==='
changes=$(mktemp)
rsync -aHAXcn --numeric-ids --itemize-changes "$BACKUP/" "$DST/" > "$changes"
if [ -s "$changes" ]; then echo 'post-swap checksum verification failed:'; cat "$changes"; rm -f "$changes"; rm "$SRC"; mv "$BACKUP" "$SRC"; exit 21; fi
rm -f "$changes"

echo '=== remove verified root copy ==='
rm -rf "$BACKUP"

echo '=== final ==='
ls -ld "$SRC" "$DST" "$SRC/chess/eye-on-chess"
du -sh "$DST" "$DST/chess/eye-on-chess/data" 2>/dev/null || true
df -h / /datastore2
echo migration=PASS

argv:

LIB="$ROOT/library"
PG_OLD=/datastore2/mediacms_pgdata
PG_NEW="$DBROOT/postgres"

BACKUPS="$DBROOT/backups"
REDIS_TMP="/tmp/mediacms-redis-$STAMP.rdb"

BASE=docker-compose.yaml
cp -a "$OVERRIDE" "$OVERRIDE.pre-storage-$STAMP"
cp -a "$BASE" "$BASE.pre-storage-$STAMP"
rollback_files(){ cp -a "$OVERRIDE.pre-storage-$STAMP" "$OVERRIDE" || true; cp -a "$BASE.pre-storage-$STAMP" "$BASE" || true; }

echo '=== prepare backup directory ==='
podman unshare sh -c 'mkdir -p "$1"; chown 0:0 "$1"' sh "$BACKUPS"

echo '=== logical PostgreSQL backup ==='
podman exec mediacms_db_1 pg_dump -U mediacms -d mediacms -Fc > "$BACKUPS/mediacms-$STAMP.dump"
pgbytes=$(stat -c %s "$BACKUPS/mediacms-$STAMP.dump")
[ "$pgbytes" -gt 1000 ]
sha256sum "$BACKUPS/mediacms-$STAMP.dump" > "$BACKUPS/mediacms-$STAMP.dump.sha256"
echo "postgres_backup_bytes=$pgbytes"

echo '=== Redis snapshot ==='
podman exec mediacms_redis_1 redis-cli SAVE >/dev/null
podman cp mediacms_redis_1:/data/dump.rdb "$REDIS_TMP"
[ -s "$REDIS_TMP" ]
echo "redis_snapshot_bytes=$(stat -c %s "$REDIS_TMP")"

echo '=== patch compose files while current stack is still healthy ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
ov=Path('docker-compose.override.yml')
s=ov.read_text()
checks={
'/datastore2/mediacms_pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data/':'/datastore2/media_files/database/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data/',
'/datastore2/media_files:/home/mediacms.io/mediacms/media_files':'/datastore2/media_files/library:/home/mediacms.io/mediacms/media_files',
}
for old,new in checks.items():
    if old not in s:
        raise SystemExit(f'override anchor missing: {old}')
    s=s.replace(old,new)
redis_old='''  redis:\n    image: redis:alpine\n    restart: always\n    networks:\n      - mediacms_fixed\n'''
redis_new='''  redis:\n    image: redis:alpine\n    restart: always\n    volumes:\n      - /datastore2/media_files/database/redis:/data\n    networks:\n      - mediacms_fixed\n'''
if redis_old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('override redis anchor missing')
s=s.replace(redis_old,redis_new,1)
ov.write_text(s)

base=Path('docker-compose.yaml')
b=base.read_text()
if '../postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data/' not in b:
    raise SystemExit('base postgres anchor missing')
b=b.replace('../postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data/','/datastore2/media_files/database/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data/',1)
redis_old='''  redis:\n    image: "redis:alpine"\n    restart: always\n    healthcheck:\n'''
redis_new='''  redis:\n    image: "redis:alpine"\n    restart: always\n    volumes:\n      - /datastore2/media_files/database/redis:/data\n    healthcheck:\n'''
if redis_old not in b:
    raise SystemExit('base redis anchor missing')
b=b.replace(redis_old,redis_new,1)
base.write_text(b)
PY

echo '=== stop MediaCMS cleanly ==='
systemctl --user stop mediacms.service

migration_ok=0
rollback(){
  rc=$?
  if [ "$migration_ok" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "migration_failed_rc=$rc; attempting rollback" >&2
    rollback_files
    systemctl --user stop mediacms.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    podman unshare sh -c '
      set +e
      ROOT="$1"; LIB="$2"; PG_OLD="$3"; PG_NEW="$4"
      if [ -d "$PG_NEW" ] && [ ! -e "$PG_OLD" ]; then mv "$PG_NEW" "$PG_OLD"; fi
      if [ -d "$LIB" ]; then
        for n in chunks encoded hls original uploads userlogos; do
          if [ -e "$LIB/$n" ] && [ ! -e "$ROOT/$n" ]; then mv "$LIB/$n" "$ROOT/$n"; fi
        done
        rmdir "$LIB" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
    ' sh "$ROOT" "$LIB" "$PG_OLD" "$PG_NEW" || true
    systemctl --user daemon-reload || true
    systemctl --user start mediacms.service || true
  fi
  exit "$rc"
}
trap rollback ERR INT TERM

echo '=== reorganize persistent paths ==='
podman unshare sh -c '
  set -e
  ROOT="$1"; DBROOT="$2"; LIB="$3"; PG_OLD="$4"; PG_NEW="$5"; REDIS_NEW="$6"; REDIS_TMP="$7"

    if [ -e "$ROOT/$n" ]; then
      [ ! -e "$LIB/$n" ]
      mv "$ROOT/$n" "$LIB/$n"

  done
  [ -d "$PG_OLD" ]
  [ ! -e "$PG_NEW" ]
  mv "$PG_OLD" "$PG_NEW"

  chown -R 999:1000 "$REDIS_NEW"
  chmod 755 "$REDIS_NEW"
  chmod 600 "$REDIS_NEW/dump.rdb"
' sh "$ROOT" "$DBROOT" "$LIB" "$PG_OLD" "$PG_NEW" "$REDIS_NEW" "$REDIS_TMP"
rm -f "$REDIS_TMP"

echo '=== start consolidated stack ==='
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user start mediacms.service

for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  web=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 4 http://127.0.0.1:8001/ 2>/dev/null || true)
  pg=$(podman exec mediacms_db_1 pg_isready -U mediacms -d mediacms 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'accepting connections' || true)
  [ "$web" = 200 ] && [ "$pg" = 1 ] && break
  sleep 1
done
[ "$web" = 200 ]
[ "$pg" = 1 ]

echo '=== verify mounts ==='
podman inspect mediacms_db_1 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{println .Source "->" .Destination}}{{end}}' | grep -F '/datastore2/media_files/database/postgres -> /var/lib/postgresql/data'
podman inspect mediacms_redis_1 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{println .Source "->" .Destination}}{{end}}' | grep -F '/datastore2/media_files/database/redis -> /data'
podman inspect mediacms_web_1 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{println .Source "->" .Destination}}{{end}}' | grep -F '/datastore2/media_files/library -> /home/mediacms.io/mediacms/media_files'

echo '=== verify DB/media row ==='
podman exec mediacms_web_1 sh -lc 'cd /home/mediacms.io/mediacms && DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=cms.settings /home/mediacms.io/bin/python3 - <<"PY"
import django, os
django.setup()
from files.models import Media
m=Media.objects.get(friendly_token="tCqVBAg4h")
print("media_id="+str(m.id))
print("media_path="+m.media_file.path)
print("source_exists="+str(os.path.exists(m.media_file.path)))
assert os.path.exists(m.media_file.path)
PY'

echo '=== verify Redis and worker queues ==='
for q in celery short_tasks long_tasks; do printf '%s=' "$q"; podman exec mediacms_redis_1 redis-cli -n 1 LLEN "$q"; done
podman ps --filter name=mediacms_celery_short_1 --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}'
podman exec mediacms_celery_short_1 /home/mediacms.io/bin/celery -A cms inspect active_queues --timeout=5 2>/dev/null | grep -F short_tasks

public=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 https://www.xavi.app/media/)
echo "public_media_http=$public"
[ "$public" = 200 ]

echo '=== consolidated paths ==='
find "$ROOT" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 2 -type d -printf '%p\n' | sort

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import unquote

from fastapi import HTTPException

from .skill_library import SkillLibrary


CANONICAL_SKILL_SCHEME = "skills://"
LEGACY_SKILL_PREFIX = "xavi-runtime://skills/"


def skill_tool_manifest() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """MCP tools for progressive-disclosure skill discovery.

    Skill instructions remain read-only knowledge. Operational actions are exposed
    by their own bounded tool modules rather than embedded in a skill document.
    """
    return [
        {
            "name": "skills.list",
            "description": "List mounted agent skills as metadata only, optionally filtered by namespace.",
            "read_only": True,
            "input_schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {"namespace": {"type": ["string", "null"]}},
                "additionalProperties": False,
            },
        },
        {
            "name": "skills.read",
            "description": "Read one path-contained SKILL.md document after selecting it from skills.list.",
            "read_only": True,
            "input_schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "required": ["name"],
                "properties": {"name": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}},
                "additionalProperties": False,
            },
        },
        {
            "name": "skills.search",
            "description": "Search mounted agent skills and return digest-backed excerpts without loading every skill.",
            "read_only": True,
            "input_schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "required": ["query"],
                "properties": {
                    "query": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
                    "namespace": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
                    "limit": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 20, "default": 8},
                },
                "additionalProperties": False,
            },
        },
    ]


def _library(corpus_dir: Path) -> SkillLibrary:
    return SkillLibrary(corpus_dir / "skills")


def skill_resources(corpus_dir: Path | None) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    resources: list[dict[str, str]] = [
        {
            "uri": "skills://concretecms",
            "name": "Concrete CMS skill catalog",
            "description": "Metadata catalog for the mounted Concrete CMS Agent Skills collection.",
            "mimeType": "application/json",
        }
    ]
    if corpus_dir is None:
        return resources

    for item in _library(corpus_dir).list("concretecms").get("items", []):
        path = str(item.get("path") or "")
        parts = path.split("/")
        if len(parts) < 3:
            continue
        slug = parts[-2]
        resources.append(
            {
                "uri": f"skills://concretecms/{slug}/skill.md",
                "name": str(item.get("name") or slug),
                "description": str(item.get("description") or "Concrete CMS agent skill"),
                "mimeType": "text/markdown",
            }
        )
    return resources


async def call_skill_tool(corpus_dir: Path, tool: str, args: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    # Compatibility aliases existed briefly during the initial integration and
    # remain accepted, but only canonical skills.* tools are advertised.
    aliases = {
        "runtime.skills_list": "skills.list",
        "runtime.skills_read": "skills.read",
        "runtime.skills_search": "skills.search",
    }
    tool = aliases.get(tool, tool)
    library = _library(corpus_dir)

    if tool == "skills.list":
        return library.list(namespace=args.get("namespace"))
    if tool == "skills.read":
        try:
            return library.read(str(args.get("name", "")))
        except (ValueError, FileNotFoundError) as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404 if isinstance(exc, FileNotFoundError) else 422, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    if tool == "skills.search":
        try:
            return library.search(
                str(args.get("query", "")),
                limit=int(args.get("limit", 8)),
                namespace=args.get("namespace"),
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"unknown skill MCP tool: {tool}")


def _canonical_skill_name(uri: str) -> str | None:
    if uri == "skills://concretecms":
        return ""
    prefix = "skills://concretecms/"
    if uri.startswith(prefix):
        tail = unquote(uri[len(prefix) :]).strip("/")
        if tail.endswith("/skill.md"):
            tail = tail[: -len("/skill.md")]
        return f"concretecms/{tail}" if tail else ""

    if uri == "xavi-runtime://skills/concretecms":
        return ""
    legacy = "xavi-runtime://skills/concretecms/"
    if uri.startswith(legacy):
        return f"concretecms/{unquote(uri[len(legacy):]).strip('/')}"
    return None


async def read_skill_resource(corpus_dir: Path, uri: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    name = _canonical_skill_name(uri)
    if name is None:
        return None
    library = _library(corpus_dir)
    if name == "":
        return {"uri": uri, "mimeType": "application/json", "contents": library.list(namespace="concretecms")}
    try:
        item = library.read(name)
    except (ValueError, FileNotFoundError) as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404 if isinstance(exc, FileNotFoundError) else 422, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    return {
        "uri": uri,
        "mimeType": "text/markdown",
        "contents": item["content"],
        "metadata": {k: v for k, v in item.items() if k != "content"},
    }

# MCP Agent Skill Architecture

The runtime keeps **instructional skills** separate from **executable MCP tools**.

## Layout

```text
corpus/skills/
├── index.json
└── concretecms/
    ├── building-blocktypes/SKILL.md
    ├── building-packages/SKILL.md
    ├── security/SKILL.md
    └── ...
```

Each skill is a directory containing `SKILL.md` and optional `references/` files. Upstream commit and licence metadata are retained in `UPSTREAM.json`.

## Progressive disclosure

1. `skills.list` returns names, descriptions, paths, sizes and SHA-256 digests.
2. `skills.search` returns small matching excerpts.
3. `skills.read` or `resources/read` loads the selected full `SKILL.md`.
4. Operational changes use separate bounded tools such as `dev.concrete_block_scaffold`; skill text never grants write authority.

Canonical resource URIs use:

```text
skills://concretecms
skills://concretecms/building-blocktypes/skill.md
```

The former `runtime.skills_*` tool names and `xavi-runtime://skills/...` resource paths remain accepted as compatibility aliases but are not advertised.
MD

    if prompt:

    parts: list[str] = []
    for msg in messages:
        content = msg.content
        if isinstance(content, list):
            text_parts = []
            for item in content:
                if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "text":

        if content_text:

    return "\n".join(parts).strip()


def _openai_chat_response(req: ChatCompletionRequest, provider_result: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    import time

    content = provider_result.get("response_text") or ""
    reasoning = provider_result.get("reasoning_text") or ""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


REASONING_KEYS = (
    "thinking",
    "reasoning",
    "reasoning_content",
    "reasoningContent",
    "thought",
    "thoughts",
)

CONTENT_KEYS = (
    "response",
    "content",
    "text",
    "message",
    "output_text",
)

TOOL_KEYS = (
    "tool_calls",
    "toolCalls",
    "function_call",
    "functionCall",
)


def _stringify(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key in CONTENT_KEYS:
            if key in value and isinstance(value[key], str):
                return value[key]
        return ""
    return str(value)


def extract_model_response(raw: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Normalize provider-specific response/thinking/tool fields.

    Ollama Qwen3 can return visible text in `response` and hidden reasoning in
    `thinking`. OpenAI-style reasoning servers may use `reasoning_content` or
    nested message fields. This function produces one stable contract for the
    runtime/API and UI adapters.
    """
    data = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
    visible = ""
    reasoning = ""
    tool_calls: list[Any] = []
    native_fields: dict[str, Any] = {}

    # Ollama generate response shape.
    for key in CONTENT_KEYS:
        if key in data and isinstance(data[key], str):
            visible = data[key]
            native_fields[key] = data[key]
            break

    for key in REASONING_KEYS:
        if key in data and data[key]:
            reasoning = _stringify(data[key])
            native_fields[key] = data[key]
            break

    for key in TOOL_KEYS:
        if key in data and data[key]:
            value = data[key]
            tool_calls = value if isinstance(value, list) else [value]
            native_fields[key] = value
            break

    # OpenAI-compatible chat/completions shape.
    choices = data.get("choices") if isinstance(data, dict) else None
    if isinstance(choices, list) and choices:
        msg = choices[0].get("message", {}) if isinstance(choices[0], dict) else {}
        if isinstance(msg, dict):
            if not visible:
                visible = _stringify(msg.get("content"))
            for key in REASONING_KEYS:
                if key in msg and msg[key]:
                    reasoning = _stringify(msg[key])
                    native_fields[f"message.{key}"] = msg[key]
                    break
            for key in TOOL_KEYS:
                if key in msg and msg[key]:
                    value = msg[key]
                    tool_calls = value if isinstance(value, list) else [value]
                    native_fields[f"message.{key}"] = value
                    break

    has_reasoning = bool(reasoning.strip())
    has_visible = bool(visible.strip())
    return {
        "response_text": visible or "",
        "reasoning_text": reasoning or "",
        "tool_calls": tool_calls,
        "capabilities_observed": {
            "has_visible_response": has_visible,
            "has_reasoning": has_reasoning,
            "has_tool_calls": bool(tool_calls),
            "reasoning_only": has_reasoning and not has_visible,
        },
        "native_fields": native_fields,
    }

argv:
set -euo pipefail
OLD_ROOT=/datastore2/srnn_server
NEW_ROOT=/datastore2/xavi/db/srnn_server
# Confirm the previous copy is inactive and the destination placeholder is empty.
if ps -eo args | grep -Eq '[r]sync .*srnn_server/db'; then
  echo 'An SRNN rsync is still active; refusing relocation.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
test -d "$OLD_ROOT/db.staging"
test -f "$OLD_ROOT/.db-preseed-in-progress"
if [ -d "$NEW_ROOT" ]; then
  test -z "$(find "$NEW_ROOT" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)"
  rmdir "$NEW_ROOT"
fi
mv "$OLD_ROOT" "$NEW_ROOT"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/datastore2/xavi/db/srnn_server')
marker=root/'.db-preseed-in-progress'
if marker.exists():
    text=marker.read_text()
    text=text.replace('/datastore2/srnn_server/db.staging','/datastore2/xavi/db/srnn_server/db.staging')
    marker.write_text(text)
PY

cat > bin/preseed-srnn-db-migration <<'SCRIPT'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

SRC=/var/www/xavi/srnn_server/db
ROOT=/datastore2/xavi/db/srnn_server
STAGE=$ROOT/db.staging
ACTIVE=$ROOT/.db-preseed-in-progress
COMPLETE=$ROOT/.db-preseed-complete
LOCK=${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/xavi-srnn-preseed.lock

[ "$(id -un)" = tbi ] || { echo 'Run as tbi without sudo.' >&2; exit 1; }
[ -d "$SRC" ] || { echo "Missing source: $SRC" >&2; exit 1; }
[ ! -L "$SRC" ] || { echo 'Source is already a symlink; migration may already be complete.' >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$(findmnt -no TARGET /datastore2)" = /datastore2 ] || { echo '/datastore2 is not mounted.' >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$(stat -c %d "$SRC")" != "$(stat -c %d /datastore2)" ] || { echo 'Source and target unexpectedly share a filesystem.' >&2; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$ROOT" "$STAGE" "$(dirname "$LOCK")"
chmod 0750 "$ROOT" "$STAGE"
exec 9>"$LOCK"
flock -n 9 || { echo 'Another SRNN preseed is active.' >&2; exit 1; }
rm -f "$COMPLETE"
printf '%s\n' \
  "started=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" \
  "source=$SRC" \
  "stage=$STAGE" \
  "pid=$$" > "$ACTIVE"
cleanup() {
  status=$?
  if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    printf 'failed=%s status=%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$status" >> "$ACTIVE" || true
  fi
  exit "$status"
}
trap cleanup ERR INT TERM

rsync \
  --recursive \
  --links \
  --perms \
  --times \
  --hard-links \
  --sparse \
  --no-owner \
  --no-group \
  --delete-delay \
  --partial \
  --human-readable \
  --info=progress2,stats2 \
  --exclude='/etcd_data/member/***' \
  "$SRC/" "$STAGE/"

touch "$COMPLETE"
rm -f "$ACTIVE"
trap - ERR INT TERM
printf '\n== SRNN preseed complete ==\n'
du -sh "$STAGE" 2>/dev/null || true
df -h / /datastore2
printf 'protected_source=%s\n' "$SRC/etcd_data/member"
printf 'protected_target_present='; if [ -e "$STAGE/etcd_data/member" ]; then echo yes; else echo no; fi
SCRIPT
chmod 0755 bin/preseed-srnn-db-migration

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('bin/finalize-srnn-db-migration')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('DATASTORE_ROOT=/datastore2/srnn_server','DATASTORE_ROOT=/datastore2/xavi/db/srnn_server')
s=s.replace('REPORT_DIR=/var/www/xavi/xavi-stack-manager/data/migrations','REPORT_DIR=/datastore2/xavi/data/xavi-stack-manager/migrations')
p.write_text(s)
PY
chmod 0755 bin/finalize-srnn-db-migration
(
  cd bin
  sha256sum preseed-srnn-db-migration > preseed-srnn-db-migration.sha256
  sha256sum finalize-srnn-db-migration > finalize-srnn-db-migration.sha256
)
bash -n bin/preseed-srnn-db-migration
bash -n bin/finalize-srnn-db-migration
(cd bin && sha256sum -c preseed-srnn-db-migration.sha256 && sha256sum -c finalize-srnn-db-migration.sha256)

cat > docs/SRNN_STORAGE_MIGRATION.md <<'EOF'
# SRNN database migration to datastore2

The governed target is `/datastore2/xavi/db/srnn_server/db`. The compatibility path remains `/var/www/xavi/srnn_server/db` and becomes a symlink only after final verification.

## Online preseed

Run as `tbi`, without sudo:

```bash
/var/www/xavi/xavi-stack-manager/bin/preseed-srnn-db-migration
```

The preseed is resumable. It copies all readable content while excluding only `etcd_data/member`, which requires the privileged final sync. Completion is represented by `.db-preseed-complete`; `.db-preseed-in-progress` is retained on failure.

## Final cutover

Stop or quiesce every process using `/var/www/xavi/srnn_server/db`, then run:

```bash
sudo /var/www/xavi/xavi-stack-manager/bin/finalize-srnn-db-migration
```

The finalizer refuses active process references or rootless container mounts, performs a privileged final rsync, compares complete metadata inventories, hashes critical databases/indexes, runs SQLite quick checks, performs an atomic source-to-symlink cutover, and rolls back automatically if cutover fails. After all verification passes it removes the old root-filesystem tree to reclaim space and writes a migration report under `/datastore2/xavi/data/xavi-stack-manager/migrations`.
EOF

# Existing routing documentation contains no token values and is suitable for source control.
git add bin/preseed-srnn-db-migration bin/preseed-srnn-db-migration.sha256 \
  bin/finalize-srnn-db-migration bin/finalize-srnn-db-migration.sha256 \
  docs/SRNN_STORAGE_MIGRATION.md docs/MCP_ROUTING.md
if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
  git commit -m 'Add governed SRNN datastore migration tooling'
fi
git push datastore-mirror main
printf '== relocated state ==\n'
stat -c '%A %U:%G %a dev=%d %n' "$NEW_ROOT" "$NEW_ROOT/db.staging" "$NEW_ROOT/.db-preseed-in-progress"
cat "$NEW_ROOT/.db-preseed-in-progress"
printf 'commit=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'mirror=%s\n' "$(git --git-dir=/datastore2/xavi/data/git/xavi-stack-manager.git rev-parse refs/heads/main)"
git status --short

from pathlib import Path

    p=root/f'searxng-docker-{port}'/'docker-compose.yaml'
    lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
    out=[]
    replaced=0
    for line in lines:
        # Each node has exactly one SearXNG host-port mapping to container 8080.
        if ':8080' in line and line.lstrip().startswith('-'):
            out.append(f'      - "127.0.0.1:{port}:8080"')
            replaced += 1
        else:
            out.append(line)
    if replaced != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f'{p}: expected exactly one :8080 mapping, got {replaced}')
    p.write_text('\n'.join(out)+'\n')

# Remove the old non-idempotent sed rewrite; compose files are normalized above.

PY

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
ROOT=/var/www/xavi/searxng
LOG="$HOME/.local/state/xavi/searxng-guardian.log"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOG")"

log(){ printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -Is)" "$*" >>"$LOG"; }
http_ok(){ curl -fsS --max-time 3 "http://127.0.0.1:$1/" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
port_open(){ ss -ltnH "sport = :$1" 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; }

repair_node(){
  port="$1"; d="$ROOT/searxng-docker-$port"; r="redis$port"; c="searxng$port"
  rstate=$(podman inspect "$r" --format '{{.State.Status}}' 2>/dev/null || true)
  cstate=$(podman inspect "$c" --format '{{.State.Status}}' 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ "$rstate" != running ]; then podman start "$r" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
  if [ "$cstate" != running ]; then podman start "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
  if http_ok "$port"; then return 0; fi
  log "repair node=$port rstate=$rstate cstate=$cstate"
  timeout -k 2 15 podman rm -f "$c" "$r" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  (cd "$d" && timeout -k 5 45 podman-compose -f docker-compose.yaml up -d) >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || true
}

repair_vpn(){
  failed=0
  for p in 8480 8481 8482 8483; do port_open "$p" || failed=1; done
  [ "$failed" = 0 ] && return 0
  log 'repair vpn/proxy compose'
  (cd "$ROOT/vpn-proxies" && timeout -k 5 60 podman-compose -f docker-compose.yaml up -d) >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || true
}

log 'guardian started'
while true; do
  repair_vpn
  for port in $(seq 8885 8904); do repair_node "$port"; done
  sleep 15
done
SCRIPT

[Unit]
Description=Xavi SearXNG VPN proxy and search fleet always-on guardian

Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/var/www/xavi/searxng/bin/searxng-always-on-guardian.sh
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
KillMode=process
TimeoutStopSec=10
Nice=5

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
UNIT

systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user disable xavi-searxng-fleet.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
systemctl --user enable --now xavi-searxng-guardian.service

for n in $(seq 1 30); do
  good=0
  for p in $(seq 8885 8904); do http_ok=0; curl -fsS --max-time 2 "http://127.0.0.1:$p/" >/dev/null 2>&1 && http_ok=1; good=$((good+http_ok)); done

systemctl --user show xavi-searxng-guardian.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p MainPID

good=0
for p in $(seq 8885 8904); do code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:$p/" 2>/dev/null || true); echo "$p=$code"; [ "$code" = 200 ] && good=$((good+1)); done

  restore_units || true
  exit "$status"

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import threading
from typing import Any, Callable

import urwid

from .backend import XaviBackend

PALETTE = [
    ("desktop", "light gray", "dark cyan"),
    ("desktop_focus", "white,bold", "dark cyan"),
    ("menu", "black", "light gray"),
    ("menu_focus", "white,bold", "dark blue"),
    ("title", "white,bold", "dark blue"),
    ("window", "black", "light gray"),
    ("button", "black", "light gray"),
    ("button_focus", "white,bold", "dark blue"),
    ("status", "black", "light gray"),
    ("ok", "dark green,bold", "light gray"),
    ("error", "dark red,bold", "light gray"),
    ("dim", "dark gray", "light gray"),
]


class ItemButton(urwid.Button):
    def __init__(self, label: str, item: dict[str, Any], callback: Callable[..., None]) -> None:
        self.item = item
        super().__init__(label, on_press=callback, user_data=item)


class XaviManTUI:
    def __init__(self, backend: XaviBackend) -> None:
        self.backend = backend
        self.overlay: urwid.Widget | None = None
        self.overlay_kind: str | None = None
        self._window_title: str | None = None
        self._window_size: tuple[Any, Any] = (("relative", 88), ("relative", 82))
        self._maximized = False
        self._active_listbox: urwid.ListBox | None = None

        self.status = urwid.Text("Ready")
        self.summary = urwid.Text("Backend state will load after the desktop opens.")
        self.minimized_bar = urwid.Columns([], dividechars=1)
        self._minimized: list[tuple[str, Callable[..., None]]] = []

        self._last_state: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        self._refresh_thread: threading.Thread | None = None
        self._refresh_result: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        self._refresh_error: str | None = None
        self._refresh_lock = threading.Lock()
        self._pending_open: Callable[..., None] | None = None

        self._aux_thread: threading.Thread | None = None
        self._aux_result: Any = None
        self._aux_error: str | None = None
        self._aux_title: str | None = None
        self._aux_lock = threading.Lock()

        self.desktop = self._build_desktop()
        self.loop = urwid.MainLoop(self.desktop, PALETTE, unhandled_input=self._key)

    def _classic_button(self, label: str, callback: Callable[..., None]) -> urwid.Widget:
        return urwid.AttrMap(urwid.Button(label, on_press=callback), "button", "button_focus")

    def _build_desktop(self) -> urwid.Widget:
        title = urwid.AttrMap(urwid.Text(" Xavi Manager ", align="center"), "title")
        menu = urwid.Columns([
            (10, urwid.AttrMap(urwid.Button(" File ", on_press=lambda _b: self._file_menu()), "menu", "menu_focus")),
            (12, urwid.AttrMap(urwid.Button(" Options ", on_press=lambda _b: self._options_menu()), "menu", "menu_focus")),
            (11, urwid.AttrMap(urwid.Button(" Window ", on_press=lambda _b: self._window_menu()), "menu", "menu_focus")),
            (10, urwid.AttrMap(urwid.Button(" Help ", on_press=lambda _b: self._help()), "menu", "menu_focus")),
            urwid.AttrMap(urwid.Text(""), "menu"),
        ], dividechars=0)

        apps = [
            ("▣ Overview", self._overview),
            ("▤ Containers", self._containers),
            ("⚙ Services", self._services),
            ("▦ Projects", self._projects),
            ("⇄ Remote Nodes", self._remote),
            ("▥ Storage", self._storage),
            ("✓ Doctor", self._doctor),
            ("◇ Resources", self._resources),
            ("◎ AI Advisor", self._advisor),
            ("? Help", self._help),
        ]
        icons = [self._classic_button(label, callback) for label, callback in apps]
        grid = urwid.GridFlow(icons, cell_width=22, h_sep=3, v_sep=1, align="left")
        desktop_body = urwid.Filler(urwid.Padding(grid, left=2, right=2), valign="top", top=2)
        footer = urwid.Pile([
            ("pack", self.minimized_bar),
            ("pack", urwid.Divider("─")),
            ("pack", urwid.Columns([(4, urwid.Text("F1")), urwid.Text("Help   F5 Refresh   Enter Open   Esc Close   Alt+Tab Restore   Q Quit")])),
            ("pack", urwid.AttrMap(self.summary, "status")),
            ("pack", urwid.AttrMap(self.status, "status")),
        ])
        return urwid.Frame(
            urwid.AttrMap(desktop_body, "desktop"),
            header=urwid.Pile([("pack", title), ("pack", urwid.AttrMap(menu, "menu"))]),
            footer=footer,
        )

    def _file_menu(self) -> None:
        body = urwid.Filler(urwid.Pile([
            ("pack", self._classic_button(" Refresh backend ", lambda _b: self._refresh_summary())),
            ("pack", self._classic_button(" Close active window ", lambda _b: self._close())),
            ("pack", self._classic_button(" Exit Xavi Manager ", lambda _b: (_ for _ in ()).throw(urwid.ExitMainLoop()))),
        ]), valign="top")
        self._show_window("File", body, width=42, height=12)

    def _options_menu(self) -> None:
        self._show_window(
            "Options",
            urwid.Filler(urwid.Text("Backend discovery runs after the desktop opens and never blocks the UI.\n\nF5 requests a fresh background pool."), valign="top"),
            width=56,
            height=12,
        )

    def _window_menu(self) -> None:
        labels = [name for name, _cb in self._minimized]
        text = "No minimized windows." if not labels else "Minimized windows:\n\n" + "\n".join(f"  {name}" for name in labels) + "\n\nAlt+Tab restores the next one."
        self._show_window("Window", urwid.Filler(urwid.Text(text), valign="top"), width=52, height=14)

    def _refresh_summary(self) -> None:
        self._start_background_refresh()

    def _start_background_refresh(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        if self._refresh_thread is not None and self._refresh_thread.is_alive():
            return
        self.status.set_text("Pooling backend state in background…")
        self.summary.set_text("Loading containers, services, projects and health…")
        with self._refresh_lock:
            self._refresh_result = None
            self._refresh_error = None

        def worker() -> None:
            try:
                result = self.backend.state(max_age=0)
                with self._refresh_lock:
                    self._refresh_result = result
            except Exception as exc:
                with self._refresh_lock:
                    self._refresh_error = str(exc)

        self._refresh_thread = threading.Thread(target=worker, name="xavi-man-state-pool", daemon=True)
        self._refresh_thread.start()
        self.loop.set_alarm_in(0.10, self._collect_background_refresh)

    def _collect_background_refresh(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        thread = self._refresh_thread
        if thread is not None and thread.is_alive():
            self.loop.set_alarm_in(0.15, self._collect_background_refresh)
            return
        with self._refresh_lock:
            state = self._refresh_result
            error = self._refresh_error
            self._refresh_result = None
            self._refresh_error = None
        if error:
            self.status.set_text("Background refresh failed")
            self.summary.set_text(f"Status refresh failed: {error}")
            return
        if state is None:
            self.status.set_text("Ready")
            return
        self._last_state = state
        doctor = state.get("doctor", {}) or {}
        self.summary.set_text(
            f"Containers {len(state.get('containers', []))}   Services {len(state.get('services', []))}   "
            f"Projects {len(state.get('projects', []))}   Doctor {'PASS' if doctor.get('ok') else 'ATTENTION'}   "
            f"Issues {doctor.get('issue_count', 0)}"
        )
        self.status.set_text("Ready — backend state pooled")
        callback = self._pending_open
        self._pending_open = None
        if callback is not None:
            callback()

    def _show_window(
        self,
        title: str,
        body: urwid.Widget,
        *,
        width: int | tuple[str, int] = ("relative", 88),
        height: int | tuple[str, int] = ("relative", 82),
        kind: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._window_title = title
        self.overlay_kind = kind
        self._window_size = (width, height)
        self._active_listbox = None if kind is None else self._active_listbox

        min_button = self._classic_button(" − ", lambda _b: self._minimize_current())
        max_button = self._classic_button(" □ ", lambda _b: self._toggle_maximize())
        title_text = urwid.AttrMap(urwid.Text(f" {title} ", align="center"), "title")
        titlebar = urwid.Columns([(5, min_button), ("weight", 1, title_text), (5, max_button)], dividechars=0)
        command_bar = urwid.Columns([
            (14, self._classic_button(" Close ", lambda _b: self._close())),
            urwid.Text(""),
        ])
        chrome_body = urwid.Pile([
            ("pack", titlebar),
            ("weight", 1, body),
            ("pack", urwid.Divider()),
            ("pack", command_bar),
        ])
        chrome = urwid.LineBox(chrome_body, title="", tlcorner="┌", trcorner="┐", blcorner="└", brcorner="┘", lline="│", rline="│", tline="─", bline="─")
        top = urwid.AttrMap(chrome, "window")
        self.overlay = urwid.Overlay(top, self.desktop, align="center", valign="middle", width=width, height=height)
        self.loop.widget = self.overlay

    def _toggle_maximize(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.overlay, urwid.Overlay):
            return
        top = self.overlay.top_w
        if self._maximized:
            width, height = self._window_size
            self._maximized = False
        else:
            width, height = ("relative", 98), ("relative", 96)
            self._maximized = True
        self.overlay = urwid.Overlay(top, self.desktop, align="center", valign="middle", width=width, height=height)
        self.loop.widget = self.overlay

    def _minimize_current(self) -> None:
        if self.overlay is None:
            return
        title = self._window_title or "Window"
        callback = self._callback_for_title(title)
        if callback is not None and all(existing[0] != title for existing in self._minimized):
            self._minimized.append((title, callback))
            self._rebuild_minimized_bar()
        self._close()
        self.status.set_text(f"Minimized: {title}")

    def _callback_for_title(self, title: str) -> Callable[..., None] | None:
        return {
            "Overview": self._overview,
            "Containers": self._containers,
            "Services": self._services,
            "Projects": self._projects,
            "Remote Nodes": self._remote,
            "Filesystems": self._storage,
            "Doctor": self._doctor,
            "WG-RNN Resource Pool": self._resources,
            "AI Advisor": self._advisor,
            "About Xavi Manager": self._help,
        }.get(title)

    def _rebuild_minimized_bar(self) -> None:
        widgets: list[Any] = []
        for title, callback in self._minimized:
            label = f"[{title}]"
            widgets.append((min(max(len(label) + 2, 10), 22), self._classic_button(label, lambda _b, t=title, cb=callback: self._restore_minimized(t, cb))))
        self.minimized_bar.contents[:] = [(widget, self.minimized_bar.options(width_type="given", width_amount=width)) for width, widget in widgets]
        if not widgets:
            self.minimized_bar.contents[:] = []

    def _restore_minimized(self, title: str, callback: Callable[..., None]) -> None:
        self._minimized = [(name, cb) for name, cb in self._minimized if name != title]
        self._rebuild_minimized_bar()
        callback()

    def _restore_next_minimized(self) -> None:
        if not self._minimized:
            return
        title, callback = self._minimized[0]
        self._restore_minimized(title, callback)

    def _close(self) -> None:
        self.overlay = None
        self.overlay_kind = None
        self._window_title = None
        self._maximized = False
        self._active_listbox = None
        self.loop.widget = self.desktop

    def _pooled_state(self, callback: Callable[..., None], title: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if self._last_state is not None:
            return self._last_state
        self._pending_open = callback
        self._loading_window(title)
        self._start_background_refresh()
        return None

    def _loading_window(self, title: str) -> None:
        text = "Backend information is still being pooled.\n\nThe desktop remains usable while it loads.\nPress F5 to request another background refresh."
        self._show_window(title, urwid.Filler(urwid.Text(text), valign="top"), width=("relative", 70), height=14)

    def _json_window(self, title: str, payload: Any) -> None:
        text = json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str)
        walker = urwid.SimpleFocusListWalker([urwid.Text(line) for line in text.splitlines()] or [urwid.Text("No data")])
        self._show_window(title, urwid.ListBox(walker))

    def _overview(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        state = self._pooled_state(self._overview, "Overview")
        if state is None:
            return
        doctor = state.get("doctor", {}) or {}
        identity = state.get("identity", {}) or {}
        lines: list[Any] = [
            ("title", "XAVI CONTROL PANEL"),
            "",
            f"User: {identity.get('user', '-')}",
            f"Rootless: {identity.get('rootless', '-')}",
            f"Podman graph: {identity.get('graph_root', '-')}",
            "",
            f"Containers: {len(state.get('containers', []))}",
            f"Services: {len(state.get('services', []))}",
            f"Projects: {len(state.get('projects', []))}",
            f"Remote nodes: {len(state.get('remote_nodes', []))}",
            "",
            ("ok" if doctor.get("ok") else "error", f"Doctor: {'PASS' if doctor.get('ok') else 'ATTENTION'}"),
            f"Issues: {doctor.get('issue_count', 0)}   Warnings: {doctor.get('warning_count', 0)}",
        ]
        self._show_window("Overview", urwid.Filler(urwid.Text(lines), valign="top"), width=("relative", 72), height=24)

    def _list_window(self, title: str, rows: list[dict[str, Any]], kind: str, formatter: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], str]) -> None:
        buttons: list[urwid.Widget] = []
        for row in rows:
            button = ItemButton(formatter(row), row, lambda _b, item: self._json_window(title + " Details", item))
            buttons.append(urwid.AttrMap(button, "button", "button_focus"))
        if not buttons:
            buttons.append(urwid.Text("No entries"))
        listbox = urwid.ListBox(urwid.SimpleFocusListWalker(buttons))
        self._active_listbox = listbox
        legend = urwid.Text("Enter details   S start   O stop   R restart   Esc close")
        body = urwid.Pile([("weight", 1, listbox), ("pack", urwid.Divider()), ("pack", legend)])
        self._show_window(title, body, kind=kind)
        self._active_listbox = listbox

    def _containers(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        state = self._pooled_state(self._containers, "Containers")
        if state is None:
            return
        def fmt(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
            details = row.get("details", {}) or {}
            return f"{row.get('name','-'):<36} {details.get('state') or row.get('state') or 'unknown':<10} health={details.get('health') or '-'}"
        self._list_window("Containers", state.get("containers", []), "container", fmt)

    def _services(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        state = self._pooled_state(self._services, "Services")
        if state is None:
            return
        self._list_window("Services", state.get("services", []), "service", lambda r: f"{r.get('scope','-'):<6} {r.get('name','-'):<44} {r.get('active','-')}/{r.get('sub','-')}")

    def _projects(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        state = self._pooled_state(self._projects, "Projects")
        if state is None:
            return
        self._list_window("Projects", state.get("projects", []), "project", lambda r: f"{r.get('id') or r.get('name') or '-':<38} {r.get('state') or r.get('status') or '-'}")

    def _remote(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        state = self._pooled_state(self._remote, "Remote Nodes")
        if state is not None:
            self._json_window("Remote Nodes", state.get("remote_nodes", []))

    def _storage(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        state = self._pooled_state(self._storage, "Filesystems")
        if state is not None:
            self._json_window("Filesystems", state.get("filesystems", []))

    def _doctor(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        state = self._pooled_state(self._doctor, "Doctor")
        if state is not None:
            self._json_window("Doctor", state.get("doctor", {}))

    def _async_payload_window(self, title: str, loader: Callable[[], Any]) -> None:
        if self._aux_thread is not None and self._aux_thread.is_alive():
            self.status.set_text("Another background request is already running")
            return
        self._aux_title = title
        with self._aux_lock:
            self._aux_result = None
            self._aux_error = None
        self._show_window(title, urwid.Filler(urwid.Text("Loading in background…"), valign="top"), width=("relative", 76), height=14)

        def worker() -> None:
            try:
                result = loader()
                with self._aux_lock:
                    self._aux_result = result
            except Exception as exc:
                with self._aux_lock:
                    self._aux_error = str(exc)

        self._aux_thread = threading.Thread(target=worker, name="xavi-man-window-load", daemon=True)
        self._aux_thread.start()
        self.loop.set_alarm_in(0.10, self._collect_aux_window)

    def _collect_aux_window(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        if self._aux_thread is not None and self._aux_thread.is_alive():
            self.loop.set_alarm_in(0.15, self._collect_aux_window)
            return
        with self._aux_lock:
            payload = self._aux_result
            error = self._aux_error
            self._aux_result = None
            self._aux_error = None
        title = self._aux_title or "Result"
        if error:
            self._json_window(title, {"error": error})
        else:
            self._json_window(title, payload)

    def _resources(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        self._async_payload_window("WG-RNN Resource Pool", self.backend.resources)

    def _advisor(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        self._async_payload_window("AI Advisor", self.backend.advisor_status)

    def _help(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        text = (
            "Xavi Manager\n\n"
            "A classic graphical operations shell for the Xavi backend.\n\n"
            "Backend information is pooled only after the desktop is visible.\n"
            "Closing or opening state windows does not trigger synchronous scans.\n\n"
            "F5 refreshes in the background.  Alt+Tab restores minimized windows.\n"
            "All mutations use the existing allowlisted StackManager control plane.\n\n"
            "Web console: https://xavi.app/xavi-man/"
        )
        self._show_window("About Xavi Manager", urwid.Filler(urwid.Text(text), valign="top"), width=("relative", 70), height=20)

    def _focused_item(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if self._active_listbox is None:
            return None
        focus = self._active_listbox.focus
        if focus is None:
            return None
        widget, _position = focus
        if isinstance(widget, urwid.AttrMap):
            widget = widget.original_widget
        return widget.item if isinstance(widget, ItemButton) else None

    def _preview_action(self, verb: str) -> None:
        item = self._focused_item()
        if item is None or not self.overlay_kind:
            self.status.set_text("Select an item first")
            return
        target = str(item.get("name") or item.get("id") or "")
        if self.overlay_kind == "remote-container":
            target = str(item.get("target") or target)
        if not target:
            self.status.set_text("Selected item has no manageable target")
            return
        kind = self.overlay_kind
        self._async_payload_window(
            f"Preview {verb}: {target}",
            lambda: self.backend.action(kind=kind, verb=verb, target=target, apply=False),
        )
        self.status.set_text("Preview requested in background; no change applied")

    def _key(self, key: str) -> None:
        if key in {"q", "Q"} and self.overlay is None:
            raise urwid.ExitMainLoop()
        if key == "f1":
            self._help()
        elif key == "f5":
            self.backend.invalidate()
            self._refresh_summary()
        elif key in {"meta tab", "alt tab"}:
            self._restore_next_minimized()
        elif key == "esc" and self.overlay is not None:
            self._close()
        elif self.overlay_kind and key in {"s", "S", "o", "O", "r", "R"}:
            verb = {"s": "start", "o": "stop", "r": "restart"}[key.lower()]
            self._preview_action(verb)

    def run(self) -> None:
        # Draw the shell first. Discovery begins only once Urwid is alive.
        self.loop.set_alarm_in(0.05, self._start_background_refresh)
        self.loop.run()

    req=urllib.request.Request(url,data=body,headers={'content-type':'application/json','x-xavi-mcp-key':key,'x-xavi-session-id':session,'x-xavi-agent-id':agent,'x-xavi-device-id':'chatgpt-connector'},method='POST')

def sc(resp):return resp.get('result',{}).get('structuredContent',{})
listing=sc(rpc('session.list',{'project_key':'xavi.app-backend','active_within_seconds':7200,'limit':100}))
rows=listing.get('sessions') or listing.get('active_sessions') or []
notice=os.environ['XAVI_NOTICE']; subject=os.environ.get('XAVI_SUBJECT') or 'MCP peer notice'
sent=[]
for row in rows:
    target=str(row.get('session_id') or '')
    if not target or target==session or target.startswith('wgrnn:'):continue
    resp=sc(rpc('session.send_message',{'recipient_session_id':target,'message_type':'system','subject':subject,'body':notice,'project_key':'xavi.app-backend'}))
    sent.append({'session_id':target,'message_id':resp.get('message_id') or (resp.get('message') or {}).get('message_id')})

argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/xavi-geo-search/v2
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,hmac,json,time,urllib.request,urllib.error
from pathlib import Path

base='http://10.89.26.1:18091'
env={}
for line in Path('.secrets/fusion-sidecar-0.5.env').read_text().splitlines():
    if '=' in line:
        k,v=line.split('=',1); env[k]=v
secret=env['XAVI_FUSION_SHARED_SECRET'].encode()
actor='ops-bootstrap'

def call(method,path,payload=None):
    body=b'' if payload is None else json.dumps(payload,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    ts=str(int(time.time()))
    canonical='\n'.join([method,path,ts,actor,hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()]).encode()
    sig=hmac.new(secret,canonical,hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    headers={'Accept':'application/json','X-Xavi-User':actor,'X-Xavi-Timestamp':ts,'X-Xavi-Signature':sig}
    if payload is not None: headers['Content-Type']='application/json'
    req=urllib.request.Request(base+path,data=body if payload is not None else None,method=method,headers=headers)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=120) as r: return json.load(r)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        text=e.read().decode(errors='replace')
        raise RuntimeError(f'{method} {path}: HTTP {e.code}: {text}')

project_specs=[
 ('MISSING-PERSONS-CANADA','Missing Persons Canada','missing_person','Canadian missing-person records, source images, case metadata and provenance.'),
 ('WEATHER-CANADA','Canadian Weather Context','environmental_analysis','Weather observations and catalogues for temporal-spatial reconstruction.'),
 ('ENVIRONMENTAL-CONTEXT','Environmental and Terrain Context','geospatial_catalogue','OSM, terrain, elevation, municipal GIS and environmental context.'),
 ('MAPPING-CATALOGUE','Mapping and Spatial Reference','geospatial_catalogue','Reusable mapping and spatial reference datasets.'),
 ('ASTRONOMY-CONTEXT','Astronomical and Illumination Context','scientific_research','Moon, ephemeris and illumination context for time-specific analysis.'),
]
existing={p['project_code'].lower():p for p in call('GET','/internal/v1/projects')['items']}
projects={}
for code,title,kind,description in project_specs:
    row=existing.get(code.lower())
    if not row:
        row=call('POST','/internal/v1/projects',{
          'project_code':code,'title':title,'description':description,
          'project_type':kind,'status':'active','access':'restricted',
          'configuration':{'blueprint':kind,'created_by':'fusion-0.5-bootstrap'}
        })
    projects[code]=row

specs=[
 ('missing-persons-canada','Canadian Missing Persons','MISSING-PERSONS-CANADA','sqlite-crawler','query-in-place','RCMP and other Canadian missing-person source records and images.'),
 ('weather-canada','Canadian Weather Archive','WEATHER-CANADA','weather-catalog','query-in-place','Weather catalogues and observations for temporal-spatial analysis.'),
 ('Enviromental Profile','Environmental Profile','ENVIRONMENTAL-CONTEXT','geospatial-filesystem','query-in-place','Environmental, OSM, terrain, municipal and infrastructure datasets.'),
 ('mapping','Mapping Catalogue','MAPPING-CATALOGUE','geospatial-filesystem','query-in-place','Reusable mapping datasets and reference layers.'),
 ('moon','Moon and Ephemeris','ASTRONOMY-CONTEXT','ephemeris','query-in-place','Ephemeris and regional moon/illumination analysis data.'),
]
registered=[]
for root,title,project_code,connector,mode,description in specs:
    handle=root.lower().replace(' ','-')
    row=call('POST','/internal/v1/datasets',{
      'project_id':projects[project_code]['project_id'],
      'handle':handle,'title':title,'description':description,'root_path':root,
      'connector_type':connector,'storage_mode':mode,'access':'restricted',
      'configuration':{'canonical':True,'exclude':['backups','updates','logs','__pycache__']}
    })
    registered.append(row)

scan_ids=[]
for row in registered:
    mode='assets' if row['root_path']=='missing-persons-canada' else 'summary'
    result=call('POST',f"/internal/v1/datasets/{row['dataset_id']}/scan",{'mode':mode,'paths':[]})
    scan_ids.append((row['title'],str(result['scan_id'])))

missing=next(row for row in registered if row['root_path']=='missing-persons-canada')
profile=call('POST',f"/internal/v1/datasets/{missing['dataset_id']}/profile",{
  'relative_path':'missing_persons.db','sample_size':5
})
print('projects=' + str(len(projects)))
print('datasets=' + str(len(registered)))
print('scans=' + ','.join(f'{title}:{scan}' for title,scan in scan_ids))
print('missing_persons_table=' + str(profile.get('selected_table')))
print('missing_persons_rows=' + str(profile.get('row_count')))
print('missing_persons_columns=' + str(len(profile.get('columns',[]))))
Path('/tmp/fusion-seed-scans.json').write_text(json.dumps(scan_ids))
PY

from xavi_stack.textual_tui import XaviStackApp
from xavi_stack.core import StackManager
from xavi_stack.cli import DEFAULT_CONFIG
from xavi_stack.ml import CPUAdvisor

async def main():
    app=XaviStackApp(StackManager(DEFAULT_CONFIG), CPUAdvisor())
    async with app.run_test(size=(150,48)) as pilot:
        # on_mount does the real inventory + doctor probes concurrently
        for _ in range(90):
            await pilot.pause(0.5)
            if app.inventory and not app.refreshing:
                break
        assert app.inventory, 'live inventory did not load'
        print('containers', len(app.inventory.get('containers', [])))
        print('services', len(app.inventory.get('services', [])))
        print('projects', len(app.inventory.get('projects', [])))
        for key, expected in [('2','containers'),('3','services'),('5','remote'),('7','storage'),('8','doctor')]:
            await pilot.press(key)
            await pilot.pause()
            assert app.current_view == expected
            print(expected, len(app.current_rows))
        await pilot.resize_terminal(82, 30)
        await pilot.pause()
        await pilot.press('1')
        await pilot.pause()
        print('overview', len(app.current_rows))
    print('TEXTUAL_LIVE_SMOKE_OK')

asyncio.run(main())
PY

  printf '%s %s\n' "$code" "$ms" >> /tmp/xavi-health-stress.txt

printf old > "$TESTROOT/source/value"

mv "$SRC" "$BACKUP"
mv "$STAGE" "$DST"
ln -s "$DST" "$SRC"
rm -f "$SRC"
mv "$DST" "$STAGE"
mv "$BACKUP" "$SRC"
[ -f "$SRC/value" ] && [ "$(cat "$SRC/value")" = old ]
[ -f "$STAGE/value" ] && [ "$(cat "$STAGE/value")" = new ]
[ ! -e "$DST" ] && [ ! -e "$BACKUP" ]

cd "$(dirname "$SCRIPT")"
sha256sum "$(basename "$SCRIPT")" > "$(basename "$CHECKSUM")"

printf 'script_validation=PASS\n'
stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U:%G bytes=%s path=%n' "$SCRIPT"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
ROOT=/var/www/xavi/xavi-man-app
V="$ROOT/vendor/twin"
LIB="$V/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu"
REDIRECT="$ROOT/native/libxavi_twin_redirect.so"

export PATH="$V/usr/bin:$PATH"
stty rows 40 cols 120
LD_PRELOAD="$REDIRECT" "$V/usr/bin/twin_server" --secure --nohw >/tmp/xavi-twin-prod-topology/server.log 2>&1
for _ in $(seq 1 80); do
  line=$(grep -m1 -E 'starting in background as :[0-9]+ \(pid [0-9]+\)' /tmp/xavi-twin-prod-topology/server.log 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ -n "$line" ] && break
  sleep .05
done
TWDISPLAY=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | sed -nE 's/.* as (:[0-9]+) \(pid ([0-9]+)\).*/\1/p')
SPID=$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | sed -nE 's/.* as (:[0-9]+) \(pid ([0-9]+)\).*/\2/p')
export TWDISPLAY

timeout 5 "$ROOT/native/xavi-man-twin" >/tmp/xavi-twin-prod-topology/client.out 2>/tmp/xavi-twin-prod-topology/client.err & CPID=$!
sleep .25

LD_PRELOAD="$REDIRECT" "$V/usr/bin/twdisplay" -f --quiet --hw=tty </dev/tty >/dev/tty 2>&1 & DPID=$!
cleanup(){ kill "$DPID" 2>/dev/null || true; kill "$CPID" 2>/dev/null || true; kill "$SPID" 2>/dev/null || true; printf '\033[?1006l\033[?1003l\033[?1002l\033[?1000l' >/dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true; stty sane </dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
wait "$CPID" 2>/dev/null || true
kill "$DPID" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$DPID" 2>/dev/null || true
SH
chmod +x /tmp/xavi-twin-prod-topology/run.sh
set +e

for bad in [b'out of memory',b'libtw error',b'failed to load the window manager',b'All display drivers failed',b'Traceback',b'Segmentation']:

import json, os, ssl, urllib.error, urllib.request
base='https://api.xavi.app'
token=os.environ['TOKEN']
ctx=ssl.create_default_context()

def rpc(path, method, params):
    body=json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':method,'method':method,'params':params}).encode()
    req=urllib.request.Request(base+path,data=body,headers={
        'Content-Type':'application/json',
        'Accept':'application/json, text/event-stream',
        'MCP-Protocol-Version':'2025-06-18',
        'X-Xavi-Agent-Id':'route-smoke',
        'X-Xavi-Device-Id':'tbi-production-4',
    },method='POST')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,context=ctx,timeout=30) as response:
        raw=response.read().decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
        status=response.status
        session=response.headers.get('Mcp-Session-Id')
    payload=json.loads(raw)
    if 'error' in payload:
        raise AssertionError(f'{path} {method} returned RPC error: {payload["error"]}')
    return status,payload.get('result',{}),session

def initialize(path):
    return rpc(path,'initialize',{
        'protocolVersion':'2025-06-18',
        'capabilities':{},
        'clientInfo':{'name':'xavi-route-smoke','version':'1.0'},
    })

def status_only(path):
    body=b'{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"invalid-route-smoke","version":"1"}}}'
    req=urllib.request.Request(base+path,data=body,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json','Accept':'application/json'},method='POST')
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req,context=ctx,timeout=20) as response:
            return response.status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        exc.read()
        return exc.code

paths={
    'runtime':f'/mcp/{token}',
    'ops':f'/mcp/ops/{token}',
    'compat':f'/chatgpt/ops/{token}',
}
summary={}
for label,path in paths.items():
    status,result,session=initialize(path)
    assert status==200,(label,status)
    server=result.get('serverInfo') or {}
    protocol=result.get('protocolVersion')
    status2,tools,_=rpc(path,'tools/list',{})
    names=[row.get('name') for row in tools.get('tools',[])]
    assert status2==200 and names,(label,status2,len(names))
    if label=='runtime':
        assert 'runtime.health' in names and 'coordination.status' in names,names[:20]
    else:
        assert 'bounded_job_start' in names and 'coordination.status' in names,names[:20]
    summary[label]={
        'initialize_status':status,
        'protocol':protocol,
        'server_name':server.get('name'),
        'tool_count':len(names),
        'session_header':bool(session),
    }
checks={

    'invalid_runtime':status_only('/mcp/not-the-token'),
    'invalid_ops':status_only('/mcp/ops/not-the-token'),
    'invalid_nested':status_only('/mcp/ops/not-the-token/extra'),
}
assert all(code==404 for code in checks.values()),checks
print(json.dumps({'tokenized_routes':'PASS','endpoints':summary,'negative_status':checks},indent=2,sort_keys=True))

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import threading
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

STACK_MANAGER_ROOT = Path("/var/www/xavi/xavi-stack-manager")
STACK_CONFIG = STACK_MANAGER_ROOT / "config/stack.json"
if str(STACK_MANAGER_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(STACK_MANAGER_ROOT))

from xavi_stack.core import StackError, StackManager  # noqa: E402
from xavi_stack.ml import CPUAdvisor  # noqa: E402


class XaviBackend:
    def __init__(self, config: Path | str = STACK_CONFIG) -> None:
        self.manager = StackManager(Path(config))
        self.advisor = CPUAdvisor()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._cache: tuple[float, dict[str, Any]] | None = None

    def state(self, *, max_age: float = 2.0) -> dict[str, Any]:
        now = time.monotonic()
        with self._lock:
            if self._cache and now - self._cache[0] <= max_age:
                return self._cache[1]
            inventory = self.manager.inventory()
            doctor = self.manager.doctor()
            payload = {
                "schema_version": 1,
                "operation": "xavi-man.state",
                "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                "identity": inventory.get("identity", {}),
                "containers": inventory.get("containers", []),
                "services": inventory.get("services", []),
                "projects": inventory.get("projects", []),
                "remote_nodes": inventory.get("remote_nodes", []),
                "filesystems": inventory.get("filesystems", []),
                "listeners": inventory.get("listeners", []),
                "doctor": doctor,
            }
            self._cache = (now, payload)
            return payload

    def invalidate(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._cache = None

    def resources(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        with self._lock:
            return {"schema_version": 1, "operation": "xavi-man.resources", **self.manager.resource_pool()}

    def contract(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        with self._lock:
            return {"schema_version": 1, "operation": "xavi-man.contract", **self.manager.contract_status()}

    def advisor_status(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        with self._lock:
            return {"schema_version": 1, "operation": "xavi-man.advisor", **self.advisor.recommend(self.manager.doctor())}

    def logs(self, target: str, lines: int = 200) -> dict[str, Any]:
        target = target.strip()
        if not target:
            raise StackError("log target is required")
        with self._lock:
            return self.manager.logs(target, lines=max(1, min(int(lines), 1000)))

    def action(self, *, kind: str, verb: str, target: str, apply: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
        kind = kind.strip().lower()
        verb = verb.strip().lower()
        target = target.strip()
        allowed = {
            "container": {"start", "stop", "restart"},
            "service": {"start", "stop", "restart", "enable", "disable"},
            "project": {"start", "stop", "restart"},
            "remote-container": {"start", "stop", "restart"},
        }
        if kind not in allowed or verb not in allowed[kind]:
            raise StackError(f"unsupported xavi-man action: {kind}/{verb}")
        if not target:
            raise StackError("target is required")
        with self._lock:
            if kind == "container":
                result = self.manager.container_action(verb, target, apply=apply)
            elif kind == "service":
                result = self.manager.user_service_action(verb, target, apply=apply)
            elif kind == "project":
                result = self.manager.project_action(verb, target, apply=apply)
            else:
                if "/" not in target:
                    raise StackError("remote target must use node/container form")
                node_id, container_name = target.split("/", 1)
                result = self.manager.remote_container_action(verb, node_id, container_name, apply=apply)
            if apply:
                self._cache = None
            return result
PY

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Mapping

AUDIENCE = "xavi-man"
REQUIRED_SCOPE = "xavi-man:control"
ENV_CANDIDATES = (
    Path("/var/www/xavi/srnn_server/havod/.env"),
    Path("/var/www/xavi/srnn_server/hovod/.env"),
)


def _load_env() -> dict[str, str]:
    env: dict[str, str] = {}
    for path in ENV_CANDIDATES:
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        for raw in path.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
            line = raw.strip()
            if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
                continue
            key, value = line.split("=", 1)
            env[key.strip()] = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        break
    return env


def jwt_secret() -> bytes:
    value = os.environ.get("XAVI_MAN_JWT_SECRET") or os.environ.get("HOVOD_JWT_SECRET")
    if not value:
        value = _load_env().get("JWT_SECRET", "")
    if not value:
        raise RuntimeError("xavi-man JWT secret is unavailable")
    return value.encode("utf-8")


def _b64url_decode(value: str) -> bytes:
    padding = "=" * ((4 - len(value) % 4) % 4)
    return base64.urlsafe_b64decode((value + padding).encode("ascii"))


def verify_token(token: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    try:
        header_raw, payload_raw, signature_raw = token.split(".")
        header = json.loads(_b64url_decode(header_raw))
        payload = json.loads(_b64url_decode(payload_raw))
        if not isinstance(header, dict) or not isinstance(payload, dict) or header.get("alg") != "HS256":
            return None
        expected = hmac.new(jwt_secret(), f"{header_raw}.{payload_raw}".encode("ascii"), hashlib.sha256).digest()
        if not hmac.compare_digest(expected, _b64url_decode(signature_raw)):
            return None
        now = int(time.time())
        if int(payload.get("exp", 0)) <= now or int(payload.get("nbf", 0) or 0) > now + 5:
            return None
        if payload.get("aud") != AUDIENCE or payload.get("admin") is not True:
            return None
        scope = payload.get("scope", [])
        if isinstance(scope, str):
            scope = scope.split()
        if REQUIRED_SCOPE not in scope:
            return None
        return payload
    except Exception:
        return None


def trusted_proxy_identity(headers: Mapping[str, str], remote: str | None) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if remote not in {"127.0.0.1", "::1", None}:
        return None
    if headers.get("X-Xavi-Man-Auth") != "1" or headers.get("X-Xavi-Man-Admin") != "1":
        return None
    user_id = headers.get("X-Xavi-Man-User-Id", "").strip()
    if not user_id:
        return None
    return {
        "sub": f"ccu-{user_id}",
        "uid": int(user_id) if user_id.isdigit() else user_id,
        "username": headers.get("X-Xavi-Man-User-Name", ""),
        "email": headers.get("X-Xavi-Man-User-Email", ""),
        "aud": AUDIENCE,
        "scope": ["xavi-man:read", REQUIRED_SCOPE],
        "admin": True,
        "via": "concretecms-auth-request",
    }


def authorize(headers: Mapping[str, str], remote: str | None, query_token: str = "") -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    proxied = trusted_proxy_identity(headers, remote)
    if proxied:
        return proxied
    auth = headers.get("Authorization", "")
    token = auth[7:].strip() if auth.lower().startswith("bearer ") else query_token.strip()
    return verify_token(token) if token else None
PY

        title = urwid.AttrMap(urwid.Text(" Xavi Program Manager — Windows 3.11 Operations Desktop ", align="center"), "title")
        menu_items = []
