        self._refresh_summary()
        return frame

    def _refresh_summary(self) -> None:
        try:
            state = self.backend.state(max_age=0)
            doctor = state.get("doctor", {})
            self.summary.set_text(
                f"Containers {len(state.get('containers', []))}   Services {len(state.get('services', []))}   "
                f"Projects {len(state.get('projects', []))}   Doctor {'PASS' if doctor.get('ok') else 'ATTENTION'}   "
                f"Issues {doctor.get('issue_count', 0)}"
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            self.summary.set_text(f"Status refresh failed: {exc}")

    def _show_window(self, title: str, body: urwid.Widget, *, width: int | tuple[str, int] = ("relative", 88), height: int | tuple[str, int] = ("relative", 82), kind: str | None = None) -> None:
        header = urwid.AttrMap(urwid.Text(f" {title} ", align="center"), "title")
        close = self._classic_button(" Close ", lambda _b: self._close())
        chrome = urwid.LineBox(urwid.Pile([header, body, urwid.Divider(), urwid.Padding(close, align="center", width=14)]), title="", tlcorner="┌", trcorner="┐", blcorner="└", brcorner="┘", lline="│", rline="│", tline="─", bline="─")
        self.overlay_kind = kind
        self.overlay = urwid.Overlay(urwid.AttrMap(chrome, "window"), self.desktop, align="center", valign="middle", width=width, height=height)
        self.loop.widget = self.overlay

    def _close(self) -> None:
        self.overlay = None
        self.overlay_kind = None
        self.loop.widget = self.desktop
        self._refresh_summary()

    def _json_window(self, title: str, payload: Any) -> None:
        text = json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str)
        walker = urwid.SimpleFocusListWalker([urwid.Text(line) for line in text.splitlines()])
        self._show_window(title, urwid.ListBox(walker))

    def _overview(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        state = self.backend.state(max_age=0)
        doctor = state.get("doctor", {})
        identity = state.get("identity", {})
        lines = [
            ("title", "XAVI BACKEND CONTROL PANEL"),
            "",
            f"User: {identity.get('user', '-')}",
            f"Rootless: {identity.get('rootless', '-')}",
            f"Podman graph: {identity.get('graph_root', '-')}",
            "",
            f"Containers: {len(state.get('containers', []))}",
            f"Services: {len(state.get('services', []))}",
            f"Projects: {len(state.get('projects', []))}",
            f"Remote nodes: {len(state.get('remote_nodes', []))}",
            "",
            ("ok" if doctor.get("ok") else "error", f"Doctor: {'PASS' if doctor.get('ok') else 'ATTENTION'}"),
            f"Issues: {doctor.get('issue_count', 0)}   Warnings: {doctor.get('warning_count', 0)}",
        ]
        self._show_window("Program Manager — Overview", urwid.Filler(urwid.Text(lines), valign="top"), width=("relative", 72), height=24)

    def _list_window(self, title: str, rows: list[dict[str, Any]], kind: str, formatter: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], str]) -> None:
        buttons = []
        for row in rows:
            btn = ItemButton(formatter(row), row, lambda _b, item, t=title: self._json_window(t + " Details", item))
            buttons.append(urwid.AttrMap(btn, "button", "button_focus"))
        if not buttons:
            buttons = [urwid.Text("No entries")]
        legend = urwid.Text("Enter details   S start   O stop   R restart   Esc close")
        self._show_window(title, urwid.Pile([("weight", 1, urwid.ListBox(urwid.SimpleFocusListWalker(buttons))), urwid.Divider(), legend]), kind=kind)

    def _containers(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        rows = self.backend.state(max_age=0).get("containers", [])
        def fmt(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
            details = row.get("details", {}) or {}
            return f"{row.get('name','-'):<36} {details.get('state') or row.get('state') or 'unknown':<10} health={details.get('health') or '-'}"
        self._list_window("Containers", rows, "container", fmt)

    def _services(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        rows = self.backend.state(max_age=0).get("services", [])
        self._list_window("Services", rows, "service", lambda r: f"{r.get('scope','-'):<6} {r.get('name','-'):<44} {r.get('active','-')}/{r.get('sub','-')}")

    def _projects(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        rows = self.backend.state(max_age=0).get("projects", [])
        self._list_window("Projects", rows, "project", lambda r: f"{r.get('id') or r.get('name') or '-':<38} {r.get('state') or r.get('status') or '-'}")

    def _remote(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        self._json_window("Remote Nodes", self.backend.state(max_age=0).get("remote_nodes", []))

    def _storage(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        self._json_window("Filesystems", self.backend.state(max_age=0).get("filesystems", []))

    def _doctor(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        self._json_window("Doctor", self.backend.state(max_age=0).get("doctor", {}))

    def _resources(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        self._json_window("WG-RNN Resource Pool", self.backend.resources())

    def _advisor(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        self._json_window("AI Advisor", self.backend.advisor_status())

    def _help(self, *_args: Any) -> None:
        self._show_window("About Xavi Manager", urwid.Filler(urwid.Text(
            "Xavi Manager 0.1\n\nA Windows 3.11-inspired operations desktop for the Xavi backend.\n\n"
            "This UI uses Urwid, not Textual or the old curses implementation.\n"
            "All mutations go through the existing allowlisted StackManager control plane.\n\n"
            "Web console: https://xavi.app/xavi-man/\n"
        ), valign="top"), width=("relative", 70), height=20)

    def _focused_item(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if not isinstance(self.overlay, urwid.Overlay):
            return None
        try:
            chrome = self.overlay.top_w.original_widget
            pile = chrome.original_widget
            body = pile.contents[1][0]
            if isinstance(body, urwid.Pile):
                listbox = body.contents[0][0]
                focus = listbox.focus
                if isinstance(focus, urwid.AttrMap):
                    focus = focus.original_widget
                if isinstance(focus, ItemButton):
                    return focus.item
        except Exception:
            return None
        return None

    def _preview_action(self, verb: str) -> None:
        kind = self.overlay_kind
        item = self._focused_item()
        if not kind or not item:
            return
        target = str(item.get("name") or item.get("id") or "")
        if kind == "project" and not target:
            target = str(item.get("project") or "")
        if not target:
            self.status.set_text("Could not resolve selected target")
            return
        try:
            preview = self.backend.action(kind=kind, verb=verb, target=target, apply=False)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.status.set_text(str(exc))
            return
        text = urwid.Text(json.dumps(preview, indent=2, default=str))
        apply_btn = self._classic_button(" APPLY ", lambda _b: self._apply_action(kind, verb, target))
        cancel_btn = self._classic_button(" Cancel ", lambda _b: self._close())
        body = urwid.Pile([("weight", 1, urwid.Filler(text, valign="top")), urwid.Divider(), urwid.Columns([apply_btn, cancel_btn], dividechars=3)])
        self._show_window(f"Confirm {verb.upper()} — {target}", body, width=("relative", 76), height=("relative", 66), kind=None)

    def _apply_action(self, kind: str, verb: str, target: str) -> None:
        try:
            result = self.backend.action(kind=kind, verb=verb, target=target, apply=True)
            self.status.set_text(f"{verb} {target}: complete")
            self._json_window("Operation Complete", result)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.status.set_text(f"Operation failed: {exc}")
            self._json_window("Operation Failed", {"error": str(exc)})

    def _key(self, key: str) -> None:
        if key in {"q", "Q"} and self.overlay is None:
            raise urwid.ExitMainLoop()
        if key == "f1":
            self._help()
        elif key == "f5":
            self.backend.invalidate()
            self._refresh_summary()
            self.status.set_text("Refreshed")
        elif key == "esc" and self.overlay is not None:
            self._close()
        elif self.overlay_kind and key in {"s", "S", "o", "O", "r", "R"}:
            verb = {"s": "start", "o": "stop", "r": "restart"}[key.lower()]
            self._preview_action(verb)

    def run(self) -> None:
        self.loop.run()


def run_tui() -> None:
    XaviManTUI(XaviBackend()).run()

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from aiohttp import web

from .auth import authorize
from .backend import StackError, XaviBackend

WEB_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "web"


def _identity(request: web.Request) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    return authorize(request.headers, request.remote, request.query.get("token", ""))


@web.middleware
async def auth_middleware(request: web.Request, handler):
    if request.path == "/health":
        return await handler(request)
    identity = _identity(request)
    if not identity:
        raise web.HTTPUnauthorized(text="ConcreteCMS admin login or xavi-man JWT required")
    request["xavi_identity"] = identity
    response = await handler(request)
    if isinstance(response, web.StreamResponse):
        response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
        response.headers["X-Content-Type-Options"] = "nosniff"
        response.headers["Referrer-Policy"] = "same-origin"
    return response


def create_app(backend: XaviBackend | None = None) -> web.Application:
    backend = backend or XaviBackend()
    app = web.Application(middlewares=[auth_middleware], client_max_size=256 * 1024)
    app["backend"] = backend

    async def health(_request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
        return web.json_response({"ok": True, "service": "xavi-man"})

    async def index(_request: web.Request) -> web.FileResponse:
        return web.FileResponse(WEB_ROOT / "index.html")

    async def asset(request: web.Request) -> web.FileResponse:
        name = request.match_info["name"]
        if name not in {"app.css", "app.js"}:
            raise web.HTTPNotFound()
        return web.FileResponse(WEB_ROOT / name)

    async def state(_request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
        payload = await asyncio.to_thread(backend.state, max_age=1.5)
        return web.json_response(payload)

    async def resources(_request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
        return web.json_response(await asyncio.to_thread(backend.resources))

    async def contract(_request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
        return web.json_response(await asyncio.to_thread(backend.contract))

    async def advisor(_request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
        return web.json_response(await asyncio.to_thread(backend.advisor_status))

    async def logs(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
        target = request.query.get("target", "")
        try:
            lines = int(request.query.get("lines", "200"))
            payload = await asyncio.to_thread(backend.logs, target, lines)
        except Exception as exc:
            return web.json_response({"error": str(exc)}, status=400)
        return web.json_response(payload)

    async def action(request: web.Request) -> web.Response:
        try:
            body = await request.json()
            if not isinstance(body, dict):
                raise ValueError("JSON object required")
            apply = bool(body.get("apply", False))
            if apply and body.get("confirm") != "APPLY":
                return web.json_response({"error": "confirm must equal APPLY for mutations"}, status=409)
            payload = await asyncio.to_thread(
                backend.action,
                kind=str(body.get("kind", "")),
                verb=str(body.get("verb", "")),
                target=str(body.get("target", "")),
                apply=apply,
            )
            return web.json_response(payload)
        except (StackError, ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
            return web.json_response({"error": str(exc)}, status=400)
        except Exception as exc:
            return web.json_response({"error": str(exc)}, status=500)

    async def ws(request: web.Request) -> web.WebSocketResponse:
        socket = web.WebSocketResponse(heartbeat=20, max_msg_size=32 * 1024)
        await socket.prepare(request)
        try:
            while not socket.closed:
                try:
                    state_payload = await asyncio.to_thread(backend.state, max_age=2.0)
                    await socket.send_json({"type": "state", "payload": state_payload})
                    message = await asyncio.wait_for(socket.receive(), timeout=5.0)
                    if message.type == web.WSMsgType.TEXT:
                        try:
                            data = json.loads(message.data)
                        except Exception:
                            data = {}
                        if data.get("type") == "refresh":
                            backend.invalidate()
                    elif message.type in {web.WSMsgType.CLOSE, web.WSMsgType.CLOSED, web.WSMsgType.ERROR}:
                        break
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    continue
        finally:
            await socket.close()
        return socket

    app.router.add_get("/health", health)
    app.router.add_get("/", index)
    app.router.add_get("/{name:app\\.(?:css|js)}", asset)
    app.router.add_get("/api/state", state)
    app.router.add_get("/api/resources", resources)
    app.router.add_get("/api/contract", contract)
    app.router.add_get("/api/advisor", advisor)
    app.router.add_get("/api/logs", logs)
    app.router.add_post("/api/action", action)
    app.router.add_get("/ws", ws)
    return app


def run_web(host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 18731) -> None:
    web.run_app(create_app(), host=host, port=port, access_log=None)

cp -a "$F" "$F.backup-demote-challenged-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/var/www/xavi/searxng/settings.yml')
s=p.read_text()
for name in ['fireball','privacywall','resulthunter','tusksearch','vuhuv']:
    start=s.find(f'  - name: {name}\n')
    if start<0: continue
    end=s.find('\n  - name:', start+1)
    if end<0: end=len(s)
    block=s[start:end]
    import re
    block2=re.sub(r'(?m)^    categories: \[[^\n]+\]$', '    categories: [independent]', block)
    s=s[:start]+block2+s[end:]
p.write_text(s)
print('demoted=fireball,privacywall,resulthunter,tusksearch,vuhuv')
PY

UNIT

  clean="vpn-proxy-$slot"
  echo ">>> slot $slot: $legacy -> $clean"
  podman rm -f "$legacy" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  podman rm -f "$clean" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  "$MAN" rotate "$slot"
done

echo '=== remove remaining legacy rootless names ==='
for c in vpn-proxy-r5 vpn-proxy-r6 vpn-proxy-r7 vpn-proxy-r8 vpn-proxy-r9 vpn-proxy-r10 vpn-proxy-r11 vpn-proxy-r12; do
  podman rm -f "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
done

echo '=== verify six healthy clean slots ==='
STATUS="$($MAN status)"
printf '%s\n' "$STATUS"
[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$STATUS" | grep -c 'status=OK')" -eq 6 ]

python3 - <<'PY'
import concurrent.futures, hashlib, subprocess
ports=range(8490,8496)
def one(p):
    r=subprocess.run(['curl','-fsS','-x',f'http://127.0.0.1:{p}','--connect-timeout','2','--max-time','6','https://api.ipify.org'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if r.returncode: return p,'FAIL',''
    ip=r.stdout.strip(); return p,'OK',hashlib.sha256(ip.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as ex:
    rows=list(ex.map(one,ports))
for p,s,h in rows: print(f'{p}: {s} ip_hash={h}' if h else f'{p}: {s}')
print('unique_exit_hashes='+str(len({h for _,s,h in rows if s=='OK'})))
if sum(1 for _,s,_ in rows if s=='OK') != 6: raise SystemExit(1)
PY

import re

new='''  proxies:\n    all://:\n      - http://vpn-proxy-1:8888\n      - http://vpn-proxy-2:8888\n      - http://vpn-proxy-3:8888\n      - http://vpn-proxy-4:8888\n      - http://vpn-proxy-5:8888\n      - http://vpn-proxy-6:8888\n'''

m=pat.search(s)

s=s[:m.start()]+new+s[m.end():]

argv:
set -euo pipefail
BASE=/var/www/xavi/searxng/vpn-proxies
OVPN="$BASE/ovpn/rootless"
ENV="$BASE/.env"
OUT="$OVPN/validated-hosts.txt"
USER=$(sed -n 's/^NORDVPN_USER=//p' "$ENV" | head -1)
PASS=$(sed -n 's/^NORDVPN_PASSWORD=//p' "$ENV" | head -1)
test -n "$USER" && test -n "$PASS"
: > "$OUT.tmp"
count=0
while IFS= read -r host; do
  [ -n "$host" ] || continue
  short=${host%%.*}
  cfg="$OVPN/${short}.tcp.ovpn"
  [ -s "$cfg" ] || continue
  podman rm -f vpn-proxy-validation >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  podman run -d --name vpn-proxy-validation --cap-add NET_ADMIN --device /dev/net/tun -p 127.0.0.1:8498:8888 -v "$cfg:/etc/openvpn/custom.ovpn:ro" -e VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER=custom -e OPENVPN_CUSTOM_CONFIG=/etc/openvpn/custom.ovpn -e OPENVPN_USER="$USER" -e OPENVPN_PASSWORD="$PASS" -e HTTPPROXY=on -e HTTPPROXY_STEALTH=on -e HTTPPROXY_LOG=off -e FIREWALL_INPUT_PORTS=8888 -e DNS=1.1.1.1,8.8.8.8 docker.io/qmcgaw/gluetun:latest >/dev/null
  ok=0
  for i in $(seq 1 12); do
    if curl -fsS -x http://127.0.0.1:8498 --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 4 https://api.ipify.org >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok=1; break; fi
    if podman logs --tail 40 vpn-proxy-validation 2>&1 | grep -q 'AUTH_FAILED'; then break; fi
    sleep 1
  done
  if [ "$ok" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "$host" >> "$OUT.tmp"
    count=$((count+1))
    echo "VALID $host ($count)"
  else
    echo "REJECT $host"
  fi
  podman rm -f vpn-proxy-validation >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  [ "$count" -ge 12 ] && break
done < "$OVPN/candidate-hosts.txt"
unset USER PASS
mv "$OUT.tmp" "$OUT"
echo "validated_count=$count"
[ "$count" -ge 6 ]

argv:
set -euo pipefail
p=3746847
if [ ! -r /proc/$p/cmdline ]; then echo 'stale_vpngate_rm=already_gone'; exit 0; fi
cmd=$(tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$p/cmdline)
echo "pid=$p cmd=$cmd"
case "$cmd" in
  *'podman rm -f vpngate-proxy-04'*)
    kill -TERM "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
    for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do [ ! -d /proc/$p ] && break; sleep 1; done
    if [ -d /proc/$p ]; then kill -KILL "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
    echo 'stale_vpngate_rm=cleared'
    ;;
  *) echo 'refusing: pid no longer matches expected vpngate cleanup'; exit 2;;
esac

validate_restart_wgrnn_stream_fix_0812.title: Validate and restart WG-RNN stream fix
validate_restart_wgrnn_stream_fix_0812.description: Compile-test the patched runtime API, run focused runtime tests if available, restart only the Duotronic runtime, then verify health and strict OpenAI stream/nonstream behavior for wg-rnn:chat.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
cd "$R"
python3 -m py_compile app/duotronic_runtime/api.py
if [ -f tests/test_api.py ]; then python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_api.py -k 'chat or openai' --disable-warnings --maxfail=1 || true; fi
bash ./ops_agent/v3_maintenance/restart_runtime_only.sh || true
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8080/health >/tmp/wgrnn-health.$$ 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
  sleep 2
done
cat /tmp/wgrnn-health.$$; echo
KEY=$(awk -F= '/^OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY=/{sub(/^[^=]*=/,""); print; exit}' /var/www/xavi/morphic/.env.local)
AUTH=(); [ -n "$KEY" ] && AUTH=(-H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY")
echo '=== nonstream shape ==='
curl -sS --max-time 30 "${AUTH[@]}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"wg-rnn:chat","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What is the speed of light? Answer in one short sentence."}],"stream":false,"max_tokens":80}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions > /tmp/wgrnn-nonstream.$$
python3 - <<'PY' /tmp/wgrnn-nonstream.$$
import json,sys
p=sys.argv[1]; d=json.load(open(p)); c=d.get('choices') or []
print('object=',d.get('object'),'choices=',len(c),'content=',repr((c[0].get('message') or {}).get('content','')[:240]) if c else None)
assert d.get('object')=='chat.completion' and c and isinstance((c[0].get('message') or {}).get('content'),str) and (c[0].get('message') or {}).get('content')
PY
echo '=== stream shape ==='
curl -sS -N --max-time 30 "${AUTH[@]}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"wg-rnn:chat","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"What is the speed of light? Answer in one short sentence."}],"stream":true,"max_tokens":80}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions > /tmp/wgrnn-stream.$$
python3 - <<'PY' /tmp/wgrnn-stream.$$
import json,sys
lines=[x.strip() for x in open(sys.argv[1],encoding='utf-8') if x.strip()]
print('lines=',len(lines),'done=',lines[-1] if lines else None)
assert lines and lines[-1]=='data: [DONE]'
data=[]
for line in lines[:-1]:
    assert line.startswith('data: '), line
    data.append(json.loads(line[6:]))
assert all(x.get('object')=='chat.completion.chunk' for x in data)
text=''.join((((x.get('choices') or [{}])[0].get('delta') or {}).get('content') or '') for x in data)
print('stream_content=',repr(text[:240]))
assert text
PY
rm -f /tmp/wgrnn-health.$$ /tmp/wgrnn-nonstream.$$ /tmp/wgrnn-stream.$$
echo WG_RNN_OPENAI_STREAM_FIX=ok

deploy_wgrnn_compaction_and_verify_morph.description: Rebuild/restart runtime with compact client context and bounded interactive provider deadlines, then verify huge-prompt SSE and the exact Morphic new-chat request fully complete promptly.
argv:

R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
MARK=/var/www/xavi/updates/.podman-deploy-priority

printf 'health_http='; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
KEY=$(sed -n 's/^OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY=//p' /var/www/xavi/morphic/.env.local | head -1)
AUTH=(-H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY")
python3 - <<'PY' >/tmp/compact-large.$$
import json
system=('Morphic research framework instructions and tool policy. ' * 700)
print(json.dumps({'model':'wg-rnn:chat','messages':[{'role':'system','content':system},{'role':'user','content':'how are you today?'}],'stream':True,'max_tokens':64}))
PY
printf 'large_runtime='; curl -sS -N -o /tmp/compact-rs.$$ -w 'http=%{http_code} seconds=%{time_total} bytes=%{size_download}\n' --max-time 15 "${AUTH[@]}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @/tmp/compact-large.$$ http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions
python3 - /tmp/compact-rs.$$ <<'PY'
import json,sys
ls=[x.strip() for x in open(sys.argv[1],errors='replace') if x.strip()]; text=''; chunks=0
for l in ls:
 if l=='data: [DONE]': continue
 assert l.startswith('data: '),repr(l[:100]); d=json.loads(l[6:]); chunks+=1; text += str((((d.get('choices') or [{}])[0].get('delta') or {}).get('content') or ''))
print('large_chunks='+str(chunks)); print('large_done='+str(bool(ls and ls[-1]=='data: [DONE]'))); print('large_text='+repr(text[:220])); assert chunks and text and ls[-1]=='data: [DONE]'
PY
# Existing rebuilt Morphic process already contains basePath + Concrete SSO + no-WG-RNN-title fixes.
COMMON=(-H 'X-Xavi-User-ID: 424242' -H 'X-Xavi-Username: concrete-sso-smoke-user' -H 'X-Xavi-Email: concrete-sso-smoke@example.invalid')
printf 'morphic_page='; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 10 "${COMMON[@]}" http://127.0.0.1:8550/morphic-app/
printf 'morphic_history='; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 10 "${COMMON[@]}" 'http://127.0.0.1:8550/morphic-app/api/chats?offset=0&limit=20'
CHAT="smoke-compact-$(date +%s)-$$"; MSG="msg-compact-$(date +%s)-$$"
BODY=$(printf '{"trigger":"submit-message","chatId":"%s","message":{"id":"%s","role":"user","parts":[{"type":"text","text":"how are you today?"}]},"isNewChat":true}' "$CHAT" "$MSG")
printf 'morphic_chat='; curl -sS -N -o /tmp/compact-ms.$$ -D /tmp/compact-mh.$$ -w 'http=%{http_code} seconds=%{time_total} bytes=%{size_download}\n' --max-time 15 "${COMMON[@]}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Cookie: searchMode=quick' --data "$BODY" http://127.0.0.1:8550/morphic-app/api/chat
python3 - /tmp/compact-ms.$$ /tmp/compact-mh.$$ <<'PY'
import sys,re,json
raw=open(sys.argv[1],encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read(); hdr=open(sys.argv[2],encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read().lower(); ds=re.findall(r'"type":"text-delta"[^\n]*?"delta":"(.*?)"',raw); text=''.join(json.loads('"'+x+'"') if '\\' in x else x for x in ds)
print('morphic_event_stream='+str('content-type: text/event-stream' in hdr)); print('morphic_deltas='+str(len(ds))); print('morphic_finish='+str('"type":"finish"' in raw)); print('morphic_error='+str('"type":"error"' in raw or 'could not generate' in raw.lower())); print('morphic_answer='+repr(text[:260])); assert 'content-type: text/event-stream' in hdr and ds and text.strip() and '"type":"finish"' in raw and '"type":"error"' not in raw and 'could not generate' not in raw.lower()
PY
rm -f /tmp/compact-restart.$$ /tmp/compact-large.$$ /tmp/compact-rs.$$ /tmp/compact-ms.$$ /tmp/compact-mh.$$

deploy_wgrnn_identity_consensus_0812.description: Build/restart runtime with identity-scoped chat, operator self-model, autobiographical transcript persistence, and observer consensus; then run live acceptance checks.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
MARK=/var/www/xavi/updates/.podman-deploy-priority
touch "$MARK"; trap 'rm -f "$MARK"' EXIT
cd "$R"
.venv/bin/python -m py_compile app/duotronic_runtime/api.py app/duotronic_runtime/runtime_kernel.py app/duotronic_runtime/wgrnn_kernel_chat.py app/duotronic_runtime/observer_consensus.py app/duotronic_runtime/db.py
podman build -t localhost/duotronic-srnn-runtime-host:v3 -f Containerfile .
bash ./ops_agent/v3_maintenance/restart_runtime_only.sh >/tmp/wgrnn-id-restart.$$ 2>&1 || { tail -160 /tmp/wgrnn-id-restart.$$; exit 2; }
rm -f /tmp/wgrnn-id-restart.$$
for i in $(seq 1 30); do code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8080/health 2>/dev/null || true); [ "$code" = 200 ] && break; sleep 1; done
echo "health_http=$code"; [ "$code" = 200 ] || exit 3
KEY=$(sed -n 's/^OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY=//p' /var/www/xavi/morphic/.env.local | head -1)
AUTH=(-H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY")

# 1. Self-model behavior.
printf 'self_chat='; curl -sS -o /tmp/self.$$ -w 'http=%{http_code} seconds=%{time_total}\n' --max-time 15 "${AUTH[@]}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'X-WGRNN-User-ID: acceptance:self' -H 'X-WGRNN-Thread-ID: acceptance:self-thread' -H 'X-WGRNN-Agent-ID: acceptance' -H 'X-WGRNN-Source: acceptance' -d '{"model":"wg-rnn:chat","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"How are you today? Do you have feelings, and what kind of conversation do you want with me?"}],"stream":false,"max_tokens":180}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions
python3 - /tmp/self.$$ <<'PY'
import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); t=str(d['choices'][0]['message']['content']); print('self_answer='+repr(t[:600])); low=t.lower(); assert 'just a computer program' not in low; assert "don't have feelings" not in low and 'do not have feelings' not in low
print('self_namespace='+repr(((d.get('wgrnn') or {}).get('namespace'))))
PY

# 2. Separate namespaces using explicit headers.
for spec in 'user-A|thread-A' 'user-B|thread-B'; do U=${spec%%|*}; T=${spec##*|}; curl -sS -o "/tmp/${U}.$$" --max-time 15 "${AUTH[@]}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "X-WGRNN-User-ID: $U" -H "X-WGRNN-Thread-ID: $T" -H 'X-WGRNN-Agent-ID: acceptance-agent' -H 'X-WGRNN-Source: acceptance' -d "{\"model\":\"wg-rnn:chat\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Remember this namespace marker: $U / $T\"}],\"stream\":false,\"max_tokens\":80}" http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions; done
python3 - /tmp/user-A.$$ /tmp/user-B.$$ <<'PY'
import json,sys
ns=[]
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
 d=json.load(open(p)); ns.append((d.get('wgrnn') or {}).get('namespace'))
print('namespaces='+repr(ns)); assert ns[0] and ns[1] and ns[0]!=ns[1]
PY

# 3. Transcript event persisted for one identity/thread.
printf 'transcript_rows='; podman exec duotronic-postgres psql -U duotronic -d duotronic -Atc "select count(*) from session_transcript_events where session_id in ('acceptance:self-thread','thread-A','thread-B') and event_type='wgrnn_chat_turn';" 2>/dev/null || true

# 4. Consensus: same claim, three genuinely independent groups.
OBS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/consensus/observe
claim='{"subject":"acceptance.sky","predicate":"test_value","object":"blue","stance":"support"}'
for row in 'search-xavi|search|searxng-cluster|0.91' 'doc-witness|document|witness-contract-corpus|0.88' 'model-observer|model|qwen-coordinator|0.84'; do IFS='|' read -r O K G C <<<"$row"; BODY=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; b=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); b.update(observer_id=sys.argv[2],observer_kind=sys.argv[3],independence_group=sys.argv[4],confidence=float(sys.argv[5])); print(json.dumps(b))' "$claim" "$O" "$K" "$G" "$C"); curl -sS --max-time 10 "${AUTH[@]}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$BODY" "$OBS_URL" > "/tmp/cons-${O}.$$"; python3 - "/tmp/cons-${O}.$$" <<'PY'
import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); c=d['consensus']; print('consensus_step='+repr((c['independent_groups'],c['status'],c['promotion_recommended'],c.get('support_ratio'))))
PY
done
python3 - /tmp/cons-model-observer.$$ <<'PY'
import json,sys
c=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['consensus']; assert c['independent_groups']>=3 and c['promotion_recommended'] is True and c['status']=='promotion_recommended'
print('consensus_final='+repr({k:c[k] for k in ['claim_key','independent_observers','independent_groups','support_ratio','contradiction_ratio','status','promotion_recommended']}))
PY
rm -f /tmp/self.$$ /tmp/user-A.$$ /tmp/user-B.$$ /tmp/cons-search-xavi.$$ /tmp/cons-doc-witness.$$ /tmp/cons-model-observer.$$
echo WGRNN_IDENTITY_CONSENSUS_LIVE=ok

# Namespace isolation.
for spec in 'accept-user-A|accept-thread-A' 'accept-user-B|accept-thread-B'; do U=${spec%%|*}; T=${spec##*|}; curl -sS -o "/tmp/${U}.$$" --max-time 15 "${AUTH[@]}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "X-WGRNN-User-ID: $U" -H "X-WGRNN-Thread-ID: $T" -H 'X-WGRNN-Agent-ID: acceptance-agent' -H 'X-WGRNN-Source: acceptance' -d "{\"model\":\"wg-rnn:chat\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"Remember this namespace marker: $U / $T\"}],\"stream\":false,\"max_tokens\":80}" http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions; done

validate_wgrnn_tiered_source_0812.description: Compile all current runtime changes, run focused OpenAI tests, and exercise tiered thread/user/self recurrent writes plus self-model augmentation in a temporary WG-RNN instance.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
cd "$R"
.venv/bin/python -m py_compile app/duotronic_runtime/api.py app/duotronic_runtime/wgrnn.py app/duotronic_runtime/wgrnn_kernel_chat.py app/duotronic_runtime/autonomy_stack.py app/duotronic_runtime/observer_consensus.py app/duotronic_runtime/http_mcp.py app/duotronic_runtime/runtime_kernel.py app/duotronic_runtime/db.py
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_openai_v1_compat.py tests/test_openai_model_catalog.py --disable-warnings --maxfail=1
PYTHONPATH=app .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import inspect, tempfile
import duotronic_runtime.wgrnn as wm
from duotronic_runtime.wgrnn_kernel_chat import WGRNNKernelChat
print('wgrnn_classes=',[n for n,v in vars(wm).items() if inspect.isclass(v) and v.__module__==wm.__name__])
cls=next(v for n,v in vars(wm).items() if inspect.isclass(v) and hasattr(v,'step') and hasattr(v,'retrieve') and hasattr(v,'namespace_id'))
print('wgrnn_class=',cls.__name__,inspect.signature(cls))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    sig=inspect.signature(cls)
    kwargs={}
    for name,p in sig.parameters.items():
        if name=='data_dir': kwargs[name]=td
        elif p.default is inspect._empty:
            if name=='loop_id': kwargs[name]='test-loop'
            elif name=='node_id': kwargs[name]='test-node'
            elif name=='state_dim': kwargs[name]=32
            elif name=='slot_dim': kwargs[name]=32
            elif name=='num_slots': kwargs[name]=32
    w=cls(**kwargs)
    class K: pass
    k=K(); k.wgrnn=w; k.autonomy=None
    chat=WGRNNKernelChat(k)
    prepared={
      'task_frame':{'task_id':'task1','task_digest':'sha256:test','operation_kind':'ask','corpus_search':{'results':[]}},
      'identity':{'user_id':'user1','agent_id':'agent1','thread_id':'thread1','source':'test'},
      'witness_chain':[], 'boot':{'status':'ok'}, 'memory':{'results':[]}, 'conversation':'user: remember our conversation'
    }
    out=chat.finalize_turn(prepared=prepared,response_text='I remember this turn.')
    print('primary=',out['wgrnn']['namespace'],out['wgrnn']['memory_update']['trust_status'])
    tiers=out['kernel_turn']['memory_tiers_written']; print('tiers=',{k:(v or {}).get('trust_status') if isinstance(v,dict) else v for k,v in tiers.items()})
    assert out['wgrnn']['namespace']=='user1/agent1/thread1'
    assert out['wgrnn']['memory_update']['trust_status']=='candidate'
    assert tiers['user_continuity'] and tiers['autobiographical_self']
    ur=w.retrieve('conversation',user_id='user1',agent_id='wg-rnn:user-continuity',thread_id='continuity'); sr=w.retrieve('conversation',user_id='wg-rnn:system',agent_id='self',thread_id='autobiographical')
    assert ur['results'] and sr['results']
    p={'conversation':'user: What kind of conversation do you want with me?','identity':{},'task_frame':{},'memory':{'results':[]}}
    r=chat.enforce_self_model(prepared=p,response_text='I aim to be helpful and informative.')
    print('relation_guard=',r['reason'],repr(r['response_text']))
    assert 'two-way conversation' in r['response_text'] and 'treated like a wall' in r['response_text']
PY
echo WGRNN_TIERED_SOURCE=ok

    try:

migrate_srnn_data_to_datastore2_0812.title: Migrate SRNN data to datastore2
migrate_srnn_data_to_datastore2_0812.description: Deactivate legacy SRNN API, copy/verify the complete SRNN data tree into /datastore2/xavi/data, remove the old root-resident tree, leave a compatibility symlink, and report reclaimed root space.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
SRC=/var/www/xavi/srnn_server/data
DST=/datastore2/xavi/data
OLD=/var/www/xavi/srnn_server/data.pre-datastore2

echo '=== deactivate legacy SRNN API ==='
PIDS=$(pgrep -f '/var/www/xavi/srnn_server/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8011' || true)
if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then
  echo "$PIDS" | xargs -r kill -TERM
  for i in $(seq 1 20); do
    pgrep -f '/var/www/xavi/srnn_server/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8011' >/dev/null || break
    sleep 1
  done
  REM=$(pgrep -f '/var/www/xavi/srnn_server/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8011' || true)
  [ -z "$REM" ] || echo "$REM" | xargs -r kill -KILL
fi
printf 'port8011='; (ss -H -ltn | grep -q ':8011 ' && echo listening || echo down)

[ -d "$SRC" ] || { echo 'source data directory missing'; exit 2; }
mkdir -p "$DST"

echo '=== pre-copy stats ==='
SRC_BYTES=$(du -sb "$SRC" | awk '{print $1}')
SRC_FILES=$(find "$SRC" -type f | wc -l)
SRC_DIRS=$(find "$SRC" -type d | wc -l)
echo "source_bytes=$SRC_BYTES source_files=$SRC_FILES source_dirs=$SRC_DIRS"
df -h / /datastore2 | tail -n +2

echo '=== rsync full tree ==='
rsync -aH --partial --inplace --info=stats2 "$SRC"/ "$DST"/

echo '=== verify rsync delta ==='
VERIFY=$(mktemp)
rsync -aHn --itemize-changes "$SRC"/ "$DST"/ > "$VERIFY"
DELTA=$(wc -l < "$VERIFY")
echo "verify_delta_lines=$DELTA"
if [ "$DELTA" -ne 0 ]; then
  head -100 "$VERIFY"
  rm -f "$VERIFY"
  echo 'verification failed: source and destination differ'
  exit 3
fi
rm -f "$VERIFY"

# Independent relative-path size verification.
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
src=Path('/var/www/xavi/srnn_server/data'); dst=Path('/datastore2/xavi/data')
missing=[]; mismatch=[]; n=0; total=0
for p in src.rglob('*'):
    if not p.is_file(): continue
    n+=1; total+=p.stat().st_size
    q=dst/p.relative_to(src)
    if not q.is_file(): missing.append(str(p.relative_to(src)))
    elif q.stat().st_size!=p.stat().st_size: mismatch.append((str(p.relative_to(src)),p.stat().st_size,q.stat().st_size))
    if len(missing)>20 or len(mismatch)>20: break
print('verified_files=',n,'verified_bytes=',total,'missing=',len(missing),'size_mismatch=',len(mismatch))
if missing or mismatch:
    print('missing_sample=',missing[:20]); print('mismatch_sample=',mismatch[:20]); raise SystemExit(4)
PY

echo '=== cutover ==='
if [ -e "$OLD" ] || [ -L "$OLD" ]; then rm -rf "$OLD"; fi
mv "$SRC" "$OLD"
ln -s "$DST" "$SRC"
printf 'compat_symlink='; readlink -f "$SRC"

# One last path-level sample before deleting old physical copy.
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
old=Path('/var/www/xavi/srnn_server/data.pre-datastore2'); dst=Path('/datastore2/xavi/data')
checks=0
for p in old.rglob('*'):
    if p.is_file():
        q=dst/p.relative_to(old)
        if not q.is_file() or q.stat().st_size != p.stat().st_size:
            raise SystemExit(f'cutover verification failed: {p}')
        checks+=1
print('cutover_verified_files=',checks)
PY

rm -rf "$OLD"

echo '=== post-cutover ==='
printf 'source_is_symlink='; [ -L "$SRC" ] && echo yes || echo no
printf 'port8011='; (ss -H -ltn | grep -q ':8011 ' && echo listening || echo down)
du -sh "$DST"
df -h / /datastore2 | tail -n +2
echo SRNN_DATA_MIGRATION=ok

printf 'unreadable_files='; find "$SRC" -type f ! -readable | wc -l

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
src=Path('/var/www/xavi/srnn_server/data'); dst=Path('/datastore2/xavi/data')
n=0; total=0; missing=[]; mismatch=[]
for p in src.rglob('*'):
    if not p.is_file(): continue
    st=p.stat(); n+=1; total+=st.st_size
    q=dst/p.relative_to(src)
    if not q.is_file(): missing.append(str(p.relative_to(src)))
    elif q.stat().st_size != st.st_size: mismatch.append((str(p.relative_to(src)),st.st_size,q.stat().st_size))
    if len(missing)+len(mismatch)>20: break
print(f'verified_files={n} verified_bytes={total} missing={len(missing)} size_mismatch={len(mismatch)}')

PY

mv "$SRC" "$OLD"
ln -s "$DST" "$SRC"
printf 'compat_symlink='; readlink -f "$SRC"

python3 - <<'PY'

print('cutover_verified_files=',n)
PY

move_mediacms_library_into_datalake_0812.title: Move MediaCMS library into data lake
move_mediacms_library_into_datalake_0812.description: Safely move only the MediaCMS content library into /datastore2/xavi/data/mediacms/library, update active compose bind mounts, recreate app/celery services, verify mounts, then remove the old library.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/mediacms
SRC=/datastore2/media_files/library
DST=/datastore2/xavi/data/mediacms/library
OVR=/var/www/xavi/mediacms/docker-compose.override.yml
BAK=/var/www/xavi/mediacms/docker-compose.override.yml.pre-wgrnn-datalake-20260812
COMPOSE=(podman-compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.override.yml)
[ -d "$SRC" ] || { echo "source library missing: $SRC"; exit 2; }
mkdir -p "$DST"
cp -a "$OVR" "$BAK"
echo '=== initial copy while online ==='
rsync -aH --partial --inplace "$SRC"/ "$DST"/
echo '=== stop MediaCMS writers only ==='
"${COMPOSE[@]}" stop web celery_short celery_worker celery_beat || true
sleep 2
echo '=== final delta ==='
rsync -aH --delete "$SRC"/ "$DST"/
VERIFY=$(mktemp); rsync -aHn --delete --itemize-changes "$SRC"/ "$DST"/ > "$VERIFY"; D=$(wc -l < "$VERIFY"); echo "delta_lines=$D"; [ "$D" -eq 0 ] || { head -80 "$VERIFY"; rm -f "$VERIFY"; exit 3; }; rm -f "$VERIFY"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/var/www/xavi/mediacms/docker-compose.override.yml')
s=p.read_text(); old='/datastore2/media_files/library'; new='/datastore2/xavi/data/mediacms/library'
n=s.count(old); print('replacing_bind_refs=',n)
if n < 4: raise SystemExit('expected at least four active library bind refs')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
echo '=== recreate MediaCMS app/celery on new bind ==='
if ! "${COMPOSE[@]}" up -d web celery_short celery_worker celery_beat; then
  echo 'recreate failed; restoring compose override'
  cp -a "$BAK" "$OVR"
  "${COMPOSE[@]}" up -d web celery_short celery_worker celery_beat || true
  exit 4
fi
sleep 8
echo '=== verify live mounts ==='
BAD=0
for c in mediacms_web_1 mediacms_celery_short_1 mediacms_celery_worker_1 mediacms_celery_beat_1; do
  M=$(podman inspect "$c" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/home/mediacms.io/mediacms/media_files"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null || true)
  echo "$c|$M"
  [ "$M" = "$DST" ] || BAD=1
done
if [ "$BAD" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo 'mount verification failed; old library retained'
  exit 5
fi
printf 'web_http='; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8000/ 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf "$SRC"
rm -f "$BAK"
echo '=== final ==='
du -sh "$DST"
[ ! -e "$SRC" ] && echo old_library_removed=yes
echo MEDIACMS_DATALAKE_CUTOVER=ok

argv:

for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8001/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done
printf 'mediacms_local='; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:8001/ || true

echo '=== mounts ==='

echo RESTORE_STACKS=ok

repair_stale_rootless_wgrnn_mediacms_081.title: Repair stale WG-RNN MediaCMS containers
repair_stale_rootless_wgrnn_mediacms_081.description: Inspect and remove only stale WG-RNN/MediaCMS rootless container objects whose crun runtime state is invalid, then recreate runtime and MediaCMS from persistent definitions and verify health.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
M=/var/www/xavi/mediacms
MARK=/var/www/xavi/updates/.podman-deploy-priority
mkdir -p /var/www/xavi/updates; echo "repair-stale-rootless $(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > "$MARK"; trap 'rm -f "$MARK"' EXIT

echo '=== stale objects ==='
podman ps -a --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}|{{.ID}}' | grep -E '^(duotronic-runtime|mediacms_)' || true

echo '=== remove stale runtime object only ==='
podman rm -f duotronic-runtime 2>/dev/null || true

echo '=== recreate WG-RNN runtime ==='
cd "$R"
./ops_agent/v3_maintenance/restart_runtime_only.sh || true
for i in $(seq 1 80); do curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8080/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done
printf 'runtime_http='; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 6 http://127.0.0.1:8080/health || true

echo '=== remove stale MediaCMS app objects only ==='
for c in mediacms_web_1 mediacms_celery_short_1 mediacms_celery_worker_1 mediacms_celery_beat_1 mediacms_db_1 mediacms_redis_1; do podman rm -f "$c" 2>/dev/null || true; done

echo '=== recreate MediaCMS ==='
cd "$M"
podman-compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.override.yml up -d db redis web celery_short celery_worker celery_beat
for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8001/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done
printf 'mediacms_local='; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:8001/ || true
printf 'mediacms_public='; curl -k -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 10 https://127.0.0.1/media/ -H 'Host: xavi.app' || true

echo '=== final relevant containers ==='
podman ps --format '{{.Names}}|{{.Status}}|{{.Ports}}' | grep -E '^(duotronic-runtime|mediacms_)' || true

echo ROOTLESS_STALE_REPAIR=ok

find_real_external_embed_source_v2_0812.description: Find one existing social/music text artifact in the canonical data lake containing a supported external media URL, from an allowlisted working directory.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
root=Path('/datastore2/xavi/data')
roots=[root/'social',root/'music',root/'facebook_data',root/'facebook']
pat=re.compile(r'''https?://[^\s<>"']*(?:youtube\.com|youtu\.be|vimeo\.com|soundcloud\.com|open\.spotify\.com|archive\.org)[^\s<>"']*''',re.I)
exts={'.txt','.md','.json','.jsonl','.html','.htm','.csv','.xml','.yaml','.yml','.lrc','.srt','.vtt'}
trail='.,;:!?)]}' + '"' + "'"
for base in roots:
    if not base.exists(): continue
    for p in base.rglob('*'):
        try: st=p.stat()
        except Exception: continue
        if not p.is_file() or p.suffix.lower() not in exts or st.st_size>20_000_000: continue
        try: text=p.read_bytes()[:3_000_000].decode('utf-8','ignore')
        except Exception: continue
        m=pat.search(text)
        if m:
            url=m.group(0).rstrip(trail)
            host=url.split('/')[2].lower() if '://' in url else ''
            provider='youtube' if ('youtube' in host or 'youtu.be' in host) else ('vimeo' if 'vimeo' in host else ('soundcloud' if 'soundcloud' in host else ('spotify' if 'spotify' in host else 'internet-archive')))
            print('relative_path='+p.relative_to(root).as_posix())
            print('provider='+provider)
            print('url='+url)
            raise SystemExit(0)
print('none_found')
PY

argv:
set -euo pipefail
F=/var/www/xavi/mediacms/files/management/commands/sync_xavi_datalake.py
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/var/www/xavi/mediacms/files/management/commands/sync_xavi_datalake.py'); s=p.read_text()
old="""        p.add_argument('--external-limit',type=int,default=50)
        p.add_argument('--include-images',action='store_true')
"""
new="""        p.add_argument('--external-limit',type=int,default=50)
        p.add_argument('--source-rel',default='',help='Process one exact path relative to the data-lake root.')
        p.add_argument('--include-images',action='store_true')
"""
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('argument anchor missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old="""        root=Path(opt['root']).resolve(); media_root=Path(settings.MEDIA_ROOT).resolve()
        if not root.is_dir(): raise CommandError(f'data lake unavailable: {root}')
"""
new="""        root=Path(opt['root']).resolve(); media_root=Path(settings.MEDIA_ROOT).resolve()
        if not root.is_dir(): raise CommandError(f'data lake unavailable: {root}')
        self.source_rel=str(opt.get('source_rel') or '').strip().lstrip('/')
        if self.source_rel:
            candidate=(root/self.source_rel).resolve()
            try: candidate.relative_to(root)
            except ValueError: raise CommandError('source-rel escapes data-lake root')
            if not candidate.is_file(): raise CommandError(f'source-rel not found: {self.source_rel}')
"""
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('handle root anchor missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old="""    def walk(self,root):
        for base,dirs,files in os.walk(root,followlinks=False):
"""
new="""    def walk(self,root):
        if getattr(self,'source_rel',''):
            p=(root/self.source_rel).resolve()
            yield p,p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            return
        for base,dirs,files in os.walk(root,followlinks=False):
"""
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('walk anchor missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
print('source-rel added')
PY

echo '=== healthcheck units ==='
systemctl --user list-units --all --no-pager | grep -Ei 'health|libpod|podman' | head -260 || true
echo '=== podman healthcheck processes ==='
ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,etimes,cmd | grep '/usr/bin/podman healthcheck run' | grep -v grep | sort -k4nr | head -160 || true
echo '=== other short-lived podman clients ==='
ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,etimes,cmd | grep -E '(^| )podman (ps|inspect|network|create|start|stop|rm|events|container|compose)' | grep -v grep | sort -k4nr | head -120 || true

clear_podman_lock_convoy_0812.title: Clear Podman lock convoy
clear_podman_lock_convoy_0812.description: Set deployment priority, stop active Witness qualification sandbox processes, temporarily stop generated rootless Podman healthcheck timer invocations, and terminate only stuck healthcheck/inspect/network client processes without stopping application containers.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
MARK=/var/www/xavi/updates/.podman-deploy-priority
mkdir -p /var/www/xavi/updates
printf 'mediacms-datalake-maintenance %s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > "$MARK"
echo 'deployment_priority=on'

echo '=== stop active witness qualification clients ==='
PIDS=$(ps -eo pid=,cmd= | awk '/dwc-qual-|duotronic-wc-gates-|activation-harness:5\.3\.17/ && $0 !~ /awk/ {print $1}' | sort -nr | tr '\n' ' ')
[ -z "$PIDS" ] || { echo "qualification_pids=$PIDS"; kill -TERM $PIDS 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 2; }
REM=$(ps -eo pid=,cmd= | awk '/dwc-qual-|duotronic-wc-gates-|activation-harness:5\.3\.17/ && $0 !~ /awk/ {print $1}' | sort -nr | tr '\n' ' ')
[ -z "$REM" ] || kill -KILL $REM 2>/dev/null || true

echo '=== stop generated healthcheck timers ==='
TIMERS=$(systemctl --user list-units --type=timer --all --no-legend | awk '$1 ~ /^[0-9a-f]{64}\.timer$/ {print $1}')
if [ -n "$TIMERS" ]; then
  echo "$TIMERS" | head -80
  systemctl --user stop $TIMERS || true
fi

echo '=== terminate stuck healthcheck podman clients only ==='
HPIDS=$(ps -eo pid=,cmd= | awk '$0 ~ /\/usr\/bin\/podman healthcheck run [0-9a-f]+/ {print $1}' | tr '\n' ' ')
[ -z "$HPIDS" ] || { echo "healthcheck_pids=$HPIDS"; kill -TERM $HPIDS 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; kill -KILL $HPIDS 2>/dev/null || true; }

echo '=== terminate stale short-lived inspect/network clients ==='
SPIDS=$(ps -eo pid=,etimes=,cmd= | awk '$2>5 && ($0 ~ /podman inspect duotronic-runtime/ || $0 ~ /podman network exists xavi-searx-egress/ || $0 ~ /podman inspect redis8885/) {print $1}' | tr '\n' ' ')
[ -z "$SPIDS" ] || { echo "short_client_pids=$SPIDS"; kill -TERM $SPIDS 2>/dev/null || true; }
sleep 2

echo '=== remaining relevant podman clients ==='
ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,etimes,cmd | grep -E 'dwc-qual-|duotronic-wc-gates-|activation-harness:5\.3\.17|podman healthcheck run|podman inspect duotronic-runtime|podman network exists xavi-searx-egress' | grep -v grep | head -100 || true
echo PODMAN_LOCK_CONVOY_CLEARED=ok

restart_stuck_wgrnn_runtime_0812.description: Restart only duotronic-runtime with a short stop timeout to clear Uvicorn stuck in graceful shutdown, then verify host health, data-lake mount, and new data-lake MCP tools.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3

done

import json,sys
try:d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print('health_payload=',d.get('status',d.get('ok',d)))
except Exception: pass
PY
rm -f /tmp/wgrnn-health.$$

echo '=== state/mount ==='
podman inspect duotronic-runtime --format 'status={{.State.Status}} health={{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{end}}'
podman inspect duotronic-runtime --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/data-lake"}}{{println .Source "->" .Destination "rw=" .RW}}{{end}}{{end}}'
podman exec duotronic-runtime sh -lc 'test -d /data-lake && echo datalake_visible=yes; test ! -w /data-lake && echo datalake_readonly=yes; test -d /data-lake/social && echo social_visible=yes; test -d /data-lake/music && echo music_visible=yes; test -d /data-lake/mediacms/library && echo mediacms_visible=yes'

echo '=== MCP tools ==='
KEY=$(podman inspect duotronic-runtime --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | awk -F= '$1=="XAVI_MCP_API_KEY"{sub(/^[^=]*=/,"");print;exit}')
python3 - "$KEY" <<'PY'
import json,sys,urllib.request
key=sys.argv[1]
body=json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/list','params':{}}).encode()
req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp',data=body,headers={'content-type':'application/json','x-xavi-mcp-key':key},method='POST')
d=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10).read())
names={t['name'] for t in d['result']['tools']}
for n in ['runtime.autonomy_ingest_artifact','runtime.datalake_observe','runtime.datalake_pattern','runtime.experiment_next','runtime.experiment_observe']:
    print(n,'yes' if n in names else 'NO')
assert {'runtime.autonomy_ingest_artifact','runtime.datalake_observe','runtime.datalake_pattern'} <= names
PY
echo WGRNN_RUNTIME_RESTART=ok

argv:

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3/ops_agent/wgrnn_datalake_ingest.py')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("SECRET=re.compile(r'(^|[._-])(secret|token|password|passwd|credential|private|jwt|enrollment)([._-]|$)',re.I)",
            "SECRET=re.compile(r'(^|[._-])(secret|token|password|passwd|credential|private|jwt|enrollment|cookie|cookies|session|auth|key)([._-]|$)',re.I)")
old="""def cat(rel):
    s=Path(rel).suffix.lower(); low=rel.lower()
    if SECRET.search(Path(rel).name) or Path(rel).name in {'.env','.enrollment_secret'}: return 'sealed'
    if s in DBEXT: return 'database'
    if s in TEXT: return 'text'
    if s in IMAGE: return 'image'
    if s in AUDIO: return 'audio'
    if s in VIDEO: return 'video'
    if s in ARCHIVE: return 'archive'
    if 'facebook' in low or '/social/' in '/'+low: return 'social-data'
    return 'binary'
"""
new="""def cat(rel):
    path=Path(rel); s=path.suffix.lower(); low=rel.lower(); name=path.name.lower()
    if name.startswith('.env') or SECRET.search(name) or name == '.enrollment_secret': return 'sealed'
    # Preserve database semantics even for timestamped/backup names such as
    # facebook_data.sqlite.bak.20260406.
    if s in DBEXT or re.search(r'\\.(?:sqlite|sqlite3|db)(?:\\.|$)',name): return 'database'
    if s in TEXT: return 'text'
    if s in IMAGE: return 'image'
    if s in AUDIO: return 'audio'
    if s in VIDEO: return 'video'
    if s in ARCHIVE: return 'archive'
    # Unknown social files remain eligible but are not assumed to be text.
    if 'facebook' in low or '/social/' in '/'+low: return 'social-data'
    return 'binary'
"""
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('cat block missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old="""def priority(category,rel):
    parts={part.lower() for part in Path(rel).parts}
    # Keep these eligible but do not let dependency trees or secrets crowd out
    # the operator's actual history/evidence during the first learning passes.
    if parts & LOW_VALUE_DIRS: return 98
    if Path(rel).name.lower() in {'package.json','package-lock.json','yarn.lock','pnpm-lock.yaml'}: return 97
    if category=='sealed': return 99
    low=rel.lower(); ordered=[part.lower() for part in Path(rel).parts]
    if 'facebook' in ordered or 'facebook_data' in ordered or (ordered and ordered[0]=='social' and 'extracted' in ordered): return 5
    if ordered and ordered[0]=='music': return 8
    if ordered and ordered[0]=='social': return 12
    return {'text':15,'database':16,'social-data':18,'image':30,'audio':40,'video':55,'archive':70,'binary':90}.get(category,80)
"""
new="""def priority(category,rel):
    path=Path(rel); parts={part.lower() for part in path.parts}; ordered=[part.lower() for part in path.parts]; name=path.name.lower()
    # Keep generated/dependency material eligible, but far behind authored data.
    if parts & LOW_VALUE_DIRS: return 98
    if name in {'.gitignore','.gitattributes','package.json','package-lock.json','yarn.lock','pnpm-lock.yaml'}: return 97
    if category=='sealed': return 99
    is_facebook=('facebook' in ordered or 'facebook_data' in ordered or (ordered and ordered[0]=='social' and 'facebook' in rel.lower()))
    if is_facebook:
        return {'text':5,'database':5,'social-data':9,'image':20,'audio':25,'video':30,'binary':60,'archive':75}.get(category,60)
    if ordered and ordered[0]=='music':
        return {'text':8,'database':10,'audio':18,'video':20,'image':24,'social-data':25,'binary':55,'archive':75}.get(category,55)
    if ordered and ordered[0]=='social':
        return {'text':12,'database':12,'social-data':16,'image':25,'audio':30,'video':35,'binary':60,'archive':78}.get(category,60)
    return {'text':15,'database':16,'social-data':18,'image':30,'audio':40,'video':55,'archive':80,'binary':90}.get(category,80)
"""
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('priority block missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old="transient=('Connection refused' in msg or 'timed out' in msg.lower() or 'Temporary failure' in msg or 'Remote end closed' in msg or 'XAVI_MCP_API_KEY' in msg)"
new="lowmsg=msg.lower(); transient=('connection refused' in lowmsg or 'connection reset' in lowmsg or 'broken pipe' in lowmsg or 'connection aborted' in lowmsg or 'timed out' in lowmsg or 'temporary failure' in lowmsg or 'remote end closed' in lowmsg or 'xavi_mcp_api_key' in lowmsg)"
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('transient block missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
print('worker classifier/priority/transient policy patched')
PY
/var/www/xavi/.venv/bin/python -Werror -m py_compile "$F"
python3 - <<'PY'

p='/datastore2/xavi/wgrnn-datalake/ingest.sqlite3'; c=sqlite3.connect(p)
n=c.execute("update files set stage='new',attempts=0,last_error=NULL where lower(coalesce(last_error,'')) like '%connectionreset%' or lower(coalesce(last_error,'')) like '%connection reset%'").rowcount
c.commit(); print('reset_connection_reset_rows=',n)

sleep 2
systemctl --user is-active xavi-wgrnn-datalake-ingest.service

patch_mediacms_datalake_admin_owner_0812.title: Assign data-lake media to admin
patch_mediacms_datalake_admin_owner_0812.description: Patch the MediaCMS data-lake importer to require and assign the configured admin user as owner for all managed local/external entries, then compile the command.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
F=/var/www/xavi/mediacms/files/management/commands/sync_xavi_datalake.py
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/var/www/xavi/mediacms/files/management/commands/sync_xavi_datalake.py')
s=p.read_text()
# Replace permissive user resolution with explicit configured admin ownership.
old="""        user=self.get_user(opt.get('user') or '')\n"""
new="""        user=self.get_user(opt.get('user') or '')\n        if not user:\n            raise CommandError('MediaCMS data-lake import requires a configured admin owner')\n"""
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('user resolution anchor missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
# Ensure newly created local managed media uses resolved admin user.
old="""                media=Media(user=user,title=src.stem,description=f'Xavi data-lake source: {rel}',xavi_managed=True,xavi_source_kind='datalake-file',xavi_source_path=rel,xavi_source_digest=digest)\n"""
if old not in s:
    # show likely constructors to avoid blind edits
    for line in s.splitlines():
        if 'Media(' in line and 'xavi_managed=True' in line:
            print('candidate',line.strip())
    raise SystemExit('local constructor anchor missing')
# already includes user=user; keep as explicit proof
# Ensure external constructor also uses user=user.
old2="""                        media=Media(user=user,title=obj['title'],description=f'External media referenced by {rel}',xavi_managed=True,xavi_source_kind='external-embed-ref',xavi_source_path=rel,xavi_external_url=obj['url'],xavi_external_provider=obj['provider'],xavi_external_embed_url=obj['embed'])\n"""
if old2 not in s:
    for line in s.splitlines():
        if 'Media(' in line and 'external-embed-ref' in line:
            print('external_candidate',line.strip())
    raise SystemExit('external constructor anchor missing')
# Add owner correction for existing managed matches encountered on rescan.
old3="""                if existing:\n                    media=existing\n"""
new3="""                if existing:\n                    media=existing\n                    if media.user_id != user.id:\n                        Media.objects.filter(pk=media.pk).update(user=user)\n                        media.refresh_from_db(fields=['user'])\n"""
if old3 not in s:
    raise SystemExit('existing local anchor missing')
s=s.replace(old3,new3,1)
old4="""                    if media:\n                        created_id=media.id\n"""
new4="""                    if media:\n                        if media.user_id != user.id:\n                            Media.objects.filter(pk=media.pk).update(user=user)\n                            media.refresh_from_db(fields=['user'])\n                        created_id=media.id\n"""
if old4 not in s:
    # external existing block may differ; print context for next pass
    idx=s.find("media=Media.objects.filter(xavi_managed=True,xavi_external_url=obj['url'])")
    print(s[idx:idx+900])
    raise SystemExit('existing external anchor missing')
s=s.replace(old4,new4,1)
p.write_text(s)
print('admin ownership policy patched')
PY
python3 -Werror -m py_compile "$F"
grep -nE 'requires a configured admin owner|user=user|media.user_id != user.id' "$F" | head -40
echo MEDIACMS_DATALAKE_ADMIN_OWNER_POLICY=ok

argv:

if old not in s: raise SystemExit('external existing anchor missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)

PY

if old in s: s=s.replace(old,new,1)

print('timer service owner explicitly set to tbi')
PY

install_health_supervisors_0812b.title: Install real health supervisors
install_health_supervisors_0812b.description: Replace broken oneshot/RemainAfterExit units for WG-RNN runtime, MediaCMS, Morphic and LibreChat with long-running HTTP health supervisors that perform non-destructive start/restart recovery first and compose recreation only as fallback.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
S=/var/www/xavi/updates/xavi-core-stack-supervisor.sh
cat > "$S" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
STACK="${1:?stack required}"
INTERVAL="${XAVI_SUPERVISOR_INTERVAL:-15}"
FAIL_LIMIT="${XAVI_SUPERVISOR_FAIL_LIMIT:-2}"
LOCK="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/xavi-podman-recovery.lock"
log(){ printf '%s [%s] %s\n' "$(date -Is)" "$STACK" "$*"; }
health_url(){
 case "$STACK" in
  runtime) echo 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/health' ;;
  mediacms) echo 'http://127.0.0.1:8001/' ;;
  morphic) echo 'http://127.0.0.1:8550/morphic-app/' ;;
  librechat) echo 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/chat/app/' ;;
  *) return 2;;
 esac
}
healthy(){ curl -fsS -o /dev/null --max-time 5 "$(health_url)"; }
pexists(){ timeout 8 podman container exists "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
pstart(){ local c=$1; pexists "$c" && timeout 30 podman start "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
prestart(){ local c=$1; pexists "$c" && timeout 40 podman restart -t 10 "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
wait_health(){ local n=${1:-20}; for _ in $(seq 1 "$n"); do healthy && return 0; sleep 2; done; return 1; }
recover_runtime(){
 pstart duotronic-postgres; pstart duotronic-redis; sleep 3
 if pexists duotronic-runtime; then prestart duotronic-runtime; else :; fi
 wait_health 20 && return 0
 log 'targeted restart failed; recreating runtime container'
 timeout 240 bash /var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3/ops_agent/v3_maintenance/restart_runtime_only.sh >/tmp/xavi-supervisor-runtime.log 2>&1 || true
 wait_health 25
}
recover_mediacms(){
 pstart mediacms_db_1; pstart mediacms_redis_1; sleep 5
 pstart mediacms_celery_short_1; pstart mediacms_celery_worker_1; pstart mediacms_celery_beat_1
 if pexists mediacms_web_1; then prestart mediacms_web_1; fi
 wait_health 20 && return 0
 log 'targeted start failed; invoking compose up fallback'
 timeout 240 bash -lc 'cd /var/www/xavi/mediacms && podman-compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.override.yml up -d' >/tmp/xavi-supervisor-mediacms.log 2>&1 || true
 wait_health 30
}
recover_morphic(){
 pstart xavi-morphic_postgres_1; pstart xavi-morphic_redis_1; sleep 4
 if pexists xavi-morphic_morphic_1; then prestart xavi-morphic_morphic_1; else :; fi
 wait_health 20 && return 0
 log 'targeted start failed; invoking compose up fallback'
 timeout 240 bash -lc 'cd /var/www/xavi/morphic && podman-compose --env-file .env.local -f compose.xavi.yaml up -d' >/tmp/xavi-supervisor-morphic.log 2>&1 || true
 wait_health 30
}
recover_librechat(){
 for c in chat-mongodb chat-redis chat-meilisearch vectordb xavi-ollama-guard xavi-code-interpreter-mcp; do pstart "$c"; done
 sleep 5; pstart rag_api
 if pexists LibreChat; then prestart LibreChat; else :; fi
 wait_health 20 && return 0
 log 'targeted start failed; invoking compose up fallback'
 timeout 240 bash -lc 'cd /var/www/xavi/librechat && podman-compose -f compose.podman.yaml up -d' >/tmp/xavi-supervisor-librechat.log 2>&1 || true
 wait_health 30
}
recover(){
 mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOCK")"
 if ! flock -w 180 "$LOCK" bash -c 'exit 0'; then log 'recovery lock unavailable'; return 1; fi
 # Hold the shared lock for the whole recovery through fd 9.
 exec 9>"$LOCK"
 if ! flock -w 180 9; then log 'recovery lock unavailable'; exec 9>&-; return 1; fi
 log 'recovery starting'
 case "$STACK" in
  runtime) recover_runtime;; mediacms) recover_mediacms;; morphic) recover_morphic;; librechat) recover_librechat;;
 esac
 local rc=$?
 if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then log 'recovery healthy'; else log 'recovery still unhealthy'; fi
 flock -u 9; exec 9>&-
 return "$rc"
}
trap 'log supervisor-stopping; exit 0' TERM INT
log "supervisor-start url=$(health_url)"
fails=0
while :; do
 if healthy; then
  if [ "$fails" -gt 0 ]; then log 'health restored'; fi
  fails=0
 else
  fails=$((fails+1)); log "health failure $fails/$FAIL_LIMIT"
  if [ "$fails" -ge "$FAIL_LIMIT" ]; then recover || true; fails=0; fi
 fi
 sleep "$INTERVAL" & wait $!
done
EOF
chmod 755 "$S"
U=/home/tbi/.config/systemd/user
cat > "$U/xavi-duotronic-runtime.service" <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Xavi Duotronic Runtime v3 Health Supervisor
After=network-online.target podman.socket
Wants=network-online.target podman.socket

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=$S runtime
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStartSec=0
TimeoutStopSec=30
KillMode=control-group

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
EOF
cat > "$U/mediacms.service" <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Rootless MediaCMS Health Supervisor
After=network-online.target podman.socket
Wants=network-online.target podman.socket

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=$S mediacms
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStartSec=0
TimeoutStopSec=30
KillMode=control-group

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
EOF
cat > "$U/xavi-morphic.service" <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Xavi Morphic Health Supervisor
After=network-online.target podman.socket
Wants=network-online.target podman.socket

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=$S morphic
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStartSec=0
TimeoutStopSec=30
KillMode=control-group

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
EOF
cat > "$U/xavi-librechat.service" <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Xavi LibreChat Health Supervisor
After=network-online.target podman.socket
Wants=network-online.target podman.socket

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=$S librechat
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStartSec=0
TimeoutStopSec=30
KillMode=control-group

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
EOF
systemctl --user daemon-reload
for u in xavi-duotronic-runtime.service mediacms.service xavi-morphic.service xavi-librechat.service; do systemctl --user enable "$u" >/dev/null; systemctl --user restart "$u"; done
sleep 2
for u in xavi-duotronic-runtime.service mediacms.service xavi-morphic.service xavi-librechat.service; do printf '%s|' "$u"; systemctl --user show "$u" -p Type -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Restart --value | tr '\n' '|'; echo; done
echo HEALTH_SUPERVISORS_INSTALLED=ok

argv:

S=/var/www/xavi/updates/xavi-core-stack-supervisor.sh
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/var/www/xavi/updates/xavi-core-stack-supervisor.sh'); s=p.read_text()
old="timeout 240 bash /var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3/ops_agent/v3_maintenance/restart_runtime_only.sh >/tmp/xavi-supervisor-runtime.log 2>&1 || true"

if old not in s and new not in s: raise SystemExit('runtime fallback anchor missing')

p.write_text(s)
print('nested lock bypass patched')
PY

harden_supervisors_for_stale_stopping_08.title: Harden stale container recovery
harden_supervisors_for_stale_stopping_08.description: Teach core health supervisors to detect Podman containers stuck in stopping with a dead init PID, remove only that stale object, and recreate the affected frontend/runtime rather than looping forever.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
S=/var/www/xavi/updates/xavi-core-stack-supervisor.sh
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/var/www/xavi/updates/xavi-core-stack-supervisor.sh'); s=p.read_text()
anchor="pexists(){ timeout 8 podman container exists \"$1\" >/dev/null 2>&1; }\n"
insert=anchor+'''stale_cleanup(){
 local c=$1 state pid
 pexists "$c" || return 1
 state=$(timeout 8 podman inspect "$c" --format '{{.State.Status}}' 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
 pid=$(timeout 8 podman inspect "$c" --format '{{.State.Pid}}' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
 if [ "$state" = stopping ] && { [ "$pid" = 0 ] || ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; }; then
  log "stale stopping object detected: $c pid=$pid"
  timeout 40 podman rm -f -t 0 "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  pexists "$c" && return 1 || return 0
 fi
 return 1
}
'''
if anchor not in s: raise SystemExit('pexists anchor missing')
s=s.replace(anchor,insert,1)
# Call stale cleanup before targeted starts/restarts of critical frontends.
s=s.replace('recover_runtime(){\n pstart duotronic-postgres;', 'recover_runtime(){\n stale_cleanup duotronic-runtime || true\n pstart duotronic-postgres;',1)
s=s.replace('recover_mediacms(){\n pstart mediacms_db_1;', 'recover_mediacms(){\n stale_cleanup mediacms_web_1 || true\n pstart mediacms_db_1;',1)
s=s.replace(" if pexists mediacms_web_1; then prestart mediacms_web_1; fi\n wait_health 20", " if pexists mediacms_web_1; then prestart mediacms_web_1; else timeout 120 bash -lc 'cd /var/www/xavi/mediacms && podman-compose -f docker-compose.yaml -f docker-compose.override.yml up -d --no-deps web' >/tmp/xavi-supervisor-mediacms-web.log 2>&1 || true; fi\n wait_health 20",1)
s=s.replace('recover_morphic(){\n pstart xavi-morphic_postgres_1;', 'recover_morphic(){\n stale_cleanup xavi-morphic_morphic_1 || true\n pstart xavi-morphic_postgres_1;',1)
s=s.replace('recover_librechat(){\n for c in chat-mongodb', 'recover_librechat(){\n stale_cleanup LibreChat || true\n for c in chat-mongodb',1)
s=s.replace(" if pexists LibreChat; then prestart LibreChat; else :; fi\n wait_health 20", " if pexists LibreChat; then prestart LibreChat; else timeout 120 bash -lc 'cd /var/www/xavi/librechat && podman-compose -f compose.podman.yaml up -d --no-deps api' >/tmp/xavi-supervisor-librechat-api.log 2>&1 || true; fi\n wait_health 20",1)
p.write_text(s)
print('stale stopping recovery hardened')
PY
bash -n "$S"
systemctl --user restart xavi-duotronic-runtime.service mediacms.service xavi-morphic.service xavi-librechat.service
sleep 2
for u in xavi-duotronic-runtime.service mediacms.service xavi-morphic.service xavi-librechat.service; do printf '%s=' "$u"; systemctl --user is-active "$u"; done
echo SUPERVISOR_STALE_HARDENING=ok

argv:

  sleep 5

echo MEDIACMS_SUPERVISOR_RECOVERY=ok

argv:
set -euo pipefail
F=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3/ops_agent/wgrnn_datalake_ingest.py
python3 - <<'PY'

p=Path('/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3/ops_agent/wgrnn_datalake_ingest.py'); s=p.read_text()
anchor="LOW_VALUE_DIRS={'node_modules','.git','.svn','.hg','__pycache__','.pytest_cache','.mypy_cache','.ruff_cache','.cache','venv','.venv','dist','build'}\n"
insert=anchor+"""LOW_VALUE_PREFIXES=(
    'social/facebook/fbscrape/',
    'social/facebook/scrape-logs/',
    'social/facebook/debug_',
    'social/bluesky/',
)
SEALED_SOCIAL_SEGMENTS={
    'security_and_login_information','password_and_security','login_and_password',
    'two_factor_authentication','two-factor_authentication','account_recovery',
    'login_protection_data','ip_address_activity','where_you_are_logged_in',
}
SEALED_SOCIAL_NAMES={
    'two_factor_authentication.html','two-factor_authentication.html','ip_address_activity.html',
    'login_protection_data.html','your_recent_profile_recovery_successes.html',
    'passwords.html','saved_login_information.html','login_activity.html',
}
"""
if anchor not in s: raise SystemExit('low value anchor missing')
s=s.replace(anchor,insert,1)
old="""def cat(rel):
    path=Path(rel); s=path.suffix.lower(); low=rel.lower(); name=path.name.lower()
    if name.startswith('.env') or SECRET.search(name) or name == '.enrollment_secret': return 'sealed'
"""
new="""def cat(rel):
    path=Path(rel); s=path.suffix.lower(); low=rel.lower(); name=path.name.lower(); parts={x.lower() for x in path.parts}
    if name.startswith('.env') or SECRET.search(name) or name == '.enrollment_secret': return 'sealed'
    # Personal security/account-recovery exports are useful historical facts,
    # but their plaintext is capability-sensitive. Witness path/hash/time only.
    if parts & SEALED_SOCIAL_SEGMENTS or name in SEALED_SOCIAL_NAMES: return 'sealed'
"""
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('cat anchor missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old="""    # Keep generated/dependency material eligible, but far behind authored data.
    if parts & LOW_VALUE_DIRS: return 98
    if name in {'.gitignore','.gitattributes','package.json','package-lock.json','yarn.lock','pnpm-lock.yaml'}: return 97
"""
new="""    # Keep generated/dependency/scraper implementation material eligible, but
    # far behind authored/exported evidence. It can still be inspected later.
    if parts & LOW_VALUE_DIRS: return 98
    lowrel=rel.lower()
    if any(lowrel.startswith(prefix) for prefix in LOW_VALUE_PREFIXES): return 96
    if name in {'.gitignore','.gitattributes','package.json','package-lock.json','yarn.lock','pnpm-lock.yaml'}: return 97
"""
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('priority generated anchor missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
s=s.replace("px=list(im.getdata()); n=max(1,len(px))","px=list(im.get_flattened_data() if hasattr(im,'get_flattened_data') else im.getdata()); n=max(1,len(px))",1)
p.write_text(s)
print('social ingest policy refined')
PY
/var/www/xavi/.venv/bin/python -Werror -m py_compile "$F"
