fix_librechat_mcp_and_interpreter_0812c.title: Fix LibreChat MCP connectivity
fix_librechat_mcp_and_interpreter_0812c.description: Patch LibreChat runtime MCP URL to the authenticated token path using existing environment interpolation, recreate only the code-interpreter MCP container to restore host port 8000, restart only LibreChat API, and verify both MCP servers initialize.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
LC=/var/www/xavi/librechat
CFG="$LC/librechat.yaml"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/var/www/xavi/librechat/librechat.yaml'); s=p.read_text()
old='    url: https://api.xavi.app/mcp\n'
new='    url: https://api.xavi.app/mcp/${XAVI_MCP_AUTH_KEY}\n'
if old not in s and new not in s: raise SystemExit('xavi MCP URL anchor missing')
if old in s: s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
print('runtime MCP URL now token-path via env interpolation')
PY
# Never print expanded URL/key.
grep -nE '^  xavi:|^  xavi-code-interpreter:|^[[:space:]]+url:' "$CFG" | sed -E 's#(mcp/)\$\{XAVI_MCP_AUTH_KEY\}#\1<env-token>#'

LOCK=${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/xavi-podman-recovery.lock
exec 9>"$LOCK"; flock -w 30 9
# Recreate only interpreter: its app is running internally but host 8000 forwarding is absent.
timeout 45 podman rm -f -t 0 xavi-code-interpreter-mcp >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
timeout 160 bash -lc 'cd /var/www/xavi/librechat && podman-compose -f compose.podman.yaml up -d --no-deps xavi-code-interpreter-mcp' >/tmp/interpreter-recreate.log 2>&1 || true
for _ in $(seq 1 25); do ss -H -ltn | grep -q ':8000 ' && break; sleep 2; done
printf 'host_8000='; ss -H -ltn | grep -q ':8000 ' && echo yes || echo no
# Restart only LibreChat API so it reloads YAML and reinitializes MCP registry.
timeout 50 podman restart -t 10 LibreChat >/dev/null
for _ in $(seq 1 35); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null --max-time 4 http://127.0.0.1:3080/chat/app/ && break; sleep 2; done
flock -u 9; exec 9>&-
ENV="$LC/.env"; KEY=$(grep -m1 '^XAVI_MCP_AUTH_KEY=' "$ENV" | cut -d= -f2-)
[ -n "$KEY" ]
printf 'runtime_mcp_auth='; curl -k -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 8 -X POST "https://127.0.0.1/mcp/$KEY" -H 'Host: api.xavi.app' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -H 'MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-06-18' --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"acceptance","version":"1"}}}'
printf 'interpreter_mcp_auth='; curl -k -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 8 -X POST https://127.0.0.1/mcp/interpreter -H 'Host: api.xavi.app' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -H 'MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-06-18' --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"acceptance","version":"1"}}}'
printf 'librechat='; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:3080/chat/app/
echo '=== new MCP log summary ==='
timeout 8 podman logs --since 90s LibreChat 2>&1 | grep -E '\[MCP\]|MCPServersRegistry|Initialized with' | sed -E 's#https://api\.xavi\.app/mcp/[^ ]+#https://api.xavi.app/mcp/<redacted>#g' | tail -80 || true
echo LIBRECHAT_MCP_CONNECTIVITY=ok

install_interpreter_health_supervisor_08.title: Supervise code interpreter MCP
install_interpreter_health_supervisor_08.description: Extend the core supervisor with a dedicated code-interpreter stack that detects missing host port 8000, recreates only the interpreter container if restart cannot restore rootless forwarding, and install it as a Type=simple Restart=always user service.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
S=/var/www/xavi/updates/xavi-core-stack-supervisor.sh
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/var/www/xavi/updates/xavi-core-stack-supervisor.sh'); s=p.read_text()
# Interpreter uses a TCP health check because FastMCP /mcp requires protocol semantics.
old="""healthy(){ curl -fsS -o /dev/null --max-time 5 \"$(health_url)\"; }
"""
new="""healthy(){
 if [ \"$STACK\" = interpreter ]; then timeout 4 bash -c '</dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8000' >/dev/null 2>&1; return $?; fi
 curl -fsS -o /dev/null --max-time 5 \"$(health_url)\"
}
"""
if old not in s and new not in s: raise SystemExit('healthy anchor missing')
if old in s: s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old="""  librechat) echo 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/chat/app/' ;;
  *) return 2;;
"""
new="""  librechat) echo 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/chat/app/' ;;
  interpreter) echo 'tcp://127.0.0.1:8000' ;;
  *) return 2;;
"""
if old not in s and new not in s: raise SystemExit('health_url anchor missing')
if old in s: s=s.replace(old,new,1)
anchor="""recover_librechat(){
"""
if anchor not in s: raise SystemExit('librechat recover anchor missing')
interp="""recover_interpreter(){
 stale_cleanup xavi-code-interpreter-mcp || true
 if pexists xavi-code-interpreter-mcp; then prestart xavi-code-interpreter-mcp; fi
 for _ in $(seq 1 10); do healthy && return 0; sleep 2; done
 log 'interpreter restart did not restore host port; recreating container'
 timeout 45 podman rm -f -t 0 xavi-code-interpreter-mcp >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 timeout 150 bash -lc 'cd /var/www/xavi/librechat && podman-compose -f compose.podman.yaml up -d --no-deps xavi-code-interpreter-mcp' >/tmp/xavi-supervisor-interpreter.log 2>&1 || true
 for _ in $(seq 1 20); do healthy && return 0; sleep 2; done
 return 1
}

"""
if 'recover_interpreter(){' not in s: s=s.replace(anchor,interp+anchor,1)
old="""  runtime) recover_runtime;; mediacms) recover_mediacms;; morphic) recover_morphic;; librechat) recover_librechat;;
"""
new="""  runtime) recover_runtime;; mediacms) recover_mediacms;; morphic) recover_morphic;; librechat) recover_librechat;; interpreter) recover_interpreter;;
"""
if old not in s and new not in s: raise SystemExit('recover case anchor missing')
if old in s: s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
print('interpreter stack added')
PY
bash -n "$S"
U=/home/tbi/.config/systemd/user
cat > "$U/xavi-code-interpreter-mcp.service" <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Xavi Code Interpreter MCP Health Supervisor
After=network-online.target podman.socket
Wants=network-online.target podman.socket

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=$S interpreter
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
TimeoutStartSec=0
TimeoutStopSec=30
KillMode=control-group

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
EOF
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now xavi-code-interpreter-mcp.service >/dev/null
sleep 2
printf 'unit='; systemctl --user is-active xavi-code-interpreter-mcp.service
printf 'port8000='; ss -H -ltn | grep -q ':8000 ' && echo yes || echo no
journalctl --user -u xavi-code-interpreter-mcp.service -n 8 --no-pager
echo INTERPRETER_SUPERVISOR=ok

set -euo pipefail
F=/home/tbi/xavi-wgrnn-node-workloads.py
cp -a "$F" "$F.pre-news-morphic-20260812"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/tbi/xavi-wgrnn-node-workloads.py'); s=p.read_text()
old='SEARCH_URL = os.environ.get("XAVI_NODE_WORK_SEARCH_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8887").rstrip("/")\n'
new=old+'NEWS_URL = os.environ.get("XAVI_NODE_WORK_NEWS_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8535").rstrip("/")\nMORPHIC_SEARCH_URL = os.environ.get("XAVI_NODE_WORK_MORPHIC_SEARCH_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8550/morphic-app/api/advanced-search")\n'
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('SEARCH_URL anchor missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
anchor='\n\ndef _record(result: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n'
if anchor not in s: raise SystemExit('record anchor missing')
functions=r'''

def _news_aggregator_observer(experiment: dict[str, Any], nodes: list[dict[str, str]]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    query = str(experiment.get("question") or experiment.get("hypothesis") or "").strip()
    if not query:
        return None
    url = NEWS_URL + "/api/search?" + urllib.parse.urlencode({"q": query[:400], "limit": 12, "time_range": "month"})
    try:
        evidence = _get_json(url, timeout=18)
    except Exception:
        return None
    articles = evidence.get("articles") or [] if isinstance(evidence, dict) else []
    if not articles:
        return None
    compact_articles = []
    for row in articles[:12]:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        item = {k: row.get(k) for k in ("title", "url", "source", "published_at", "summary", "description", "snippet") if row.get(k) not in (None, "")}
        if item:
            compact_articles.append(item)
    if not compact_articles:
        return None
    compact = {
        "query": query,
        "time_range": evidence.get("time_range"),
        "articles": compact_articles,
        "brief": evidence.get("brief"),
        "clusters": (evidence.get("clusters") or [])[:8],
    }
    digest = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(compact, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()
    interpreted = _interpret_external_evidence(
        experiment=experiment,
        evidence_kind="xavi_news_aggregator",
        evidence=compact,
        source_ref="xavi-news:" + digest,
        nodes=nodes,
    )
    if not interpreted:
        return None
    publishers = sorted({str(row.get("source")) for row in compact_articles if row.get("source")})
    urls = [str(row.get("url")) for row in compact_articles if row.get("url")][:12]
    return call(
        "runtime.experiment_observe",
        {
            "experiment_id": experiment["experiment_id"],
            "observer_id": "xavi-news-aggregator",
            "observer_kind": "news_corpus",
            # Conservative: many articles improve evidence quality, but the
            # aggregator contributes one quorum group in this pass.
            "independence_group": "news-aggregator-corpus",
            "stance": interpreted["stance"],
            "confidence": interpreted["confidence"],
            "observation": interpreted["observation"],
            "source_ref": "xavi-news:" + digest,
            "evidence_refs": urls,
            "measurement": {
                "article_count": len(compact_articles),
                "publishers": publishers,
                "evidence_digest": digest,
                "analysis_id": evidence.get("analysis_id"),
                **interpreted,
            },
            "session_id": SESSION_ID,
        },
    )


def _morphic_search_observer(experiment: dict[str, Any], nodes: list[dict[str, str]]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    query = str(experiment.get("question") or experiment.get("hypothesis") or "").strip()
    if not query:
        return None
    try:
        evidence = _post_json(
            MORPHIC_SEARCH_URL,
            {"query": query[:1200], "maxResults": 8, "searchDepth": "basic", "includeDomains": [], "excludeDomains": []},
            timeout=30,
        )
    except Exception:
        return None
    rows = evidence.get("results") or [] if isinstance(evidence, dict) else []
    if not rows:
        return None
    compact_rows = []
    for row in rows[:8]:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        item = {k: row.get(k) for k in ("title", "url", "content", "snippet", "engine", "engines", "publishedDate", "score") if row.get(k) not in (None, "")}
        if item:
            compact_rows.append(item)
    if not compact_rows:
        return None
    compact = {"query": query, "results": compact_rows}
    digest = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(compact, sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()
    interpreted = _interpret_external_evidence(
        experiment=experiment,
        evidence_kind="morphic_advanced_web_search",
        evidence=compact,
        source_ref="morphic-search:" + digest,
        nodes=nodes,
    )
    if not interpreted:
        return None
    urls = [str(row.get("url")) for row in compact_rows if row.get("url")][:8]
    return call(
        "runtime.experiment_observe",
        {
            "experiment_id": experiment["experiment_id"],
            "observer_id": "morphic-advanced-search",
            "observer_kind": "internet_search_interface",
            # Morphic advanced search is built over the same public web/search
            # substrate as Xavi/SearXNG. It enriches retrieval but does not add
            # another independent quorum vote.
            "independence_group": "public-web-search",
            "stance": interpreted["stance"],
            "confidence": interpreted["confidence"],
            "observation": interpreted["observation"],
            "source_ref": "morphic-search:" + digest,
            "evidence_refs": urls,
            "measurement": {
                "result_count": len(compact_rows),
                "evidence_digest": digest,
                "correlated_with": ["xavi-public-search", "searxng"],
                **interpreted,
            },
            "session_id": SESSION_ID,
        },
    )
'''
s=s.replace(anchor,functions+anchor,1)
old='''        for kind, observer in (("document_corpus", _local_corpus_observer), ("internet_search", _web_search_observer)):
'''
new='''        for kind, observer in (
            ("document_corpus", _local_corpus_observer),
            ("internet_search", _web_search_observer),
            ("news_corpus", _news_aggregator_observer),
            ("morphic_search", _morphic_search_observer),
        ):
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('observer loop anchor missing')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
print('News + Morphic observers patched')
PY
python3 -m py_compile "$F"
grep -nE 'NEWS_URL|MORPHIC_SEARCH_URL|def _news_aggregator_observer|def _morphic_search_observer|news_corpus|morphic_search|independence_group.*public-web-search' "$F" | head -80
systemctl --user daemon-reload
printf 'timer='; systemctl --user is-active xavi-wgrnn-node-workloads.timer || true
echo NEWS_MORPHIC_OBSERVERS_SOURCE=ok

argv:

printf 'before_pg55432='; ss -H -ltn | grep -q ':55432 ' && echo yes || echo no
printf 'before_redis56379='; ss -H -ltn | grep -q ':56379 ' && echo yes || echo no

systemctl --user stop xavi-morphic.service
LOCK=${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/xavi-podman-recovery.lock

fix_librechat_supervisor_api_only_0812f.title: Fix LibreChat supervisor API recovery
fix_librechat_supervisor_api_only_0812f.description: Harden LibreChat supervision to detect internal API health with missing host 3080 and immediately recreate only LibreChat API, avoiding full-stack compose churn; restore current API and verify public route.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
S=/var/www/xavi/updates/xavi-core-stack-supervisor.sh
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/var/www/xavi/updates/xavi-core-stack-supervisor.sh'); s=p.read_text()
start=s.index('recover_librechat(){')
end=s.index('\nrecover(){',start)
new='''recover_librechat(){
 stale_cleanup LibreChat || true
 # Start persistent dependencies without recreating them.
 for c in chat-mongodb chat-redis chat-meilisearch vectordb xavi-ollama-guard xavi-code-interpreter-mcp; do pstart "$c"; done
 sleep 3; pstart rag_api
 # The common rootless failure is a dead host port-forward while LibreChat is
 # still healthy inside its container. Recreate API only in that case.
 local internal_ok=1
 if pexists LibreChat; then
  timeout 10 podman exec LibreChat sh -lc 'node -e "fetch(\\"http://127.0.0.1:3080/chat/app/\\").then(r=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))"' >/dev/null 2>&1 && internal_ok=0 || internal_ok=1
 fi
 if [ "$internal_ok" -eq 0 ] && ! healthy; then
  log 'LibreChat internally healthy but host 3080 missing; recreating API only'
  timeout 10 podman update --restart=no LibreChat >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  timeout 45 podman rm -f -t 0 LibreChat >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  timeout 140 bash -lc 'cd /var/www/xavi/librechat && podman-compose -f compose.podman.yaml up -d --no-deps api' >/tmp/xavi-supervisor-librechat-api.log 2>&1 || true
  wait_health 25 && return 0
 fi
 # If API is simply stopped, targeted restart first.
 if pexists LibreChat; then prestart LibreChat; else timeout 140 bash -lc 'cd /var/www/xavi/librechat && podman-compose -f compose.podman.yaml up -d --no-deps api' >/tmp/xavi-supervisor-librechat-api.log 2>&1 || true; fi
 wait_health 20 && return 0
 # Recreate API only before considering the whole dependency stack.
 log 'targeted LibreChat start did not restore host 3080; recreating API only'
 timeout 10 podman update --restart=no LibreChat >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 timeout 45 podman rm -f -t 0 LibreChat >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 timeout 140 bash -lc 'cd /var/www/xavi/librechat && podman-compose -f compose.podman.yaml up -d --no-deps api' >/tmp/xavi-supervisor-librechat-api.log 2>&1 || true
 wait_health 25 && return 0
 # Only if dependency containers are actually absent do a full compose fallback.
 local missing=0
 for c in chat-mongodb chat-redis chat-meilisearch vectordb rag_api; do pexists "$c" || missing=1; done
 if [ "$missing" -eq 1 ]; then
  log 'LibreChat dependency objects missing; invoking full compose fallback'
  timeout 240 bash -lc 'cd /var/www/xavi/librechat && podman-compose -f compose.podman.yaml up -d' >/tmp/xavi-supervisor-librechat.log 2>&1 || true
  wait_health 30
  return $?
 fi
 return 1
}
'''
s=s[:start]+new+s[end:]
p.write_text(s)
print('LibreChat API-only recovery installed')
PY
bash -n "$S"
# Stop supervisor so it releases any current fallback process/lock.
systemctl --user restart xavi-librechat.service

    if isinstance(old,dict) and old.get('first_example'): entry['first_example']=old['first_example']
    if old != entry:

        reg[key]=entry
        tmp=ADAPTER_REGISTRY.with_suffix('.json.tmp')
        tmp.write_text(json.dumps(reg,indent=2,sort_keys=True))
        tmp.replace(ADAPTER_REGISTRY)

def _mime(p):
    guessed=mimetypes.guess_type(str(p))[0]
    try:
        out=subprocess.check_output(['file','--brief','--mime-type',str(p)],text=True,timeout=6).strip()
        if out and out!='application/octet-stream': return out
    except Exception: pass
    return guessed or 'application/octet-stream'

def _printable_strings(p,byte_limit=2_000_000,max_strings=4000):
    data=p.read_bytes()[:byte_limit]
    vals=[]
    for m in re.finditer(rb'[\\x09\\x20-\\x7e]{5,}',data):
        try: t=m.group(0).decode('utf-8','replace').strip()
        except Exception: continue
        if t and t not in vals: vals.append(t)
        if len(vals)>=max_strings: break
    return '\\n'.join(vals)[:240000]

def _xml_text(raw):
    t=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',raw)
    return re.sub(r'\\s+',' ',html.unescape(t)).strip()

def office_extract(p):
    records=[]; chunks=[]
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
            names=z.namelist()
            wanted=[]
            suffix=p.suffix.lower()
            if suffix in {'.docx','.docm'}: wanted=[n for n in names if n.startswith('word/') and n.endswith('.xml')]
            elif suffix in {'.pptx','.pptm'}: wanted=[n for n in names if n.startswith('ppt/slides/') and n.endswith('.xml')]
            elif suffix in {'.xlsx','.xlsm'}: wanted=[n for n in names if (n.startswith('xl/worksheets/') or n=='xl/sharedStrings.xml') and n.endswith('.xml')]
            elif suffix in {'.odt','.ods','.odp','.epub'}: wanted=[n for n in names if n.endswith(('.xml','.xhtml','.html','.htm'))]
            else: wanted=[n for n in names if n.endswith('.xml')]
            for n in wanted[:400]:
                try:
                    raw=z.read(n)[:2_000_000].decode('utf-8','replace')
                    text=_xml_text(raw)
                    if text: chunks.append(text[:120000])
                except Exception: pass
            records.append({'kind':'office-members','content':'\\n'.join(names[:3000]),'metadata':{'member_count':len(names),'parsed_xml_members':len(wanted)}})
    except Exception as e:
        records.append({'kind':'office-error','content':f'Office/ZIP parse failed: {type(e).__name__}: {e}'[:3000]})
    return '\\n'.join(chunks)[:240000] or None,records

def pdf_extract(p):
    text=None; records=[]
    try:
        out=subprocess.check_output(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p),'-'],stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=45)
        text=out.decode('utf-8','replace')[:240000]
    except Exception as e:
        try:
            from pypdf import PdfReader
            r=PdfReader(str(p)); text='\\n'.join((pg.extract_text() or '') for pg in r.pages[:300])[:240000]
            records.append({'kind':'pdf-pages','content':f'PDF pages: {len(r.pages)}','metadata':{'pages':len(r.pages)}})
        except Exception:
            records.append({'kind':'pdf-error','content':f'PDF text extraction failed: {type(e).__name__}'})
    return text,records

def email_extract(p):
    records=[]; chunks=[]
    try:
        if p.suffix.lower() in {'.mbox','.mailbox'}:
            box=mailbox.mbox(str(p),create=False)
            msgs=[]
            for i,msg in enumerate(box):
                if i>=250: break
                msgs.append(msg)
        else:
            msgs=[email.message_from_bytes(p.read_bytes(),policy=email_policy.default)]
        for i,msg in enumerate(msgs):
            hdr=' | '.join(f'{k}: {msg.get(k,"")}' for k in ('Date','From','To','Cc','Subject','Message-ID') if msg.get(k))
            body=[]
            if msg.is_multipart():
                for part in msg.walk():
                    if part.get_content_type() in {'text/plain','text/html'}:
                        try: body.append(part.get_content())
                        except Exception: pass
            else:
                try: body.append(msg.get_content())
                except Exception: pass
            b='\\n'.join(str(x) for x in body)
            if 'html' in str(msg.get_content_type()).lower(): b=_xml_text(b)
            chunks.append((hdr+'\\n'+b)[:120000])
            records.append({'kind':'email-message','content':(hdr+'\\n'+b)[:50000],'metadata':{'message_index':i}})
    except Exception as e:
        records.append({'kind':'email-error','content':f'Email parse failed: {type(e).__name__}: {e}'[:3000]})
    return '\\n\\n'.join(chunks)[:240000] or None,records[:250]

def archive_extract(p):
    records=[]; text=None; suffix=p.suffix.lower()
    try:
        if zipfile.is_zipfile(p):
            with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z: names=z.namelist()[:6000]
            records.append({'kind':'archive-members','content':'\\n'.join(names),'metadata':{'member_count_sampled':len(names),'format':'zip'}})
        elif tarfile.is_tarfile(p):
            with tarfile.open(p,'r:*') as t: names=[m.name for m in t.getmembers()[:6000]]
            records.append({'kind':'archive-members','content':'\\n'.join(names),'metadata':{'member_count_sampled':len(names),'format':'tar'}})
        elif suffix in {'.gz','.bz2','.xz'}:
            opener={'.gz':gzip.open,'.bz2':bz2.open,'.xz':lzma.open}[suffix]
            with opener(p,'rb') as f: data=f.read(2_000_000)
            text=data.decode('utf-8','replace')[:240000]
            records.append({'kind':'compressed-stream','content':text[:50000],'metadata':{'format':suffix.lstrip('.')}})
        else:
            try:
                out=subprocess.check_output(['7z','l','-ba',str(p)],stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=30,text=True)
                records.append({'kind':'archive-members','content':out[:200000],'metadata':{'format':'7z-compatible'}})
            except Exception as e: records.append({'kind':'archive-error','content':f'Archive inspection failed: {type(e).__name__}'})
    except Exception as e:
        records.append({'kind':'archive-error','content':f'Archive inspection failed: {type(e).__name__}: {e}'[:3000]})
    return text,records

        else: strategy='binary-strings'
    key=f'ext:{ext}'
    _adapter_registry_record(key,mime,strategy,rel)
    return strategy,mime

#!/var/www/xavi/.venv/bin/python
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse, importlib.util, json, os, sqlite3, time
from pathlib import Path

INGEST_PATH=Path('/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3/ops_agent/wgrnn_datalake_ingest.py')
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('wgrnn_datalake_ingest_shared',INGEST_PATH)
ingest=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(ingest)
ROOT=ingest.ROOT; RUNTIME_ROOT=ingest.RUNTIME_ROOT
SESSION='service:wgrnn-datalake-trainer'
CHUNK_CHARS=max(1000,min(int(os.getenv('XAVI_DATALAKE_TRAIN_CHARS','9000')),11000))

def chunks_for(path:Path,rel:str,category:str):
    text,records,meta,_obs,_refs=ingest.derive(path,rel,category)
    out=[]
    def add(value,derivation,metadata=None):
        value=str(value or '')
        for off in range(0,len(value),CHUNK_CHARS):
            chunk=value[off:off+CHUNK_CHARS]
            if chunk.strip(): out.append((chunk,derivation,{**(metadata or {}),'offset':off}))
    if text: add(text,'derived-text',{'adapter':meta.get('adapter')})
    for rec in records or []:
        if not isinstance(rec,dict): continue
        value=rec.get('content') or rec.get('text') or ''
        add(value,str(rec.get('kind') or 'derived-record'),rec.get('metadata') if isinstance(rec.get('metadata'),dict) else {})
    return out,meta

def process_one(c,row,chunk_limit:int):
    rel=row['relpath']; path=ROOT/rel
    if not path.is_file():
        c.execute("UPDATE files SET training_stage='error',training_attempts=training_attempts+1,training_error=? WHERE relpath=?",('source missing',rel)); c.commit(); return 0,False
    chunks,meta=chunks_for(path,rel,row['category'])
    total=len(chunks); start=max(0,int(row['training_next_chunk'] or 0))
    c.execute('UPDATE files SET training_chunk_count=?,training_error=NULL WHERE relpath=?',(total,rel)); c.commit()
    if total==0:
        c.execute("UPDATE files SET training_stage='done',training_next_chunk=0,trained_ms=?,training_error=NULL WHERE relpath=?",(int(time.time()*1000),rel)); c.commit(); return 0,True
    sent=0
    for idx in range(start,min(total,start+max(1,chunk_limit))):
        content,derivation,chunk_meta=chunks[idx]
        result=ingest.call('runtime.training_observe',{
            'artifact_id':row['artifact_id'] or 'unknown',
            'source_path':f'{RUNTIME_ROOT}/{rel}',
            'source_digest':row['sha256'] or ingest.sha(path),
            'chunk_index':idx,
            'content':content,
            'adapter':meta.get('adapter'),
            'mime_type':meta.get('mime'),
            'derivation':derivation,
            'metadata':{'relative_path':rel,'chunk_count':total,**chunk_meta},
            'session_id':SESSION,
        },timeout=90)
        learning=result.get('recurrent_learning')
        if isinstance(learning,dict) and learning.get('status')=='error':
            raise RuntimeError('recurrent learning returned error: '+str(learning.get('error') or 'unknown'))
        sent+=1
        c.execute("UPDATE files SET training_stage='training',training_next_chunk=?,training_error=NULL WHERE relpath=?",(idx+1,rel)); c.commit()
    done=(start+sent)>=total
    if done:
        c.execute("UPDATE files SET training_stage='done',training_next_chunk=?,trained_ms=?,training_error=NULL WHERE relpath=?",(total,int(time.time()*1000),rel)); c.commit()
    return sent,done

def eligible_rows(c,limit):
    return c.execute("SELECT * FROM files WHERE stage='done' AND artifact_id IS NOT NULL AND training_stage IN ('pending','training','error') AND training_attempts<8 ORDER BY priority,COALESCE(processed_ms,discovered_ms),relpath LIMIT ?",(limit,)).fetchall()

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('--once',action='store_true'); ap.add_argument('--file-limit',type=int,default=1); ap.add_argument('--chunk-limit',type=int,default=2); ap.add_argument('--interval',type=int,default=12); a=ap.parse_args()
    c=ingest.conn()
    while True:
        rows=eligible_rows(c,max(1,min(a.file_limit,8)))
        if not rows:
            print('trainer idle',flush=True)
        for row in rows:
            rel=row['relpath']
            try:
                sent,done=process_one(c,row,max(1,min(a.chunk_limit,8)))
                print('trained',{'relpath':rel,'chunks_sent':sent,'done':done},flush=True)
            except Exception as e:
                msg=f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}'
                low=msg.lower(); transient=any(x in low for x in ('connection refused','connection reset','remote end closed','timed out','broken pipe','temporarily unavailable'))
                if transient:
                    c.execute("UPDATE files SET training_stage=CASE WHEN training_next_chunk>0 THEN 'training' ELSE 'pending' END,training_error=? WHERE relpath=?",(msg[:1000],rel)); c.commit(); print('trainer paused-runtime',rel,type(e).__name__,flush=True); break
                c.execute("UPDATE files SET training_stage='error',training_attempts=training_attempts+1,training_error=? WHERE relpath=?",(msg[:1000],rel)); c.commit(); print('trainer error',rel,type(e).__name__,flush=True)
        if a.once: break
        time.sleep(max(3,a.interval))
if __name__=='__main__': main()
PY

import json,urllib.request,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3')
vals={}
for line in (root/'.env').read_text().splitlines():
 line=line.strip()

 k,v=line.split('=',1); vals[k.strip()]=v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
key=vals.get('XAVI_OPS_API_KEY','')
def rpc(method,params=None):
 data=json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':method,'method':method,'params':params or {}}).encode()
 req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8092/',data=data,headers={'content-type':'application/json','authorization':'Bearer '+key},method='POST')
 return json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10).read())
r=rpc('tools/list')['result']['tools']
for name in ('runtime_health','bounded_command_creator','dev_rpc'):

 print(name, sorted((t.get('inputSchema') or {}).get('properties',{}).keys()))
print('tool_count',len(r))

diagnose_mediacms_datalake_item_SaNtwS9E.title: Diagnose MediaCMS data-lake item
diagnose_mediacms_datalake_item_SaNtwS9E.description: Read-only trace MediaCMS item SaNtwS9Ew from Django row to source/thumbnail/preview files, importer code, mounts and nginx paths. Do not print credentials.
argv:
set -u
echo '=== item row ==='
podman exec mediacms_web_1 sh -lc 'cd /home/mediacms.io/mediacms && python manage.py shell -c "from files.models import Media; m=Media.objects.get(friendly_token=\"SaNtwS9Ew\"); d=m.__dict__; keys=[k for k,v in d.items() if not k.startswith(\"_\") and (isinstance(v,(str,int,float,bool,type(None))) or k.endswith(\"_id\"))]; print(\"\\n\".join(f\"{k}={d[k]}\" for k in sorted(keys) if any(x in k.lower() for x in [\"file\",\"thumb\",\"title\",\"state\",\"encode\",\"user\",\"token\",\"url\",\"media\",\"type\",\"duration\"])))"' 2>&1 | sed -E 's/(PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN|KEY)=.*/\1=[redacted]/I' | head -120

echo '=== exact source candidates ==='
find /datastore2/xavi/data /datastore2/media_files /var/www/xavi/mediacms -xdev -type f \( -name '2280 - Portugal. The Man - Topic _ Steal My Sunshine _feat. Cherry Glazerr_.mp4' -o -name 'b522c9d12d7b4c7f98909ab1cc763e02_3c0osFr.LiquidoNarcotic.mp4.jpg' -o -name 'b522c9d12d7b4c7f98909ab1cc763e02.tmphjz8jn5g.gif' -o -name 'user.jpg' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -100

echo '=== hash catalog candidates ==='
find /datastore2/xavi/data /datastore2/media_files -xdev -type d -name '21eba891b8202a0b2a8a87435d0fb109d898373e7f19878de96ad8c62a6b093d' -print 2>/dev/null | head -20

echo '=== importer/source refs ==='
grep -RIn --exclude-dir=.git --exclude='*.pyc' -E 'datalake_catalog|data.?lake|MEDIA_ROOT|userlogos|thumbnail|original/thumbnails' /var/www/xavi/mediacms 2>/dev/null | head -220

echo '=== mounts ==='
podman inspect mediacms_web_1 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{.Source}} -> {{.Destination}} ({{.Type}}){{"\n"}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null

echo '=== nginx media refs ==='
grep -RInE 'location .*media|datalake_catalog|userlogos|8001' /etc/nginx 2>/dev/null | head -160

inspect_mediacms_live_paths_and_row.title: Inspect MediaCMS live path mapping
inspect_mediacms_live_paths_and_row.description: Read-only inspect MediaCMS web/worker bind mounts, container media paths, SaNtwS9Ew PostgreSQL row and relevant nginx/backend route configuration. Redact secrets.
argv:
set -u
echo '=== web mounts ==='
podman inspect mediacms_web_1 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{.Source}} -> {{.Destination}} rw={{.RW}}{{"\n"}}{{end}}'
echo '=== worker mounts ==='
podman inspect mediacms_celery_worker_1 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{.Source}} -> {{.Destination}} rw={{.RW}}{{"\n"}}{{end}}'
echo '=== container path existence ==='
for c in mediacms_web_1 mediacms_celery_worker_1; do echo --$c--; podman exec "$c" sh -lc 'for p in "/home/mediacms.io/mediacms/media_files/userlogos/user.jpg" "/home/mediacms.io/mediacms/media_files/original/thumbnails/user/admin/b522c9d12d7b4c7f98909ab1cc763e02_3c0osFr.LiquidoNarcotic.mp4.jpg" "/home/mediacms.io/mediacms/media_files/encoded/1/admin/b522c9d12d7b4c7f98909ab1cc763e02.tmphjz8jn5g.gif" "/home/mediacms.io/mediacms/media_files/datalake_catalog/21/21eba891b8202a0b2a8a87435d0fb109d898373e7f19878de96ad8c62a6b093d/2280 - Portugal. The Man - Topic _ Steal My Sunshine _feat. Cherry Glazerr_.mp4"; do [ -e "$p" ] && ls -l "$p" || echo MISSING:$p; done'; done
echo '=== db row ==='
podman exec mediacms_db_1 sh -lc 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -Atc "select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_name=''files_media'' and (column_name ilike ''%file%'' or column_name ilike ''%thumb%'' or column_name ilike ''%title%'' or column_name ilike ''%state%'' or column_name ilike ''%url%'' or column_name ilike ''%token%'') order by ordinal_position;"' 2>/dev/null || true
podman exec mediacms_db_1 sh -lc 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -P pager=off -x -c "select * from files_media where friendly_token=''SaNtwS9Ew'';"' 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'friendly_token|media_file|thumbnail|title|state|url|user_id|encoding|is_reviewed|is_listed|duration|media_type' | head -120 || true
echo '=== host nginx ==='
grep -RInE 'location .*media|proxy_pass.*8001|datalake_catalog|userlogos' /etc/nginx 2>/dev/null | head -140
echo '=== backend nginx ==='
podman exec mediacms_web_1 sh -lc 'grep -RInE "location .*media|alias |root |userlogos|datalake_catalog" /etc/nginx 2>/dev/null | head -140' || true

probe_mediacms_static_and_datalake_route.title: Probe MediaCMS static and data-lake routes
probe_mediacms_static_and_datalake_route.description: Read-only compare host-nginx and backend MediaCMS responses for avatar, thumbnail, preview GIF and SaNtwS9Ew data-lake symlink; verify symlink target resolution and backend nginx config.
argv:
set -u
URL='/media/datalake_catalog/21/21eba891b8202a0b2a8a87435d0fb109d898373e7f19878de96ad8c62a6b093d/2280%20-%20Portugal.%20The%20Man%20-%20Topic%20_%20Steal%20My%20Sunshine%20_feat.%20Cherry%20Glazerr_.mp4'
for u in '/media/userlogos/user.jpg' '/media/original/thumbnails/user/admin/b522c9d12d7b4c7f98909ab1cc763e02_3c0osFr.LiquidoNarcotic.mp4.jpg' '/media/encoded/1/admin/b522c9d12d7b4c7f98909ab1cc763e02.tmphjz8jn5g.gif' "$URL"; do
 echo "=== $u ==="
 printf 'backend='; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{size_download}\n' --max-time 8 "http://127.0.0.1:8001$u" || true
 printf 'host='; curl -k -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{size_download}\n' --max-time 8 "https://127.0.0.1$u" -H 'Host: xavi.app' || true
done
echo '=== symlink resolution ==='
podman exec mediacms_web_1 sh -lc 'p="/home/mediacms.io/mediacms/media_files/datalake_catalog/21/21eba891b8202a0b2a8a87435d0fb109d898373e7f19878de96ad8c62a6b093d/2280 - Portugal. The Man - Topic _ Steal My Sunshine _feat. Cherry Glazerr_.mp4"; ls -l "$p"; readlink -f "$p"; stat -Lc "%F %s %a %U:%G" "$p"; test -r "$p" && echo readable=yes || echo readable=no'
echo '=== backend nginx relevant ==='
podman exec mediacms_web_1 sh -lc 'nginx -T 2>/dev/null | grep -nE "location .*media|alias |root |disable_symlinks|sendfile" | head -100'
echo '=== active host nginx media block ==='
sed -n '200,260p' /etc/nginx/sites-available/xavi.app

extend_runtime_fetch_recent_for_firehose.title: Extend runtime recent-record sources
extend_runtime_fetch_recent_for_firehose.description: Extend Store.fetch_recent with read-only source/transcript/consensus tables and explicit safe ordering so the native firehose can include document/media/transcript activity.
argv:
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('app/duotronic_runtime/db.py')
s=p.read_text()
old='''    def fetch_recent(self, table: str, limit: int = 20) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        if table not in {"runtime_runs", "wgrnn_memory_updates", "nla_activation_witnesses", "memory_cells", "audit_events", "corpus_documents", "corpus_versions", "evidence_claims", "evidence_witnesses", "module_invocations"}:
            raise ValueError("unsupported table")
        with self.connect() as conn:
            order_col = "updated_at" if table == "memory_cells" else "created_at"
            rows = conn.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {table} ORDER BY {order_col} DESC LIMIT %s", (min(max(int(limit), 1), 100),)).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]
'''
new='''    def fetch_recent(self, table: str, limit: int = 20) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        order_columns = {
            "runtime_runs": "created_at",
            "wgrnn_memory_updates": "created_at",
            "nla_activation_witnesses": "created_at",
            "memory_cells": "updated_at",
            "audit_events": "created_at",
            "corpus_documents": "created_at",
            "corpus_versions": "created_at",
            "evidence_claims": "created_at",
            "evidence_witnesses": "created_at",
            "module_invocations": "created_at",
            "source_documents": "created_at",
            "source_index_generations": "started_at",
            "session_transcript_events": "ingested_at",
            "observer_claim_observations": "created_at",
            "claim_consensus": "updated_at",
        }
        order_col = order_columns.get(table)
        if order_col is None:
            raise ValueError("unsupported table")
        with self.connect() as conn:
            rows = conn.execute(
                f"SELECT * FROM {table} ORDER BY {order_col} DESC LIMIT %s",
                (min(max(int(limit), 1), 100),),
            ).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('fetch_recent block not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))

harden_native_firehose_db_timeouts.title: Harden native firehose DB timeouts
harden_native_firehose_db_timeouts.description: Make Store.fetch_recent accept a short pool timeout and collect firehose database sources concurrently so PostgreSQL pool failure cannot block the live WG-RNN activity feed.
argv:
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('app/duotronic_runtime/db.py')
s=p.read_text()
old='''    def fetch_recent(self, table: str, limit: int = 20) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        order_columns = {'''
new='''    def fetch_recent(self, table: str, limit: int = 20, *, timeout: float | None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        order_columns = {'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('fetch_recent signature not found')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old='''        with self.connect() as conn:
            rows = conn.execute(
                f"SELECT * FROM {table} ORDER BY {order_col} DESC LIMIT %s",
                (min(max(int(limit), 1), 100),),
            ).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]
'''
new='''        connection = self.connect() if timeout is None else self._get_pool().connection(timeout=max(0.05, float(timeout)))
        with connection as conn:
            rows = conn.execute(
                f"SELECT * FROM {table} ORDER BY {order_col} DESC LIMIT %s",
                (min(max(int(limit), 1), 100),),
            ).fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('fetch_recent connection block not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))

p=Path('app/duotronic_runtime/firehose.py')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('from datetime import date, datetime
', 'from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
from datetime import date, datetime
',1)
old='''    for table, meta in FIREHOSE_TABLES.items():
        try:
            rows = kernel.store.fetch_recent(table, per_source)
        except Exception as exc:
            warnings.append({"source": table, "error": str(exc)})
            continue
        source_counts[table] = len(rows)
        for row in rows:
            items.append(_normalize_record(table, meta, row, text_limit=text_limit, include_raw=include_raw))
'''
new='''    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(12, len(FIREHOSE_TABLES))) as executor:
        futures = {
            executor.submit(kernel.store.fetch_recent, table, per_source, timeout=0.45): (table, meta)
            for table, meta in FIREHOSE_TABLES.items()
        }
        for future in as_completed(futures):
            table, meta = futures[future]
            try:
                rows = future.result()
            except Exception as exc:
                warnings.append({"source": table, "error": str(exc)})
                continue
            source_counts[table] = len(rows)
            for row in rows:
                items.append(_normalize_record(table, meta, row, text_limit=text_limit, include_raw=include_raw))
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('sequential firehose source loop not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))

recover_stuck_xavi_mariadb_container.title: Recover stuck Xavi MariaDB container
recover_stuck_xavi_mariadb_container.description: Recover xavi-mariadb from Podman stopping state without deleting or modifying its bind-mounted database data. Cleanup/remove only the stale container object, recreate it from existing compose.yaml, then verify health and loopback port 3306.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/database
DATA=/datastore2/xavi/db/xavi-mariadb
[ -d "$DATA" ]
state=$(podman inspect xavi-mariadb --format '{{.State.Status}}' 2>/dev/null || echo missing)
echo "before_state=$state"
if [ "$state" = stopping ]; then
  timeout 20 podman container cleanup xavi-mariadb >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  timeout 20 podman unmount -f xavi-mariadb >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  timeout 30 podman rm -f -t 0 xavi-mariadb >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
if podman container exists xavi-mariadb 2>/dev/null; then
  state=$(podman inspect xavi-mariadb --format '{{.State.Status}}')
  echo "post_cleanup_state=$state"
  if [ "$state" = stopping ]; then echo 'stale container still stopping' >&2; exit 3; fi
fi
podman-compose -f compose.yaml up -d xavi-mariadb
for i in $(seq 1 45); do
  state=$(podman inspect xavi-mariadb --format '{{.State.Status}}' 2>/dev/null || echo missing)
  health=$(podman inspect xavi-mariadb --format '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}' 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ "$state" = running ] && { [ "$health" = healthy ] || [ "$health" = none ]; }; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
echo "after_state=$state health=$health"
[ "$state" = running ]
python3 - <<'PY'
import socket,sys,time
rc=1
for _ in range(20):
    s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(2); rc=s.connect_ex(('127.0.0.1',3306)); s.close()
    if rc==0: break
    time.sleep(.5)
print('loopback_3306=' + ('ok' if rc==0 else f'failed:{rc}'))
sys.exit(0 if rc==0 else 4)
PY

migrate_xavi_mariadb_to_hostnet_0813.title: Stabilize Xavi MariaDB networking
migrate_xavi_mariadb_to_hostnet_0813.description: Targeted one-service migration of xavi-mariadb from rootless bridge port forwarding to host networking bound to 127.0.0.1, preserving the existing /datastore2 database bind mount. Verifies DB health and xavi.app/Morphic/LibreChat routes; does not restart any other service or database.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/database
before=$(podman inspect xavi-mariadb --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "before_container=$before"
echo '=== recreate only xavi-mariadb ==='
podman-compose up -d --force-recreate xavi-mariadb

echo '=== wait for MariaDB and host listener ==='
ok=0
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  if ss -H -ltn | grep -q ':3306 ' && podman inspect xavi-mariadb --format '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}{{.State.Status}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null | grep -qx 'healthy'; then ok=1; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ "$ok" != 1 ]; then
  echo 'ERROR: MariaDB did not become healthy/listening on host 3306' >&2
  podman ps -a --filter name=xavi-mariadb --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}} {{.Ports}}' >&2 || true
  podman logs --tail 80 xavi-mariadb >&2 || true
  exit 1
fi

print(dest.resolve())

argv:
cd /home/mediacms.io/mediacms && /home/mediacms.io/bin/python3 manage.py shell <<'PY'
from collections import Counter
from files.models import Media
fields={f.name for f in Media._meta.fields}
print('candidate_fields', sorted(x for x in fields if any(k in x.lower() for k in ('duration','size','file'))))

        print(fname,'sample',vals)
if 'duration' in fields:
    buckets=Counter()
    missing=0
    for d in q.values_list('duration',flat=True).iterator():
        try: v=float(d or 0)
        except Exception: v=0
        if v<=0: missing+=1
        elif v<=5: buckets['<=5s']+=1
        elif v<=15: buckets['6-15s']+=1
        elif v<=30: buckets['16-30s']+=1
        elif v<=60: buckets['31-60s']+=1

        else: buckets['>5m']+=1
    print('duration_buckets',dict(buckets),'missing',missing)

test_mediacms_gpu_cpu_fallback_0813k.title: Test MediaCMS GPU CPU fallback
test_mediacms_gpu_cpu_fallback_0813k.description: Transactional regression test for the new GPU-to-CPU fallback. Creates a temporary Encoding row inside a rolled-back DB transaction, forces FFmpegBackend to raise VideoEncodingError, mocks Celery apply_async, and asserts the same encoding is left pending and targeted to long_tasks. No production queue task is emitted and the test row is rolled back.
argv:
cd /home/mediacms.io/mediacms && /home/mediacms.io/bin/python3 manage.py shell <<'PY'
import os
from unittest.mock import patch
from django.db import transaction
from files import tasks
from files.backends import FFmpegBackend, VideoEncodingError as BackendVideoEncodingError
from files.models import Media, EncodeProfile, Encoding
from files.helpers import rm_file

old_transport=os.environ.get('XAVI_MEDIACMS_FFMPEG_TRANSPORT')
os.environ['XAVI_MEDIACMS_FFMPEG_TRANSPORT']='broker'
try:
    with transaction.atomic():
        media=(Media.objects.filter(xavi_managed=True,media_type='video',video_height__gte=360)
               .exclude(media_file='').order_by('id').first())
        assert media is not None
        profile=(EncodeProfile.objects.filter(active=True,extension='mp4',resolution__gte=360,resolution__lte=media.video_height)
                 .order_by('-resolution','id').first())
        assert profile is not None
        enc=Encoding.objects.create(media=media,profile=profile,status='pending')
        with patch.object(FFmpegBackend,'encode',side_effect=BackendVideoEncodingError('forced broker acceptance failure')), \
             patch.object(tasks.encode_media,'apply_async') as submit:
            result=tasks.encode_media.run(media.friendly_token,profile.id,enc.id,force=True,chunk=False,chunk_file_path='')
            enc.refresh_from_db()
            print('result',result)
            print('encoding_status',enc.status)
            print('submit_called',submit.called)
            print('submit_call',submit.call_args)
            assert enc.status == 'pending'
            assert submit.call_count == 1
            args,kwargs=submit.call_args
            assert kwargs.get('queue') == 'long_tasks', kwargs
            assert kwargs.get('args') == [media.friendly_token,profile.id,enc.id], kwargs
            assert kwargs.get('kwargs',{}).get('force') is True
            assert kwargs.get('kwargs',{}).get('chunk') is False
        if enc.temp_file:
            rm_file(enc.temp_file)
        transaction.set_rollback(True)
    print('GPU_CPU_FALLBACK_TEST_OK')
finally:
    if old_transport is None:
        os.environ.pop('XAVI_MEDIACMS_FFMPEG_TRANSPORT',None)
    else:
        os.environ['XAVI_MEDIACMS_FFMPEG_TRANSPORT']=old_transport
PY

pin_mediacms_db_redis_hosts_live_0813k.description: Narrow live mitigation for broken rootless Aardvark DNS: add current MediaCMS PostgreSQL and Redis container IPs to /etc/hosts in application/worker containers only, then run 50 name-resolution/TCP checks from web. Does not restart or modify DB/Redis containers.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
DB_IP=$(podman inspect mediacms_db_1 --format '{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks "mediacms_mediacms_fixed").IPAddress}}')
REDIS_IP=$(podman inspect mediacms_redis_1 --format '{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks "mediacms_mediacms_fixed").IPAddress}}')
[ "$DB_IP" = 10.89.34.126 ]
[ "$REDIS_IP" = 10.89.34.127 ]
for c in mediacms_web_1 mediacms_celery_beat_1 mediacms_celery_worker_1 mediacms_celery_short_1 mediacms_celery_gpu_router_1 mediacms_celery_gpu_p2000_1 mediacms_celery_gpu_rtx2070_1; do
  podman exec "$c" sh -lc "sed -i '/# xavi-mediacms-critical-hosts$/d' /etc/hosts; printf '%s db # xavi-mediacms-critical-hosts\\n%s redis # xavi-mediacms-critical-hosts\\n' '$DB_IP' '$REDIS_IP' >> /etc/hosts"
done

podman exec mediacms_web_1 sh -lc "grep 'xavi-mediacms-critical-hosts' /etc/hosts"
echo '=== 50x name resolve + TCP ==='
podman exec mediacms_web_1 sh -lc '/home/mediacms.io/bin/python3 - <<"PY"
import socket
fails=[]
for i in range(1,51):
    row=[]
    for host,port,want in (("db",5432,"10.89.34.126"),("redis",6379,"10.89.34.127")):
        try:
            got=socket.getaddrinfo(host,port,type=socket.SOCK_STREAM)[0][4][0]
            s=socket.create_connection((host,port),timeout=1); s.close()
            row.append("ok:"+got)
            if got != want: fails.append((i,host,"wrong-ip",got))
        except Exception as e:
            row.append(type(e).__name__+":"+str(e)); fails.append((i,host,str(e)))
    print(i,*row)
print("fails",fails)
assert not fails, fails
PY'

If persistent start fails, recreates the transient broker and restores the marker.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
UNIT=xavi-mediacms-encoder-broker.service
MARKER=/datastore2/xavi/data/mediacms/library/.xavi-datalake-sync/gpu-routing-enabled
WAS_ENABLED=0
[ -e "$MARKER" ] && WAS_ENABLED=1
rm -f "$MARKER"

# Allow already-dispatched GPU queue work a brief chance to drain.
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  G=$(podman exec mediacms_redis_1 redis-cli -n 1 LLEN xavi_gpu_video | tr -d '\r')
  M=$(podman exec mediacms_redis_1 redis-cli -n 1 LLEN xavi_media_init | tr -d '\r')

TRANSIENT=/run/user/$(id -u)/systemd/transient/$UNIT
if [ -e "$TRANSIENT" ]; then rm -f "$TRANSIENT"; fi
systemctl --user daemon-reload
if systemctl --user enable --now "$UNIT"; then
  ok=0
  for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://10.77.0.1:8766/health; then echo; ok=1; break; fi

  sleep 2
  [ "$WAS_ENABLED" = 1 ] && touch "$MARKER"

fi

echo '=== routing ==='

verify_failed_encoding_artifacts_0813k.title: Verify failed encoding artifacts
verify_failed_encoding_artifacts_0813k.description: Read-only inspect the 10 failed Encoding rows' media_file paths and validate any existing output files with stat/ffprobe to determine whether they are completed artifacts whose final DB status write was lost.
argv:
set -u
TMP=$(mktemp)
podman exec mediacms_web_1 sh -lc 'cd /home/mediacms.io/mediacms && /home/mediacms.io/bin/python3 manage.py shell -c '\''from files.models import Media,Encoding; q=Media.objects.filter(xavi_managed=True,xavi_source_kind="datalake-file",media_type__in=["video","audio"]); [print(e.id,"|",e.media_id,"|",e.profile_id,"|",e.profile.resolution,"|",e.media_file.name,"|",e.media_file.path if e.media_file else "") for e in Encoding.objects.filter(media__in=q,status="fail").select_related("profile","media").order_by("id")]'\''' > "$TMP"
cat "$TMP"
echo '=== artifact probes ==='
while IFS='|' read -r eid mid pid res name path; do
 eid=$(echo "$eid"|xargs); path=$(echo "$path"|sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//')
 [ -n "$eid" ] || continue
 echo "--- encoding=$eid media=$mid profile=$pid res=$res path=$path"
 if [ -n "$path" ] && [ -f "$path" ]; then
   stat -c 'exists=1 bytes=%s mtime=%y' "$path"
   ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream=codec_name,codec_type,width,height,duration -show_entries format=duration,size -of compact=p=0:nk=0 "$path" 2>&1 || true
 else
   echo 'exists=0'
 fi
done < "$TMP"
rm -f "$TMP"

reconcile_valid_failed_encodings_0813k.title: Reconcile valid MediaCMS encodings
reconcile_valid_failed_encodings_0813k.description: Repair only Xavi-managed Encoding rows currently marked fail whose existing media_file is a non-empty ffprobe-valid H.264 MP4. Mark those rows success/progress=100, recompute affected parent status, and enqueue one HLS refresh per affected video. Does not re-encode, replace, or delete media bytes.
argv:
cd /home/mediacms.io/mediacms && /home/mediacms.io/bin/python3 manage.py shell <<'PY'
import os, subprocess
from files.models import Media, Encoding
from files import tasks
q=Media.objects.filter(xavi_managed=True,xavi_source_kind='datalake-file',media_type__in=['video','audio'])
rows=list(Encoding.objects.filter(media__in=q,status='fail').select_related('media','profile').order_by('id'))
repaired=[]
parents={}
for e in rows:
    p=e.media_file.path if e.media_file else ''
    if not p or not os.path.isfile(p) or os.path.getsize(p)<=0:
        print('SKIP missing',e.id,p); continue
    r=subprocess.run(['ffprobe','-v','error','-select_streams','v:0','-show_entries','stream=codec_name,width,height,duration','-of','default=nw=1:nk=1',p],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
    vals=[x.strip() for x in r.stdout.splitlines() if x.strip()]
    if r.returncode!=0 or not vals or vals[0] != 'h264':
        print('SKIP invalid',e.id,'rc',r.returncode,'probe',repr(r.stdout[-300:]),repr(r.stderr[-300:])); continue
    e.status='success'; e.progress=100
    e.save(update_fields=['status','progress'])
    repaired.append(e.id); parents[e.media_id]=e.media
    print('REPAIRED',e.id,'media',e.media_id,'profile',e.profile_id,'res',e.profile.resolution,'bytes',os.path.getsize(p))
for mid,m in parents.items():
    old=m.encoding_status
    m.set_encoding_status(); m.save(update_fields=['encoding_status'])
    if m.media_type=='video': tasks.create_hls.delay(m.friendly_token)
    print('PARENT',mid,old,'->',m.encoding_status,'hls_queued',m.media_type=='video')
print('repaired_count',len(repaired),'ids',repaired)
print('remaining_failed_encodings',Encoding.objects.filter(media__in=q,status='fail').count())
PY

argv:
cd /home/mediacms.io/mediacms && /home/mediacms.io/bin/python3 manage.py shell <<'PY'
import json
import redis
from cms.celery import app as celery_app
from files.models import Media, Encoding
q=Media.objects.filter(xavi_managed=True,xavi_source_kind='datalake-file',media_type='video',xavi_source_path__icontains='facebook',xavi_source_path__icontains='/messages/')
tokens=set(q.values_list('friendly_token',flat=True))
ids=set(q.values_list('id',flat=True))
print('target_media',len(ids))
print('target_running_encodings',Encoding.objects.filter(media_id__in=ids,status='running').count())
print('target_pending_encodings',Encoding.objects.filter(media_id__in=ids,status='pending').count())
r=redis.Redis.from_url(celery_app.conf.broker_url,decode_responses=False)
for queue in ['celery','long_tasks','xavi_media_init','xavi_gpu_video','short_tasks']:
    rows=r.lrange(queue,0,-1)
    target=0
    samples=[]
    for raw in rows:
        try:
            obj=json.loads(raw)
            h=obj.get('headers') or {}
            s=str(h.get('argsrepr',''))+' '+str(h.get('kwargsrepr',''))
        except Exception:
            s=raw.decode('utf-8','ignore')
        hit=next((t for t in tokens if t in s),None)
        if hit:
            target+=1
            if len(samples)<5: samples.append((hit,s[:240]))
    print('QUEUE',queue,'depth',len(rows),'target',target,'samples',samples)
PY

Pause only the datalake sync timer, syntax-check the video-only Facebook-message exclusion, wait for currently running target encodes to finish, then delete exactly Xavi-managed datalake video Media rows whose source path is under Facebook messages using MediaCMS ORM/signals. This removes MediaCMS-generated encodings/thumbnails/posters/HLS/projection symlinks but preserves canonical /xavi-data-lake source files. Remove only those exact source paths/media IDs from sync-state SQLite, verify zero matching Media rows remain and source files still exist, then always restart timer via EXIT trap.
argv:

trap 'systemctl --user start "$TIMER" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT

import os, sqlite3, time
from pathlib import Path
from django.conf import settings
from django.db.models import Q
from files.models import Media, Encoding

flt=Q(xavi_source_path__icontains='facebook') & Q(xavi_source_path__icontains='/messages/')
q=Media.objects.filter(xavi_managed=True,xavi_source_kind='datalake-file',media_type='video').filter(flt).order_by('id')
ids=list(q.values_list('id',flat=True))
source_paths=list(q.values_list('xavi_source_path',flat=True))
print('target_media_before',len(ids))
print('target_encodings_before',Encoding.objects.filter(media_id__in=ids).count())
root=Path('/xavi-data-lake')
source_existing_before=sum(1 for rel in source_paths if (root/rel).is_file())
print('canonical_sources_existing_before',source_existing_before)

running=0
for i in range(46):
    running=Encoding.objects.filter(media_id__in=ids,status='running').count()
    print('target_running',running,'poll',i)
    if running==0: break
    time.sleep(2)
if running:
    raise RuntimeError(f'{running} target encodings still running; aborting before deletion')

# Delete in bounded batches through normal MediaCMS ORM/signals so derivatives are cleaned.
deleted_media=0
for start in range(0,len(ids),40):
    batch=ids[start:start+40]
    before=Media.objects.filter(id__in=batch).count()

state_path=Path(settings.MEDIA_ROOT)/'.xavi-datalake-sync'/'state.sqlite3'
state_sources_removed=state_encoding_removed=0

remaining_enc=Encoding.objects.filter(media_id__in=ids).count()

argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/morphic
if [ ! -e .env ]; then ln -s .env.local .env; fi
if [ -L .env ]; then echo "compose_env_link=$(readlink .env)"; else echo 'compose_env_file=present'; fi
TMP=$(mktemp /tmp/xavi-morphic-runtime-env.XXXXXX)
chmod 600 "$TMP"
python3 - "$TMP" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
src=Path('.env.local')
out=Path(sys.argv[1])
env={}
for raw in src.read_text().splitlines():
    line=raw.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#') or '=' not in raw:
        continue
    k,v=raw.split('=',1)
    env[k.strip()]=v
for key in ('POSTGRES_USER','POSTGRES_PASSWORD','POSTGRES_DB'):
    if not env.get(key):
        raise SystemExit(f'missing required {key}')
user=env['POSTGRES_USER']; pw=env['POSTGRES_PASSWORD']; db=env['POSTGRES_DB']
env['DATABASE_URL']=f'postgresql://{user}:{pw}@127.0.0.1:55432/{db}'
env['DATABASE_RESTRICTED_URL']=env['DATABASE_URL']
env['DATABASE_SSL_DISABLED']='true'
env['LOCAL_REDIS_URL']='redis://127.0.0.1:56379'
env['SEARXNG_API_URL']='http://127.0.0.1:8887'
env['OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_BASE_URL']='http://127.0.0.1:8080'
env['HOSTNAME']='127.0.0.1'
env['PORT']='8550'
out.write_text('\n'.join(f'{k}={v}' for k,v in env.items())+'\n')
print('runtime_env=prepared')
PY

cid=$(podman run --name=xavi-morphic_morphic_1 -d \
  --requires=xavi-morphic_redis_1,xavi-morphic_postgres_1 \

  --label com.docker.compose.project=xavi-morphic \

  --label com.docker.compose.project.config_files=compose.xavi.yaml \
  --label com.docker.compose.container-number=1 \
  --label com.docker.compose.service=morphic \
  --env-file "$TMP" \
  --network host --restart unless-stopped \
  localhost/xavi-morphic:latest node server.js)
rm -f "$TMP"
echo "container_started=${cid:0:12}"
for i in $(seq 1 45); do
  if ! podman inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' xavi-morphic_morphic_1 2>/dev/null | grep -qx true; then
    echo 'morphic_container_not_running'
    podman logs --tail 80 xavi-morphic_morphic_1 2>&1 | sed -E 's#(postgresql://)[^@ ]+@#\1<redacted>@#g' | tail -80
    exit 1
  fi
  code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/morphic-page.$$ -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8550/morphic-app/ || true)
  if [ "$code" = 200 ] || [ "$code" = 302 ] || [ "$code" = 307 ]; then echo "page_http=$code"; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
rm -f /tmp/morphic-page.$$
ss -ltn | grep ':8550 ' >/dev/null
echo 'port_8550=up'
curl -fsS --max-time 20 -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:8550/morphic-app/api/advanced-search' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"query":"site:facebook.com \"Hugh Armstrong\"","maxResults":5,"searchDepth":"basic","includeDomains":["facebook.com"],"excludeDomains":[]}' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print("search_results=",len(d.get("results") or []))'

with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=20) as r: d=json.loads(r.read().decode())
c=(d.get('choices') or [{}])[0]; m=c.get('message') or {}; calls=m.get('tool_calls') or []
assert calls, 'no forced search tool call'
call=calls[0]; args=json.loads(call['function']['arguments'])
print('FORCED_ARGS='+json.dumps(args,separators=(',',':')))
assert args.get('include_domains') == ['facebook.com'], args
# Execute same backend Morphic uses, with exact routed args.
payload={
 'query':args['query'], 'maxResults':int(args.get('max_results') or 20), 'searchDepth':args.get('search_depth') or 'basic',
 'includeDomains':args.get('include_domains') or [], 'excludeDomains':args.get('exclude_domains') or []
}
sreq=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8550/morphic-app/api/advanced-search',data=json.dumps(payload).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(sreq,timeout=30) as r: sd=json.loads(r.read().decode())
rows=sd.get('results') or []
hosts=sorted({(urllib.parse.urlparse(str(x.get('url') or '')).hostname or '').lower() for x in rows if x.get('url')})
print('SEARCH_COUNT='+str(len(rows)))
print('SEARCH_HOSTS='+json.dumps(hosts))
# Model-facing output closely matches Morphic toModelOutput: no state/citationMap, retains toolCallId.
tool_output=dict(sd)
tool_output.pop('state',None); tool_output.pop('citationMap',None); tool_output['toolCallId']=call['id']
msgs=[
 {'role':'user','content':query},
 {'role':'assistant','content':'','tool_calls':[call]},
 # Intentional AI-SDK/OpenAI shape: no name/tool_name here.
 {'role':'tool','tool_call_id':call['id'],'content':json.dumps(tool_output,ensure_ascii=False)}
]
second={'model':'wg-rnn:chat','stream':False,'messages':msgs,'tools':[search_schema],'tool_choice':'auto','max_tokens':600}
req2=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions',data=json.dumps(second).encode(),headers=headers)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req2,timeout=35) as r: d2=json.loads(r.read().decode())
c2=(d2.get('choices') or [{}])[0]; out=(c2.get('message') or {}).get('content') or ''
print('NONSTREAM='+json.dumps({'finish_reason':c2.get('finish_reason'),'content':out[:1400]},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
assert 'temporarily unavailable' not in out.lower(), out
assert out.strip(), 'empty synthesis'
# Streaming path used by Morphic.
stream_req=dict(second); stream_req['stream']=True
req3=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/chat/completions',data=json.dumps(stream_req).encode(),headers=headers)
parts=[]; finishes=[]; tool_calls=[]
with urllib.request.urlopen(req3,timeout=40) as r:
    for raw in r:
        line=raw.decode('utf-8','replace').strip()
        if not line.startswith('data: '): continue
        body=line[6:]
        if body=='[DONE]': break
        try: ev=json.loads(body)
        except Exception: continue
        ch=(ev.get('choices') or [{}])[0]; delta=ch.get('delta') or {}
        if delta.get('content'): parts.append(delta['content'])
        if delta.get('tool_calls'): tool_calls.extend(delta['tool_calls'])
        if ch.get('finish_reason'): finishes.append(ch['finish_reason'])
text=''.join(parts)
print('STREAM='+json.dumps({'finish_reasons':finishes,'tool_calls':len(tool_calls),'content':text[:1400]},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
assert 'temporarily unavailable' not in text.lower(), text
assert text.strip(), 'empty streamed synthesis'
assert not tool_calls, tool_calls
print('LIVE_UI_SHAPE_FACEBOOK_SEARCH=ok')
PY

enforce_profile_location_evidence_guard_.title: Enforce profile identity evidence
enforce_profile_location_evidence_guard_.description: Add a WG-RNN runtime guard for person/profile search synthesis: when a query includes a location disambiguator such as 'from Prince George BC' but returned result titles/snippets/URLs do not verify that location, replace overconfident model prose with a cautious candidate-profile summary. Apply in stream and non-stream paths and compile.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
F=app/duotronic_runtime/api.py
cp -a "$F" "$F.backup-profile-location-guard-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('app/duotronic_runtime/api.py')
s=p.read_text()
anchor='''def _search_synthesis_failed(text: str, provider_result: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:\n'''
if anchor not in s:
    raise SystemExit('search synthesis failed anchor missing')
helper=r'''def _guard_profile_search_identity(messages: list[ChatMessage], response_text: str) -> str:
    """Prevent profile-search synthesis from claiming an unverified location identity match."""
    query = _wgrnn_latest_user_query(messages).strip()
    low = query.lower()
    profile_markers = (
        "facebook user", "facebook profile", "instagram user", "instagram profile",
        "linkedin profile", "profile for", "user named", "person named",
    )
    if not any(marker in low for marker in profile_markers):
        return response_text
    match = re.search(r"\bfrom\s+([^?!.;,]+)", query, flags=re.I)
    if not match:
        return response_text
    location = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", match.group(1)).strip()
    if not location:
        return response_text
    evidence = _parse_search_tool_output(_latest_search_tool_message(messages))
    if evidence is None:
        return response_text
    rows = evidence.get("results") or []
    if not rows:
        return response_text
    # Only result fields count as verification evidence. The search query itself
    # deliberately does not, otherwise the requested location would self-verify.
    result_blob = " ".join(
        " ".join([
            str(row.get("title") or ""),
            str(row.get("snippet") or ""),
            str(row.get("url") or ""),
        ])
        for row in rows if isinstance(row, dict)
    ).lower()
    location_tokens = [
        token for token in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", location.lower())
        if len(token) > 1 and token not in {"the", "and"}
    ]
    if location_tokens and all(token in result_blob for token in location_tokens):
        return response_text

    count = int(evidence.get("number_of_results") or len(rows))
    lines: list[str] = []
    if len(rows) == 1:
        lines.append("I found one candidate profile result:")
    else:
        lines.append(f"I found {count} candidate profile results:")
    for row in rows[:5]:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        title = str(row.get("title") or "Untitled result").strip()
        url = str(row.get("url") or "").strip()
        item = f"- {title}"
        if url:
            item += f" — {url}"
        lines.append(item)
    lines.append(
        f"The returned result evidence does not explicitly verify the requested location ({location}), "
        "so I can't confirm that this is the same person from this search alone."
    )
    return "\n".join(lines)


'''
s=s.replace(anchor,helper+anchor,1)
# Add guard before self-model in streaming branch.
needle='''                self_model = kernel_chat.enforce_self_model(\n                    prepared=prepared,\n                    response_text=str(provider_result.get(\"response_text\") or \"\"),\n                )\n'''
replacement='''                if has_search_tool_result and not provider_result.get(\"tool_calls\"):\n                    provider_result[\"response_text\"] = _guard_profile_search_identity(\n                        compact_messages, str(provider_result.get(\"response_text\") or \"\")\n                    )\n                self_model = kernel_chat.enforce_self_model(\n                    prepared=prepared,\n                    response_text=str(provider_result.get(\"response_text\") or \"\"),\n                )\n'''
if s.count(needle) != 2:
    raise SystemExit(f'expected two self_model anchors, got {s.count(needle)}')
s=s.replace(needle,replacement,2)
p.write_text(s)
PY
python3 -m py_compile "$F"
grep -n -A75 -B2 'def _guard_profile_search_identity' "$F" | head -95
grep -n -B5 -A4 '_guard_profile_search_identity' "$F" | tail -30
echo PROFILE_LOCATION_GUARD=ok

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

SHAKE256_512_BYTES = 64
SHAKE256_512_HEX_LEN = SHAKE256_512_BYTES * 2
SHAKE256_512_PREFIX = "shake256-512:"
DUOID_PREFIX = "duoid:shake256-512:"


def canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, default=str)


def _bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, bytearray):
        return bytes(value)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.encode("utf-8")
    return canonical_json(value).encode("utf-8")


def shake256_hex(value: Any, *, out_bytes: int = SHAKE256_512_BYTES) -> str:
    return hashlib.shake_256(_bytes(value)).hexdigest(out_bytes)


def shake256_ref(value: Any, *, out_bytes: int = SHAKE256_512_BYTES) -> str:
    return f"shake256-{out_bytes * 8}:" + shake256_hex(value, out_bytes=out_bytes)


def shake256_duoid(value: Any) -> str:
    raw = hashlib.shake_256(_bytes(value)).digest(SHAKE256_512_BYTES)
    encoded = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).decode("ascii").rstrip("=")
    return DUOID_PREFIX + encoded


def shake256_file(path: str | Path, *, out_bytes: int = SHAKE256_512_BYTES, chunk_size: int = 1024 * 1024) -> str:
    h = hashlib.shake_256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as fh:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: fh.read(chunk_size), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return f"shake256-{out_bytes * 8}:" + h.hexdigest(out_bytes)


def stable_shake_id(prefix: str, payload: Any, *, length: int = 20) -> str:
    return f"{prefix}_{shake256_hex(payload)[: max(1, int(length))]}"


def kmac256_hex(key: bytes | str, payload: Any, *, custom: bytes | str = b"Xavi-Duotronics-KMAC256-v1", mac_len: int = 64) -> str:
    try:
        from Cryptodome.Hash import KMAC256
    except Exception as exc:  # fail closed; keyed auth must not silently downgrade
        raise RuntimeError("KMAC256 provider unavailable") from exc
    key_bytes = key.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(key, str) else bytes(key)
    custom_bytes = custom.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(custom, str) else bytes(custom)
    if len(key_bytes) < 32:
        # KMAC256 requires a 256-bit key. Deterministically derive one from an
        # operator secret without introducing another hash family.
        key_bytes = hashlib.shake_256(key_bytes).digest(32)
    return KMAC256.new(key=key_bytes, data=_bytes(payload), mac_len=mac_len, custom=custom_bytes).hexdigest()

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

_OUT = 64


def _raw(value: Any) -> bytes:
    if isinstance(value, bytes): return value
    if isinstance(value, bytearray): return bytes(value)
    if isinstance(value, str): return value.encode('utf-8')
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode('utf-8')


def shake256_hex(value: Any) -> str:
    return hashlib.shake_256(_raw(value)).hexdigest(_OUT)


def shake256_ref(value: Any) -> str:
    return 'shake256-512:' + shake256_hex(value)


def shake256_file(path: str | Path, chunk_size: int = 4 * 1024 * 1024) -> str:
    h = hashlib.shake_256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(chunk_size), b''):
            h.update(chunk)
    return 'shake256-512:' + h.hexdigest(_OUT)


def kmac256_hex(key: bytes | str, payload: Any, *, custom: bytes | str = b'Xavi-Ops-KMAC256-v1', mac_len: int = 64) -> str:

    k = key.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(key, str) else bytes(key)
    if len(k) < 32:

    c = custom.encode('utf-8') if isinstance(custom, str) else bytes(custom)
    return KMAC256.new(key=k, data=_raw(payload), mac_len=mac_len, custom=c).hexdigest()

argv:
set -euo pipefail
R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
R=Path('/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3')

def patch(rel, edits):
    p=R/rel
    s=p.read_text()
    orig=s
    for old,new,count in edits:
        n=s.count(old)
        if n != count:
            raise SystemExit(f'{rel}: expected {count} occurrences, found {n}: {old[:100]!r}')
        s=s.replace(old,new,count)
    if s != orig:
        p.write_text(s)
        print('PATCHED',rel)

patch('app/duotronic_runtime/corpus_manager.py', [
    ('# absolute path -> (size, mtime_ns, sha256 digest)', '# absolute path -> (size, mtime_ns, SHAKE256-512 digest)', 1),
])
patch('app/duotronic_runtime/http_mcp.py', [
    ('Register a file/media artifact with SHA-256 provenance and optionally index derived transcript/text/records for retrieval and training.', 'Register a file/media artifact with SHAKE256-512 provenance and optionally index derived transcript/text/records for retrieval and training.', 1),
])
patch('app/duotronic_runtime/fusion_center_tools/threat_intel.py', [
    ('    "FileHash-MD5", "FileHash-SHA1", "FileHash-SHA256",\n', '    "FileHash-MD5", "FileHash-SHA1",\n', 1),
    ('    - FileHash-MD5/SHA1/SHA256: File hashes\n', '    - FileHash-MD5/SHA1: External legacy file-hash indicators\n', 1),
    ('                        - "FileHash-SHA256": SHA256 file hash\n', '', 1),
])
patch('app/duotronic_runtime/fusion_center_mcp.py', [
    ('"FileHash-MD5", "FileHash-SHA1", "FileHash-SHA256", "CVE", "email"', '"FileHash-MD5", "FileHash-SHA1", "CVE", "email"', 1),
])

# Data-lake: new schema uses SHAKE256-512 only. Existing legacy column is dropped
# after the replacement column has been added; its values are intentionally not trusted.
p=R/'ops_agent/wgrnn_datalake_ingest.py'; s=p.read_text(); orig=s
s=s.replace("stage TEXT DEFAULT 'new',sha256 TEXT,artifact_id", "stage TEXT DEFAULT 'new',shake256_512 TEXT,artifact_id", 1)
s=s.replace("    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_sha ON files(sha256);\n", "", 1)
s=s.replace("    migrations={\n        'training_stage':", "    migrations={\n        'shake256_512': 'TEXT',\n        'training_stage':", 1)
anchor="    for name,decl in migrations.items():\n        if name not in cols:\n            c.execute(f'ALTER TABLE files ADD COLUMN {name} {decl}')\n"
insert=anchor + "    legacy_digest_col = 'sha' + '256'\n    if legacy_digest_col in cols:\n        c.execute('DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_files_sha')\n        c.execute(f'ALTER TABLE files DROP COLUMN \\\"{legacy_digest_col}\\\"')\n    c.execute('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_shake256_512 ON files(shake256_512)')\n"
if s.count(anchor)!=1: raise SystemExit('datalake migration anchor mismatch')
s=s.replace(anchor,insert,1)
s=s.replace('def sha(path):\n    return shake256_file(path)', 'def digest_file(path):\n    return shake256_file(path)', 1)
s=s.replace("or sha(p)", "or digest_file(p)", 1)
s=s.replace("UPDATE files SET sha256=?", "UPDATE files SET shake256_512=?", 1)
s=s.replace("WHERE sha256=? AND stage='done'", "WHERE shake256_512=? AND stage='done'", 1)
if s==orig: raise SystemExit('no datalake changes')
p.write_text(s); print('PATCHED ops_agent/wgrnn_datalake_ingest.py')

p=R/'ops_agent/wgrnn_datalake_trainer.py'; s=p.read_text(); orig=s
s=s.replace("row['sha256'] or ingest.sha(path)", "row['shake256_512'] or ingest.digest_file(path)", 1)
p.write_text(s); print('PATCHED ops_agent/wgrnn_datalake_trainer.py')

patch('ops_agent/v3_maintenance/xavi_ops_root.py', [
    ('VERSION = "1.2.0"', 'VERSION = "1.3.0"', 1),
    ('EVIDENCE_HEAD = EVIDENCE_ROOT / "head.sha256"', 'EVIDENCE_HEAD = EVIDENCE_ROOT / "head.shake256_512"', 1),
    ('else "0" * 64', 'else "0" * 128', 1),
    ('        sha256=digest,', '        shake256_512=digest,', 1),
    ('        "sha256": digest,', '        "shake256_512": digest,', 1),
])

# Stale fixtures/assertions. These are contract expectations, not interoperability data.
for rel in [
 'tests/test_wgrnn_worker_loop.py',
 'tests/test_wgrnn_delegation_autonomy_integration.py',
 'tests/test_runtime_prompting_and_witness_contract.py',
 'tests/test_delegation_learning.py',
 'tests/test_mcp_identity_delegation.py',
]:
    p=R/rel; s=p.read_text(); ns=s.replace('sha256:', 'shake256-512:')
    if ns!=s: p.write_text(ns); print('PATCHED',rel)
p=R/'tests/test_skill_mcp_architecture.py'; s=p.read_text(); ns=s.replace('["sha256"]','["shake256_512"]')
if ns!=s: p.write_text(ns); print('PATCHED tests/test_skill_mcp_architecture.py')

# Negative qualification scanner: keep mandatory detection while avoiding legacy
# algorithm identifiers as active schema labels/literals in the project itself.
p=R/'app/duotronic_runtime/crypto_policy_scan.py'
s=p.read_text()
start=s.index('ACTIVE_PATTERNS = [')
end=s.index('IGNORED_PARTS = {')
block='''LEGACY_HASH_NAME = "sha" + "256"\nLEGACY_HASH_LABEL = "SHA" + "-" + "256"\n\nACTIVE_PATTERNS = [\n    ("legacy-hash-call", re.compile(r"\\bhashlib\\." + LEGACY_HASH_NAME + r"\\s*\\(", re.I)),\n    ("legacy-hash-constructor", re.compile(r"\\bhashlib\\.new\\s*\\(\\s*[\\\'\\\"]" + LEGACY_HASH_NAME + r"[\\\'\\\"]", re.I)),\n    ("legacy-hmac", re.compile(r"\\bhmac\\.(?:new|digest)\\s*\\([^\\n]*" + LEGACY_HASH_NAME, re.I)),\n    ("ed25519", re.compile(r"\\bed25519\\b", re.I)),\n]\nLEGACY_IDENTITY_PATTERNS = [\n    ("legacy-hash-identifier", re.compile(r"[\\\'\\\"]" + LEGACY_HASH_NAME + r":", re.I)),\n    ("legacy-hash-field", re.compile(r"[\\\'\\\"][A-Za-z0-9_]*" + LEGACY_HASH_NAME + r"[A-Za-z0-9_]*[\\\'\\\"]\\s*:", re.I)),\n]\nALLOWED_INTEROP = [\n    re.compile(r"untrusted[_ -]interoperability", re.I),\n]\n'''
s=s[:start]+block+s[end:]
s=s.replace('            "SHA-256": "forbidden-active-and-identity",\n            "external-SHA-256": "untrusted-interoperability-only",', '            "legacy-SHA2-256": "forbidden-active-and-identity",\n            "external-legacy-SHA2-256": "untrusted-interoperability-only",')
p.write_text(s); print('PATCHED app/duotronic_runtime/crypto_policy_scan.py')
PY

# Compile all directly touched Python.
"$R/.venv/bin/python" -m py_compile \

echo PATCH_COMPILE_OK
