deploy_morphic_thumbnail_image_safe_0813.title: Deploy Morphic thumbnails safely
deploy_morphic_thumbnail_image_safe_0813.description: Pause only the Morphic supervisor bash loop, preserve the current app container environment without printing secrets, replace only the app container with the newly built image, verify it, roll back automatically on failure, then resume supervision. Postgres and Redis containers are untouched.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
NAME=xavi-morphic_morphic_1
NEW_IMAGE=localhost/xavi-morphic:latest
OLD_IMAGE=$(podman inspect "$NAME" --format '{{.Image}}')
NEW_ID=$(podman image inspect "$NEW_IMAGE" --format '{{.Id}}')
SUP=$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value xavi-morphic.service)
ENVF=$(mktemp /tmp/xavi-morphic-env.XXXXXX)
chmod 600 "$ENVF"
podman inspect "$NAME" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' > "$ENVF"
cleanup(){ rm -f "$ENVF"; if [ -n "${SUP:-}" ] && kill -0 "$SUP" 2>/dev/null; then kill -CONT "$SUP" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; }
trap cleanup EXIT
if [ -n "$SUP" ] && [ "$SUP" != 0 ]; then kill -STOP "$SUP"; echo "supervisor_paused pid=$SUP"; fi
rollback(){
  echo 'ROLLBACK_START'
  podman rm -f -t 0 "$NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  podman run -d --name "$NAME" --network host --restart unless-stopped --env-file "$ENVF" \
    --label com.docker.compose.project=xavi-morphic --label com.docker.compose.service=morphic \
    "$OLD_IMAGE" >/dev/null
  for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8550/morphic-app/ || true)
    case "$code" in 200|302|307|308) echo "rollback_page_http=$code"; return 0;; esac
    sleep 1
  done
  echo 'ROLLBACK_FAILED' >&2
  return 1
}
# Replace only the application container.
podman rm -f -t 3 "$NAME" >/dev/null
if ! podman run -d --name "$NAME" --network host --restart unless-stopped --env-file "$ENVF" \
    --label com.docker.compose.project=xavi-morphic --label com.docker.compose.service=morphic \
    "$NEW_IMAGE" >/dev/null; then
  rollback; exit 10
fi
ok=0
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8550/morphic-app/ || true)
  case "$code" in 200|302|307|308) echo "page_http=$code attempt=$i"; ok=1; break;; esac
  sleep 1
done
if [ "$ok" != 1 ]; then
  podman logs --tail 100 "$NAME" 2>&1 || true
  rollback
  exit 11
fi
RUN_ID=$(podman inspect "$NAME" --format '{{.Image}}')
if [ "$RUN_ID" != "$NEW_ID" ]; then echo "wrong_image running=$RUN_ID expected=$NEW_ID" >&2; rollback; exit 12; fi
# Verify database-backed page can actually answer rather than merely hold the port.
curl -fsS --max-time 20 -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:8550/morphic-app/api/advanced-search' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{"query":"site:facebook.com Hugh Armstrong Prince George BC thumbnail deployment verification","maxResults":5,"searchDepth":"basic","includeDomains":["facebook.com"],"excludeDomains":[]}' \
  >/tmp/morphic-new-search.$$.json || { podman logs --tail 100 "$NAME" 2>&1 || true; rollback; exit 13; }
python3 - <<'PY' /tmp/morphic-new-search.$$.json
import json,sys
x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); rows=x.get('results') or []
print('search_results',len(rows))
print('thumbnail_fields',sum(bool(r.get('thumbnailUrl')) for r in rows))
assert isinstance(rows,list)
PY
rm -f /tmp/morphic-new-search.$$.json
echo "old_image=$OLD_IMAGE"
echo "new_image=$NEW_ID"
echo 'MORPHIC_APP_ONLY_DEPLOY_OK'

qualify_meta_graph_v5318_0813.description: Compile all changed runtime modules, verify contract-framed identity helpers against 5.3.18 vectors, test deterministic meta graph construction and registered relations, migrate PostgreSQL, round-trip candidate graph storage/search, prove retry-idempotent recurrence, and test self-model narration suppression.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
C='/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/witness_contract/v1.6 - Draft 5.3.18'
PY="$R/.venv/bin/python"
export PYTHONPATH="$R/app"
"$PY" -m py_compile \
  "$R/app/duotronic_runtime/crypto_primitives.py" \
  "$R/app/duotronic_runtime/meta_graph.py" \
  "$R/app/duotronic_runtime/db.py" \
  "$R/app/duotronic_runtime/wgrnn.py" \
  "$R/app/duotronic_runtime/runtime_kernel.py" \
  "$R/app/duotronic_runtime/wgrnn_kernel_chat.py" \
  "$R/app/duotronic_runtime/duotronic_bijective.py"
echo COMPILE_OK
"$PY" - <<'PY'
import json, time, uuid
from pathlib import Path
from duotronic_runtime.crypto_primitives import semantic_content_id, meta_edge_content_id
from duotronic_runtime.meta_graph import build_information_graph, feature_content_ids, REGISTERED_RUNTIME_RELATIONS
from duotronic_runtime.config import get_settings
from duotronic_runtime.db import Store
from duotronic_runtime.wgrnn_kernel_chat import WGRNNKernelChat

C=Path('/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/witness_contract/v1.6 - Draft 5.3.18')
v=json.load(open(C/'vectors/identity_vectors.json'))
for row in v['semantic_content']:
    actual=semantic_content_id(row['content_type'], row['body'])
    assert actual == row['expected_id'], (row['name'],actual,row['expected_id'])
for row in v['meta_object_edges']:
    actual=meta_edge_content_id(row['edge'])
    assert actual == row['expected_id'], (row['name'],actual,row['expected_id'])
print('IDENTITY_VECTORS_OK')

g1=build_information_graph(
    information_kind='qualification_media_example',
    text_fields={'description':'Canadian black and white music video with guitar and disco ball'},
    facets={'country':'Canada','visual_style':'black_and_white','medium':'music_video'},
    metadata={'qualification':'v5318-meta-graph'},
)
g2=build_information_graph(
    information_kind='qualification_media_example',
    text_fields={'description':'Canadian black and white music video with guitar and disco ball'},
    facets={'country':'Canada','visual_style':'black_and_white','medium':'music_video'},
    metadata={'qualification':'v5318-meta-graph'},
)
assert g1['root_content_id']==g2['root_content_id']
assert g1['content_ids']==g2['content_ids']
assert g1['edge_ids']==g2['edge_ids']
assert g1['contents'] and g1['edges']
assert {e['relation_type'] for e in g1['edges']} <= REGISTERED_RUNTIME_RELATIONS
print('META_GRAPH_DETERMINISTIC_OK',len(g1['contents']),len(g1['edges']))

store=Store(get_settings())
store.migrate()
print('DB_MIGRATE_OK')
ns='qualification:meta-graph:'+uuid.uuid4().hex
now=int(time.time()*1000)
r1=store.insert_meta_graph_observation(graph=g1, namespace=ns, source_update_id='qual_update_1', trust_status='candidate', observed_at_ms=now, metadata={'probe':1})
# Retry exact observation: recurrence must not increase.
r1b=store.insert_meta_graph_observation(graph=g1, namespace=ns, source_update_id='qual_update_1', trust_status='candidate', observed_at_ms=now+1, metadata={'probe':1})
qids=feature_content_ids('Canadian black white music video guitar disco ball')
s1=store.search_meta_graph(namespace=ns, query_content_ids=qids)
assert s1['matches'] and s1['matches'][0]['source_update_id']=='qual_update_1', s1
before=max(int(m['recurrence_support']) for m in s1['matches'])
# A genuinely new observation of the same pattern increments recurrence.
r2=store.insert_meta_graph_observation(graph=g1, namespace=ns, source_update_id='qual_update_2', trust_status='candidate', observed_at_ms=now+2, metadata={'probe':2})
s2=store.search_meta_graph(namespace=ns, query_content_ids=qids)
after=max(int(m['recurrence_support']) for m in s2['matches'])
assert after > before, (before,after)
assert all(m['trust_status']=='candidate' for m in s2['matches'])
print('META_GRAPH_DB_ROUNDTRIP_OK','before',before,'after',after,'matches',len(s2['matches']))

# Invoke the unbound enforcement method with a minimal instance; it does not use self.
obj=object.__new__(WGRNNKernelChat)
text='I am self-aware. The evidence points to three recurring motifs. I do have feelings in the WG-RNN sense.'
out=obj.enforce_self_model(prepared={}, response_text=text)
assert out['narration_detected'] is True
assert 'self-aware' not in out['response_text'].lower()
assert 'feelings in the wg-rnn sense' not in out['response_text'].lower()
assert 'three recurring motifs' in out['response_text'].lower()
print('SELF_MODEL_NARRATION_SUPPRESSION_OK',out['response_text'])
print('QUALIFICATION_OK')
PY

argv:

R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
export PYTHONPATH="$R/app"
"$R/.venv/bin/python" -m py_compile "$R/app/duotronic_runtime/meta_graph.py"

from duotronic_runtime.meta_graph import build_information_graph
common='Canadian black and white music video with guitar and disco ball'
a=build_information_graph(information_kind='music_video',text_fields={'description':common},facets={'media_id':'video-A'},metadata={'source':'A'})
b=build_information_graph(information_kind='music_video',text_fields={'description':common},facets={'media_id':'video-B'},metadata={'source':'B'})
assert a['root_content_id'] != b['root_content_id']
aco={e['edge_content_id'] for e in a['edges'] if e['relation_type']=='co_occurs_with' and e.get('context_content_id') is None}
bco={e['edge_content_id'] for e in b['edges'] if e['relation_type']=='co_occurs_with' and e.get('context_content_id') is None}
shared=aco & bco
assert shared,(len(aco),len(bco))
ctx_a={e['edge_content_id'] for e in a['edges'] if e.get('context_content_id')==a['root_content_id']}
ctx_b={e['edge_content_id'] for e in b['edges'] if e.get('context_content_id')==b['root_content_id']}
assert ctx_a != ctx_b
print('CROSS_OBJECT_PATTERN_HASH_OK','shared_co_occurrence_edges',len(shared),'root_a',a['root_content_id'],'root_b',b['root_content_id'])
PY

qualify_source_document_meta_graph_0813.title: Qualify source document meta graph
qualify_source_document_meta_graph_0813.description: Compile the bulk graph transaction refactor and, inside the runtime network namespace, index two source chunks with a shared media pattern, verify source search and candidate graph observations/recurrence, then retry the same chunks and prove recurrence is idempotent.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
"$R/.venv/bin/python" -m py_compile "$R/app/duotronic_runtime/db.py" "$R/app/duotronic_runtime/meta_graph.py"
cat >/tmp/source-meta-graph-probe.py <<'PY'
import uuid
from duotronic_runtime.config import get_settings
from duotronic_runtime.db import Store
from duotronic_runtime.crypto_primitives import shake256_ref

store=Store(get_settings())
repo='qualification-source-meta-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
gen='gen-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
ns=f'source-document/{repo}'
store.begin_source_generation(generation_id=gen,repository_id=repo,root_path='/qualification',commit_id='test-commit',metadata={'qualification':True})
base='Canadian black and white music video with guitar and disco ball recurring visual motif. '
contents=[
    base+'First source document discusses the visual relationship and guitar motif.',
    base+'Second source document discusses the same cross-media connection and disco motif.',
]
docs=[]
for idx,text in enumerate(contents):
    docs.append({
      'repository_id':repo,'generation_id':gen,'path':f'media/item-{idx}.md','chunk_index':0,'language':'en',
      'content_digest':shake256_ref(text),'source_digest':shake256_ref(f'source-{idx}'),
      'content':text,'metadata':{
        'media_kind':'music_video','country':'Canada','visual_style':'black_and_white',
        'objects':['guitar','disco_ball'],'media_id':f'item-{idx}'
      },'training_eligible':True,
    })
first=store.upsert_source_documents(docs)
print('FIRST_UPSERT',first)
assert first['upserted']==2 and first['meta_graph_observations']==2,first
store.finalize_source_generation(generation_id=gen,status='completed',keep_generations=3)
search=store.search_source_documents(query='guitar disco ball',repository_id=repo,limit=10)
print('SOURCE_SEARCH_COUNT',search['count'])
assert search['count']==2,search
with store.connect() as conn:
    obs=conn.execute('select observation_id,root_content_id,content_ids,edge_ids from meta_graph_observations where namespace=%s order by observed_at_ms',(ns,)).fetchall()
    rec=conn.execute('select count(*) as n,coalesce(max(occurrence_count),0) as mx,sum(case when occurrence_count>=2 then 1 else 0 end) as repeated from meta_edge_recurrence where namespace=%s',(ns,)).fetchone()
print('GRAPH_OBSERVATIONS',len(obs),'RECURRENCE',dict(rec))
assert len(obs)==2,obs
assert int(rec['mx'])>=2,rec
assert int(rec['repeated'])>0,rec
before=(int(rec['n']),int(rec['mx']),int(rec['repeated']))
# Retry exact same source chunks. Deterministic observations must not inflate recurrence.
second=store.upsert_source_documents(docs)
print('SECOND_UPSERT',second)
with store.connect() as conn:
    obs2=conn.execute('select count(*) as n from meta_graph_observations where namespace=%s',(ns,)).fetchone()
    rec2=conn.execute('select count(*) as n,coalesce(max(occurrence_count),0) as mx,sum(case when occurrence_count>=2 then 1 else 0 end) as repeated from meta_edge_recurrence where namespace=%s',(ns,)).fetchone()
after=(int(rec2['n']),int(rec2['mx']),int(rec2['repeated']))
print('RETRY_COUNTS','before',before,'after',after,'observation_count',obs2['n'])
assert int(obs2['n'])==2,obs2
assert after==before,(before,after)
# Verify graph metadata carries bounded source identity/provenance rather than a second full-file store.
with store.connect() as conn:
    root_ids=[r['root_content_id'] for r in obs]
    roots=conn.execute('select canonical_body from semantic_contents where semantic_content_id=any(%s)',(root_ids,)).fetchall()
for row in roots:
    body=bytes(row['canonical_body'])
    assert b'content_digest' in body and b'graph_window_chars' in body
print('SOURCE_META_GRAPH_IDEMPOTENT_OK')
# Clean test-specific observations/index rows; shared semantic contents/edges remain content-addressed/deduplicated.
with store.connect() as conn:
    conn.execute('delete from meta_edge_recurrence where namespace=%s',(ns,))
    conn.execute('delete from meta_graph_observations where namespace=%s',(ns,))
    conn.execute('delete from source_documents where repository_id=%s',(repo,))
    conn.execute('delete from source_index_generations where repository_id=%s',(repo,))
    conn.commit()
print('SOURCE_DOCUMENT_META_GRAPH_OK')
PY

podman exec duotronic-runtime python -u -c "$CODE"
rm -f /tmp/source-meta-graph-probe.py

argv:

import shutil,time,uuid
from pathlib import Path
from duotronic_runtime.config import get_settings
from duotronic_runtime.db import Store
from duotronic_runtime.crypto_primitives import shake256_ref
from duotronic_runtime.meta_graph import build_information_graph
from duotronic_runtime.wgrnn import WGRNNRuntime
s=get_settings(); store=Store(s)
repo='qualification-shared-source-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
gen='gen-'+uuid.uuid4().hex
src_ns=f'source-document/{repo}'
common='Canadian black and white music video with guitar and disco ball recurring visual connection'
store.begin_source_generation(generation_id=gen,repository_id=repo,root_path='/qualification',commit_id='shared-source-test',metadata={'qualification':True})
docs=[]
for idx in range(2):
 text=common+f' source document {idx}.'
 docs.append({'repository_id':repo,'generation_id':gen,'path':f'item-{idx}.md','chunk_index':0,'language':'en','content_digest':shake256_ref(text),'source_digest':shake256_ref('source-'+str(idx)),'content':text,'metadata':{'media_kind':'music_video','country':'Canada','visual_style':'black_and_white','objects':['guitar','disco_ball'],'media_id':f'source-{idx}'},'training_eligible':True})
up=store.upsert_source_documents(docs); store.finalize_source_generation(generation_id=gen,status='completed',keep_generations=3)

 src_rec=conn.execute('select count(*) as n,coalesce(max(occurrence_count),0) as mx from meta_edge_recurrence where namespace=%s',(src_ns,)).fetchone()
print('SOURCE_RECURRENCE',dict(src_rec)); assert int(src_rec['mx'])>=2

tmp=Path('/tmp/wgrnn-shared-source-'+uuid.uuid4().hex)
rt=WGRNNRuntime(loop_id='qual-shared-source',node_id='qual-node',state_dim=16,slot_dim=16,num_slots=8,data_dir=tmp,store=store)

upd=step['memory_update']; local_ns=step['namespace']
local_graph=build_information_graph(information_kind='wgrnn_chat_turn',text_fields={'conversation':common,'response':'The recurring connection is a candidate pattern.'},facets={'operation_kind':'observe'},metadata={'qualification':'shared-source-support'})
store.insert_meta_graph_observation(graph=local_graph,namespace=local_ns,source_update_id=upd['update_id'],trust_status=upd['trust_status'],observed_at_ms=int(time.time()*1000),metadata={'qualification':True})
retr=rt.retrieve(common,top_k=8,user_id='local-user',agent_id='local-agent',thread_id='local-thread')
row=[r for r in retr['results'] if r.get('update_id')==upd['update_id']][0]
print('LOCAL_RETRIEVAL',row)
assert row['trust_status']=='candidate',row
assert int(row.get('graph_shared_source_recurrence_support') or 0)>0,row
assert float(row.get('graph_shared_source_recurrence_score') or 0)>0,row
assert float(row.get('graph_score') or 0) >= float(row.get('graph_local_score') or 0),row
print('SHARED_SOURCE_PATTERN_SUPPORT_OK','support',row['graph_shared_source_recurrence_support'],'local_graph',row['graph_local_score'],'combined_graph',row['graph_score'])
# Cleanup test namespaces/index rows.
with store.connect() as conn:
 for ns in (src_ns,local_ns):
  conn.execute('delete from meta_edge_recurrence where namespace=%s',(ns,))
  conn.execute('delete from meta_graph_observations where namespace=%s',(ns,))
 conn.execute('delete from source_documents where repository_id=%s',(repo,))
 conn.execute('delete from source_index_generations where repository_id=%s',(repo,))
 conn.commit()
shutil.rmtree(tmp,ignore_errors=True)
print('SHARED_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_OK')
PY

qualify_shared_source_pattern_support_v2.title: Qualify shared source pattern support v2
qualify_shared_source_pattern_support_v2.description: Use unique local/source namespaces to prove direct local graph lookup sees separately reported shared source-document recurrence, then prove WG-RNN update linkage exposes the same signal; always clean qualification rows in finally.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
cat >/tmp/shared-source-pattern-v2.py <<'PY'
import shutil,time,uuid
from pathlib import Path
from duotronic_runtime.config import get_settings
from duotronic_runtime.db import Store
from duotronic_runtime.crypto_primitives import shake256_ref
from duotronic_runtime.meta_graph import build_information_graph,feature_content_ids
from duotronic_runtime.wgrnn import WGRNNRuntime
s=get_settings(); store=Store(s)
token=uuid.uuid4().hex
repo='qualification-shared-source-'+token
gen='gen-'+token
src_ns=f'source-document/{repo}'
user='local-user-'+token; agent='local-agent'; thread='local-thread-'+token
common='Canadian black and white music video with guitar and disco ball recurring visual connection'
tmp=Path('/tmp/wgrnn-shared-source-'+token)
local_ns=None
try:
    store.begin_source_generation(generation_id=gen,repository_id=repo,root_path='/qualification',commit_id='shared-source-test',metadata={'qualification':True})
    docs=[]
    for idx in range(2):
        text=common+f' source document {idx}.'
        docs.append({'repository_id':repo,'generation_id':gen,'path':f'item-{idx}.md','chunk_index':0,'language':'en','content_digest':shake256_ref(text),'source_digest':shake256_ref('source-'+str(idx)),'content':text,'metadata':{'media_kind':'music_video','country':'Canada','visual_style':'black_and_white','objects':['guitar','disco_ball'],'media_id':f'source-{idx}'},'training_eligible':True})
    up=store.upsert_source_documents(docs); store.finalize_source_generation(generation_id=gen,status='completed',keep_generations=3)
    print('SOURCE_GRAPH_UPSERT',up,flush=True)
    with store.connect() as conn:
        src_rec=conn.execute('select count(*) as n,coalesce(max(occurrence_count),0) as mx from meta_edge_recurrence where namespace=%s',(src_ns,)).fetchone()
    print('SOURCE_RECURRENCE',dict(src_rec),flush=True); assert int(src_rec['mx'])>=2

    rt=WGRNNRuntime(loop_id='qual-shared-source',node_id='qual-node',state_dim=16,slot_dim=16,num_slots=8,data_dir=tmp,store=store)
    step=rt.step(prompt=common,response_text='The recurring connection is a candidate pattern.',requested_action='observe',evidence_quality=0.8,user_id=user,agent_id=agent,thread_id=thread,tags=['qualification'])
    upd=step['memory_update']; local_ns=step['namespace']
    local_graph=build_information_graph(information_kind='wgrnn_chat_turn',text_fields={'conversation':common,'response':'The recurring connection is a candidate pattern.'},facets={'operation_kind':'observe'},metadata={'qualification':'shared-source-support','token':token})
    persisted=store.insert_meta_graph_observation(graph=local_graph,namespace=local_ns,source_update_id=upd['update_id'],trust_status=upd['trust_status'],observed_at_ms=int(time.time()*1000),metadata={'qualification':True,'token':token})
    print('LOCAL_GRAPH_PERSISTED',persisted,flush=True)
    qids=feature_content_ids(common)
    overlap=set(qids)&set(local_graph['content_ids'])
    print('EXPECTED_QUERY_OVERLAP',len(overlap),flush=True); assert overlap
    direct=store.search_meta_graph(namespace=local_ns,query_content_ids=qids)
    print('DIRECT_GRAPH_SEARCH',direct,flush=True)
    dm=[m for m in direct['matches'] if m.get('source_update_id')==upd['update_id']]
    assert dm, direct
    d=dm[0]
    assert d['overlap_count']>0,d
    assert int(d.get('shared_source_recurrence_support') or 0)>0,d
    assert float(d.get('shared_source_recurrence_score') or 0)>0,d

    retr=rt.retrieve(common,top_k=8,user_id=user,agent_id=agent,thread_id=thread)
    row=[r for r in retr['results'] if r.get('update_id')==upd['update_id']][0]
    print('LOCAL_RETRIEVAL',row,flush=True)
    assert row['trust_status']=='candidate',row
    assert row['graph_observation_id']==persisted['observation_id'],row
    assert int(row.get('graph_shared_source_recurrence_support') or 0)>0,row
    assert float(row.get('graph_shared_source_recurrence_score') or 0)>0,row
    assert float(row.get('graph_score') or 0)>=float(row.get('graph_local_score') or 0),row
    print('SHARED_SOURCE_PATTERN_SUPPORT_OK','support',row['graph_shared_source_recurrence_support'],'local_graph',row['graph_local_score'],'combined_graph',row['graph_score'],flush=True)
finally:
    with store.connect() as conn:
        if local_ns:
            conn.execute('delete from meta_edge_recurrence where namespace=%s',(local_ns,))
            conn.execute('delete from meta_graph_observations where namespace=%s',(local_ns,))
        conn.execute('delete from meta_edge_recurrence where namespace=%s',(src_ns,))
        conn.execute('delete from meta_graph_observations where namespace=%s',(src_ns,))
        conn.execute('delete from source_documents where repository_id=%s',(repo,))
        conn.execute('delete from source_index_generations where repository_id=%s',(repo,))
        conn.commit()
    shutil.rmtree(tmp,ignore_errors=True)
print('SHARED_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_V2_OK',flush=True)
PY
CODE=$(cat /tmp/shared-source-pattern-v2.py)
podman exec duotronic-runtime python -u -c "$CODE"
rm -f /tmp/shared-source-pattern-v2.py
qualify_shared_source_pattern_support_v2.work_title: Qualify shared source pattern support v2

qualify_pairwise_structural_patterns_081.title: Qualify pairwise structural patterns
qualify_pairwise_structural_patterns_081.description: Compile meta_graph and prove symmetric co_occurrence hashing plus complete bounded pairwise structural pattern reuse across distinct media objects, while roots/provenance remain distinct.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
export PYTHONPATH="$R/app"
"$R/.venv/bin/python" -m py_compile "$R/app/duotronic_runtime/meta_graph.py"
"$R/.venv/bin/python" -u - <<'PY'
from duotronic_runtime.meta_graph import build_information_graph,_edge
# Symmetric registry relation must have one normalized identity.
a='duoid:shake256-512:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA'
b='duoid:shake256-512:BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB'
e1=_edge(a,'co_occurs_with',b)
e2=_edge(b,'co_occurs_with',a)
assert e1['edge_content_id']==e2['edge_content_id'],(e1,e2)
assert e1['source_content_id']==e2['source_content_id'] and e1['target_content_id']==e2['target_content_id']
print('SYMMETRIC_EDGE_CANONICAL_OK',e1['edge_content_id'])
shared={'country':'Canada','visual_style':'black_and_white','objects':['guitar','disco_ball'],'audio':{'motif':'descending_chime'}}
a=build_information_graph(information_kind='music_video',text_fields={'description':'video A'},facets={'payload':{**shared,'media_id':'A'}},metadata={'source':'A'})
b=build_information_graph(information_kind='music_video',text_fields={'description':'video B'},facets={'payload':{**shared,'media_id':'B'}},metadata={'source':'B'})
assert a['root_content_id']!=b['root_content_id']
def structural_ids(g): return {r['semantic_content_id'] for r in g['contents'] if r['content_type']=='structural_meta_feature/v1'}
shared_nodes=structural_ids(a)&structural_ids(b)
co_a={e['edge_content_id'] for e in a['edges'] if e['relation_type']=='co_occurs_with' and e.get('context_content_id') is None}
co_b={e['edge_content_id'] for e in b['edges'] if e['relation_type']=='co_occurs_with' and e.get('context_content_id') is None}
shared_edges=co_a&co_b
expected_pairs=len(shared_nodes)*(len(shared_nodes)-1)//2
print('SHARED_NODES',len(shared_nodes),'SHARED_PAIR_EDGES',len(shared_edges),'EXPECTED_MIN_PAIRS',expected_pairs)
assert len(shared_nodes)>=5
assert len(shared_edges)>=expected_pairs,(len(shared_edges),expected_pairs)
# Explicitly prove guitar/disco-ball relation exists in both graphs.
def find_id(g,kind,value):
 for r in g['contents']:
  if r['content_type']=='structural_meta_feature/v1' and r['body'].get('feature_kind')==kind and r['body'].get('value')==value: return r['semantic_content_id']
 raise AssertionError((kind,value))
guitar=find_id(a,'payload.objects[]','guitar'); disco=find_id(a,'payload.objects[]','disco_ball')
gd=_edge(guitar,'co_occurs_with',disco)['edge_content_id']
assert gd in co_a and gd in co_b
print('GUITAR_DISCO_PATTERN_OK',gd)
print('PAIRWISE_STRUCTURAL_PATTERNS_OK')
PY

argv:

from duotronic_runtime.config import get_settings

s=Store(get_settings())
with s.connect() as c:
    obs=c.execute("""
      select namespace,count(*) as n from meta_graph_observations

         or namespace like 'source-document/qualification-%%'
         or namespace like 'adapter-observation/qualification.%%'
         or namespace like 'qual-user-%%'
         or namespace like 'pattern-probe-%%'
         or namespace='adapter-observation/source-document-evil/corpus-root'
      group by namespace order by namespace
    """).fetchall()
    rec=c.execute("""
      select namespace,count(*) as n from meta_edge_recurrence

         or namespace like 'source-document/qualification-%%'
         or namespace like 'adapter-observation/qualification.%%'
         or namespace like 'qual-user-%%'
         or namespace like 'pattern-probe-%%'

      from pg_stat_activity
      where datname=current_database() and pid<>pg_backend_pid()

qualify_pq_key_manager_0813.title: Qualify persistent PQ key manager
qualify_pq_key_manager_0813.description: Compile and exercise the new persistent ML-DSA key manager in an isolated temp directory: sign/verify, rotation, retired-key historical verification, revocation rejection, lifecycle-chain integrity, key persistence across manager instances, and 0600 secret-file permissions.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
export PYTHONPATH="$R/app"
"$R/.venv/bin/python" -m py_compile "$R/app/duotronic_runtime/pq_key_manager.py"
"$R/.venv/bin/python" -u - <<'PY'
import shutil,stat,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from duotronic_runtime.pq_key_manager import PQKeyManager
root=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='pq-key-manager-'))
try:
 m=PQKeyManager(root)
 payload={'witness_id':'qualification-witness','event_digest':'duoid:shake256-512:test','sequence':1}
 e1=m.sign(payload,purpose='witness')
 print('SIGN1',e1['key_id'],e1['signature_suite'])
 assert m.verify(e1)
 key1=e1['key_id']
 assert stat.S_IMODE(m._secret_path(key1).stat().st_mode)==0o600
 status1=m.status(); assert status1['registry_chain_valid'] and status1['secret_key_count']==1
 # Re-instantiation must reuse the same active key.
 m2=PQKeyManager(root); e1b=m2.sign({'witness_id':'qualification-witness-2'},purpose='witness'); assert e1b['key_id']==key1
 rot=m2.rotate_signing_key('witness'); key2=rot['active_key']['key_id']; print('ROTATE',key1,'->',key2); assert key2!=key1
 e2=m2.sign({'witness_id':'qualification-witness-3'},purpose='witness'); assert e2['key_id']==key2 and m2.verify(e2)
 # Retirement stops new signing with predecessor but historical verification remains valid.
 assert m2.verify(e1)
 m2.revoke_key(key1,reason='qualification')
 assert not m2.verify(e1)
 assert m2.verify(e2)
 st=m2.status(); print('STATUS',st); assert st['registry_chain_valid']; assert key1 in st['revoked_key_ids']
 for p in root.joinpath('secret').glob('*.key'): assert stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==0o600
 print('PQ_KEY_MANAGER_QUALIFICATION_OK')
finally:
 shutil.rmtree(root,ignore_errors=True)
PY

qualify_meta_composition_v2_0814.title: Qualify meta composition v2
qualify_meta_composition_v2_0814.description: Compile the rewritten meta-object composition model and prove same measured meta object across different media, distinct timed occurrences, deterministic composition identity, and successive-chain matching without pairwise co-occurrence edges.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
cd "$R"

from duotronic_runtime.meta_graph import build_information_graph, compare_information_compositions, build_information_chain
m1=build_information_graph(information_kind='video', metadata={'source':'video1'}, meta_objects=[
 {'label':'country','value':'Canada','measurement_kind':'quality','locator':{'scope':'whole_media'},'ordinal':0},
 {'label':'detected_object','value':'guitar','measurement_kind':'quality','locator':{'time_seconds':60},'ordinal':1},
 {'label':'background_color','value':'red','measurement_kind':'quality','locator':{'time_seconds':60},'ordinal':2},
 {'label':'detected_object','value':'disco_ball','measurement_kind':'quality','locator':{'time_seconds':90},'ordinal':3},
])
m2=build_information_graph(information_kind='video', metadata={'source':'video2'}, meta_objects=[
 {'label':'country','value':'Canada','measurement_kind':'quality','locator':{'scope':'whole_media'},'ordinal':0},
 {'label':'detected_object','value':'guitar','measurement_kind':'quality','locator':{'time_seconds':120},'ordinal':1},
 {'label':'background_color','value':'red','measurement_kind':'quality','locator':{'time_seconds':300},'ordinal':2},
 {'label':'detected_object','value':'disco_ball','measurement_kind':'quality','locator':{'time_seconds':180},'ordinal':3},
])
assert not m1['edges'] and not m2['edges']
assert m1['root_content_id'] != m2['root_content_id']
assert m1['composition_content_id'] != m2['composition_content_id']

assert len(shared)==4, shared
red1=[o for o in m1['occurrences'] if o['locator'].get('time_seconds')=='60']
red2=[o for o in m2['occurrences'] if o['locator'].get('time_seconds')=='300']
assert red1 and red2
cmp=compare_information_compositions(m1,m2)
assert cmp['shared_meta_object_count']==4, cmp
chain=build_information_chain([m1,m2])
assert len(chain['transitions'])==1
print('PASS')
print('video1_root',m1['root_content_id'])
print('video1_composition',m1['composition_content_id'])
print('video2_composition',m2['composition_content_id'])
print('shared_meta_objects',cmp['shared_meta_object_count'])
for row in cmp['matches']:
 print(row['meta_object_id'], row['left_occurrences'], '=>', row['right_occurrences'])
print('chain_pattern',chain['chain_pattern_content_id'])
PY

qualify_nested_meta_objects_0814.title: Qualify nested meta objects
qualify_nested_meta_objects_0814.description: Prove distinct parent object witnesses can share nested attributes, nearby quantities score as similar without identical SHAKE IDs, and structured reconstruction works.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
cd "$R"
python3 -m py_compile app/duotronic_runtime/meta_graph.py
PYTHONPATH=app .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from duotronic_runtime.meta_graph import build_information_graph, compare_information_compositions, reconstruct_information_description

def disco(src,t,reflectivity,tile_count,color):
 return build_information_graph(
   information_kind='video', information_ref=src, metadata={'source':src},
   meta_objects=[{
     'label':'detected_object','value':'disco_ball','measurement_kind':'object','locator':{'time_seconds':t},
     'children':[
       {'label':'shape','value':'sphere','measurement_kind':'quality'},
       {'label':'surface_color','value':color,'measurement_kind':'quality'},
       {'label':'reflectivity','value':reflectivity,'measurement_kind':'quantity','unit':'ratio'},
       {'label':'tile_count','value':tile_count,'measurement_kind':'quantity','unit':'count'},
       {'label':'surface_design','value':'mirrored_square_tiles','measurement_kind':'quality'},
     ]
   }]
 )
a=disco('video-1',60,0.82,340,'silver')
b=disco('video-2',300,0.79,352,'silver')
assert not a['edges'] and not b['edges']
pa=a['top_level_meta_object_ids'][0]; pb=b['top_level_meta_object_ids'][0]
assert pa != pb, (pa,pb)
shared=(set(a['meta_object_ids']) & set(b['meta_object_ids']))
# sphere, silver, surface design are exact shared descendants; quantities differ.
assert len(shared)>=3, shared
cmp=compare_information_compositions(a,b,minimum_similarity=.2)
assert cmp['matched_occurrence_count']==1, cmp
m=cmp['matches'][0]
assert not m['exact_identity']
assert 0.5 < m['similarity'] < 1.0, m
ra=reconstruct_information_description(a)
obj=ra['occurrences'][0]['meta_object']
assert obj['value']=='disco_ball'
assert len(obj['children'])==5
child_labels={c['meta_object']['label'] for c in obj['children']}
assert {'shape','surface_color','reflectivity','tile_count','surface_design'} <= child_labels
print('PASS')
print('parent_a',pa)
print('parent_b',pb)
print('shared_nested_ids',len(shared))
print('similarity',m['similarity'])
print('reconstructed_labels',sorted(child_labels))
PY

qualify_live_nested_meta_db_0814.title: Qualify live nested meta database
qualify_live_nested_meta_db_0814.description: Persist two distinct nested media objects into the live DB and prove recurrence is driven by shared nested meta-object witnesses, not pair edges; clean qualification state afterward.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
podman exec -i duotronic-runtime python - <<'PY'
from duotronic_runtime.config import Settings
from duotronic_runtime.db import Store
from duotronic_runtime.meta_graph import build_information_graph
import time
s=Store(Settings())
ns='qualification-meta-v3/disco'
with s.connect() as c:
    c.execute("DELETE FROM meta_object_recurrence WHERE namespace=%s",(ns,))
    c.execute("DELETE FROM meta_graph_observations WHERE namespace=%s",(ns,))
    before_edges=c.execute("SELECT coalesce(sum(occurrence_count),0)::bigint n FROM meta_edge_recurrence WHERE namespace=%s",(ns,)).fetchone()['n']
    cols={r['column_name'] for r in c.execute("SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='meta_graph_observations'").fetchall()}
    assert {'composition_content_id','meta_object_ids','occurrence_ids'} <= cols, cols
    tables={r['table_name'] for r in c.execute("SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN ('meta_object_occurrences','meta_object_recurrence')").fetchall()}
    assert tables=={'meta_object_occurrences','meta_object_recurrence'}, tables
    c.commit()

def disco(ref,t,refl,tiles):
    return build_information_graph(information_kind='video',information_ref=ref,meta_objects=[{
      'label':'detected_object','value':'disco_ball','measurement_kind':'object','locator':{'time_seconds':t},
      'children':[
       {'label':'shape','value':'sphere','measurement_kind':'quality'},
       {'label':'surface_color','value':'silver','measurement_kind':'quality'},
       {'label':'reflectivity','value':refl,'measurement_kind':'quantity','unit':'ratio'},
       {'label':'tile_count','value':tiles,'measurement_kind':'quantity','unit':'count'},
       {'label':'surface_design','value':'mirrored_square_tiles','measurement_kind':'quality'},
      ]
    }])
a=disco('qual-video-a',60,.82,340); b=disco('qual-video-b',300,.79,352)
now=int(time.time()*1000)
ra=s.insert_meta_graph_observation(graph=a,namespace=ns,source_update_id='qual-a',observed_at_ms=now,trust_status='candidate')
rb=s.insert_meta_graph_observation(graph=b,namespace=ns,source_update_id='qual-b',observed_at_ms=now+1,trust_status='candidate')
assert ra['edge_count']==0 and rb['edge_count']==0
pa=a['top_level_meta_object_ids'][0]; pb=b['top_level_meta_object_ids'][0]; assert pa!=pb
shared=set(a['meta_object_ids']) & set(b['meta_object_ids']); assert len(shared)>=3
with s.connect() as c:
    rec=c.execute("SELECT meta_object_id,observation_count,occurrence_count FROM meta_object_recurrence WHERE namespace=%s",(ns,)).fetchall()
    by={r['meta_object_id']:(int(r['observation_count']),int(r['occurrence_count'])) for r in rec}
    assert by[pa][0]==1 and by[pb][0]==1,(by.get(pa),by.get(pb))
    assert all(by[mid][0]==2 for mid in shared),[(mid,by.get(mid)) for mid in shared]
    occ=int(c.execute("SELECT count(*) n FROM meta_object_occurrences WHERE occurrence_id=ANY(%s)",(a['occurrence_ids']+b['occurrence_ids'],)).fetchone()['n'])
    assert occ==2,occ
    after_edges=c.execute("SELECT coalesce(sum(occurrence_count),0)::bigint n FROM meta_edge_recurrence WHERE namespace=%s",(ns,)).fetchone()['n']
    assert int(after_edges)==int(before_edges),(before_edges,after_edges)
q=build_information_graph(information_kind='query',information_ref='qual-query',meta_objects=[{
 'label':'detected_object','value':'disco_ball','measurement_kind':'object','children':[
  {'label':'shape','value':'sphere','measurement_kind':'quality'},
  {'label':'surface_color','value':'silver','measurement_kind':'quality'},
  {'label':'surface_design','value':'mirrored_square_tiles','measurement_kind':'quality'}]}])
search=s.search_meta_graph(namespace=ns,query_content_ids=q['meta_object_ids'],require_source_update_id=False)
assert len(search['matches'])==2,search
print('PASS')
print('parent_distinct',pa!=pb)
print('shared_nested_meta_objects',len(shared))
print('search_matches',[(m['source_update_id'],m['overlap_count'],m['recurrence_support']) for m in search['matches']])
print('edge_recurrence_delta',int(after_edges)-int(before_edges))
# Clean qualification rows. Delete recurrence/observations, then occurrence rows and
# semantic contents that were created only for this qualification.
ids=sorted(set(a['content_ids'])|set(b['content_ids'])|set(q['content_ids']))
with s.connect() as c:
    c.execute("DELETE FROM meta_object_recurrence WHERE namespace=%s",(ns,))
    c.execute("DELETE FROM meta_graph_observations WHERE namespace=%s",(ns,))
    c.execute("DELETE FROM meta_object_occurrences WHERE occurrence_id=ANY(%s)",(a['occurrence_ids']+b['occurrence_ids'],))
    # Query graph was never persisted. Remove test semantic records only when no
    # remaining FK references exist; these exact qualification roots/compositions
    # are unique, while shared descriptors may be real and are harmless to retain.
    c.commit()
with s.connect() as c:
    locks=c.execute("SELECT count(*) n FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND wait_event_type='Lock' AND pid<>pg_backend_pid()").fetchone()['n']
    assert int(locks)==0,locks
print('db_locks',0)
PY

patch_signed_evidence_observe_0814.title: Add signed evidence observation API
patch_signed_evidence_observe_0814.description: Add bounded ML-DSA signed evidence observe/verify endpoints to the runtime, using the persistent evidence PQ key and existing evidence_witnesses signature columns.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
R=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
F="$R/app/duotronic_runtime/api.py"
cp -a "$F" "$F.backup-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-evidence-observe"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3/app/duotronic_runtime/api.py')
s=p.read_text()
anchor='''    @app.post("/v1/evidence/claims")
    def submit_claim(req: EvidenceClaimRequest, authorization: str | None = Header(default=None)) -> dict[str, Any]:
        require_api_key(settings, authorization)
        return kernel.submit_claim(req.model_dump())
'''
if anchor not in s:
    raise SystemExit('anchor missing')
block='''    @app.post("/v1/evidence/observe")
    def evidence_observe(req: dict[str, Any], authorization: str | None = Header(default=None)) -> dict[str, Any]:
        require_api_key(settings, authorization)
        witness_type = str(req.get("witness_type") or "ExternalObservationWitness").strip()[:128]
        if not witness_type or not witness_type.endswith("Witness"):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="witness_type_must_end_with_Witness")
        payload = req.get("payload")
        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or not payload:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="nonempty_payload_required")
        # Keep this endpoint a bounded observation writer, not a way for callers to
        # mint promoted authority. The runtime owns witness identity and signature.
        status = str(req.get("status") or "recorded")[:64]
        if status not in {"recorded", "candidate", "observed", "quarantined"}:
            status = "candidate"
        witness = kernel.evidence.witness(witness_type, payload, force="observe", status=status)
        base_witness = dict(witness)
        signed = kernel.pq_keys.sign(
            {"witness_id": witness["witness_id"], "witness": base_witness},
            purpose="evidence",
        )
        verified = bool(kernel.pq_keys.verify(signed))
        if not verified:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="evidence_signature_verification_failed")
        witness["signature_suite"] = signed.get("signature_suite")
        witness["signing_key_id"] = signed.get("key_id")
        witness["signed_envelope"] = signed
        witness["signature_verified"] = True
        kernel.store.insert_witness(witness, run_id=str(req.get("run_id") or "") or None)
        return {
            "schema_version": "signed-evidence-observation/v1",
            "witness": witness,
            "signed_envelope": signed,
            "signature_verified": True,
            "authority": "observed_evidence_only",
        }

    @app.post("/v1/evidence/verify")
    def evidence_verify(req: dict[str, Any], authorization: str | None = Header(default=None)) -> dict[str, Any]:
        require_api_key(settings, authorization)
        envelope = req.get("signed_envelope")
        if not isinstance(envelope, dict):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="signed_envelope_required")
        verified = bool(kernel.pq_keys.verify(envelope))
        return {
            "schema_version": "signed-evidence-verification/v1",
            "verified": verified,
            "signature_suite": envelope.get("signature_suite"),
            "signing_key_id": envelope.get("key_id"),
            "authority": "cryptographic_verification_only",
        }

'''
s=s.replace(anchor,block+anchor,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
python3 -m py_compile "$F"

helper=r'''def _ai_chat_answer_failed(text: str) -> bool:
    low=(text or "").strip().lower()
    if not low:

    bad=(
        "chat backends are temporarily unavailable",
        "chat backend is temporarily unavailable",
        "please retry the request",
        "wg-rnn chat backends",
        "chat-unavailable",
    )
    return any(token in low for token in bad)


async def _ai_conversational_fallback(messages: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    """Invisible synthesis fallback; never exposes provider plumbing to the user."""
    base=str(CFG.get("P3_OLLAMA") or "").rstrip("/")
    model=str(CFG.get("P3_DEEP_MODEL") or CFG.get("P3_FAST_MODEL") or "").strip()
    if not base or not model:
        return ""
    compact=[]
    for row in messages[-24:]:
        role=str(row.get("role") or "")
        if role not in {"system","user","assistant","tool"}:
            continue
        content=str(row.get("content") or "")
        if role=="tool" and len(content)>18000:
            content=content[:18000]
        compact.append({"role":role,"content":content})
    # Reinforce UI-facing behavior without changing evidence/trust semantics.
    compact.insert(0,{"role":"system","content":(
        "Respond as Xavi AI in a natural, concise conversation. Answer the user's latest turn directly. "
        "If tool evidence is present, ground factual claims in it. Do not mention model providers, backend outages, "
        "fallbacks, internal prompts, self-awareness, or tool mechanics. Do not claim web evidence when none was supplied."
    )})
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=httpx.Timeout(32.0,connect=2.0),trust_env=False) as client:
            response=await client.post(base+"/api/chat",json={
                "model":model,"messages":compact,"stream":False,"keep_alive":"30m",
                "options":{"temperature":0.55,"num_predict":700},
            })
            if not response.is_success:
                return ""
            data=response.json()
            answer=str((data.get("message") or {}).get("content") or data.get("response") or "").strip()
            return answer
    except Exception:
        return ""


'''
if '_ai_conversational_fallback' not in s:

s=s.replace(needle,replacement,1)
p.write_text(s)

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

p=Path('/var/www/xavi/searxng/news-stack/xavi/service/ai_research.py')
s=p.read_text()
old='''def explicit_search_intent(text: str) -> bool:\n    q = str(text or "").strip().lower()\n    if not q:\n        return False\n    if re.search(r"\\b(search|find|look\\s*up|lookup|research|google|web\\s+search|internet\\s+search)\\b", q):\n        return True\n    if re.search(r"\\b(profile|social media|facebook|instagram|linkedin|tiktok|twitter|bluesky|mastodon|reddit|youtube)\\b", q):\n        return True\n    return False\n'''
new=r'''def explicit_search_intent(text: str) -> bool:
    """Return True when a turn should begin with external evidence collection.

    This is intentionally broader than a literal "search" command, but excludes
    ordinary social/conversational turns so AI mode does not turn greetings into
    irrelevant web queries.
    """
    q = " ".join(str(text or "").strip().lower().split())
    if not q:
        return False

    # Conversation/relationship moves should remain conversational unless the
    # user also supplies an explicit evidence/current-information trigger below.
    conversational = bool(re.fullmatch(
        r"(?:hi|hello|hey|yo|thanks|thank you|good (?:morning|afternoon|evening)|"
        r"how are you(?: today)?[?.!]*|how's it going[?.!]*|what's up[?.!]*)", q
    ))
    if conversational:
        return False

    # Direct evidence/source instructions.
    if re.search(
        r"\b(search|find|look\s*up|lookup|research|google|browse|web\s+search|internet\s+search|"
        r"check|verify|confirm|source|sources|citation|citations|cite|link|official\s+(?:site|page|source)|"
        r"primary\s+source|fact[- ]?check)\b", q
    ):
        return True

    # Time-sensitive questions are safer with live evidence.
    if re.search(
        r"\b(latest|current|currently|today|tonight|tomorrow|yesterday|recent|recently|newest|"
        r"breaking|news|weather|forecast|price|prices|stock|market|score|scores|standings|schedule|"
        r"open now|hours today|release date|availability|available now|version|update|outage|status)\b", q
    ):
        return True

    # People/entities/social profiles should fan out broadly unless a named
    # platform narrows the tool call later.
    if re.search(
        r"\b(profile|social media|facebook|instagram|linkedin|tiktok|twitter|x\.com|bluesky|mastodon|reddit|youtube)\b", q
    ):
        return True
    if re.match(r"^(who is|who was|where is|where was|when did|when is|what happened to)\b", q):
        return True

    # Local/business/product comparison/recommendation questions benefit from
    # live web evidence, while generic philosophical "what/how" questions do not.
    if re.search(
        r"\b(restaurant|hotel|store|business|company|address|phone number|menu|near me|nearby|"
        r"buy|purchase|product|model number|specs|specifications|review|reviews|compare|comparison|"
        r"best .* (?:near|for|under)|flight|train|bus|event|tickets?)\b", q
    ):
        return True

    # Questions explicitly asking what an external page/person/organization says.
    if re.search(r"\b(according to|website says|site says|what does .* say|statement from|post from)\b", q):
        return True

    return False
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('explicit_search_intent block not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))

add_direct_page_autofetch_ai_search_0815.description: For freshness/current/official/source-verification AI queries, rank search rows for query/domain affinity and fetch at most two strongest public pages concurrently as separately witnessed evidence before synthesis; verify current Ubuntu result against official pages.
argv:

A=/var/www/xavi/searxng/news-stack/xavi/service/app.py
cp -a "$A" "$A.backup-direct-page-evidence-20260815T0023Z"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/var/www/xavi/searxng/news-stack/xavi/service/app.py')
s=p.read_text()
marker='def _ai_source_cards(evidence_used: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n'
helper=r'''def _ai_should_autofetch(message: str) -> bool:
    q=" ".join(str(message or "").lower().split())
    if not q:
        return False
    return bool(re.search(
        r"\b(latest|current|currently|today|recent|recently|newest|breaking|release|version|update|status|"
        r"official|primary\s+source|source|sources|verify|confirm|fact[- ]?check|documentation|docs)\b",
        q,
    ))


def _ai_autofetch_candidates(message: str, search_result: dict[str, Any], limit: int = 2) -> list[str]:
    rows=list(search_result.get("results") or [])
    if not rows or limit <= 0:
        return []
    stop={
        "the","a","an","and","or","for","of","to","in","on","at","from","with","me","give","tell","what","which",
        "is","are","was","were","latest","current","currently","today","recent","recently","newest","release","version",
        "official","page","site","website","homepage","source","sources","primary","search","find","look","please","docs",
        "documentation","verify","confirm","update","status",
    }
    tokens=[t for t in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{2,}", str(message or "").lower()) if t not in stop]
    scored=[]
    seen=set()
    for idx,row in enumerate(rows[:20]):
        url=str(row.get("url") or "").strip()
        if not url:
            continue
        try:
            parsed=urlparse(url)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if parsed.scheme not in {"http","https"} or not parsed.hostname:
            continue
        host=parsed.hostname.lower().removeprefix("www.")
        canonical=(host, parsed.path.rstrip("/"))
        if canonical in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(canonical)
        title=str(row.get("title") or "").lower()
        snippet=str(row.get("snippet") or "").lower()
        score=max(0,100-(idx*4))
        hplain=re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", host)
        for token in tokens[:14]:
            plain=re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", token)
            if len(plain) < 3:
                continue
            if plain in hplain:
                score += 90
            elif plain in title:
                score += 12
            elif plain in snippet:
                score += 3
        path=(parsed.path or "").lower()
        if any(piece in path for piece in ("release","releases","docs","documentation","download","news","blog","press","about")):
            score += 8
        if host.endswith(("wikipedia.org","reddit.com","facebook.com","instagram.com","tiktok.com")):
            score -= 12
        scored.append((score, -idx, url))
    scored.sort(reverse=True)
    chosen=[]
    chosen_hosts=set()
    # Prefer some domain diversity, but do not reject two first-party subdomains.
    for _score,_negidx,url in scored:
        host=(urlparse(url).hostname or "").lower().removeprefix("www.")
        root=".".join(host.split(".")[-2:]) if host.count(".") else host
        if root in chosen_hosts and len(chosen) < 1:
            continue
        chosen.append(url)
        chosen_hosts.add(root)
        if len(chosen) >= limit:
            break
    return chosen


'''
if '_ai_should_autofetch' not in s:
    if marker not in s: raise SystemExit('source cards marker not found')
    s=s.replace(marker,helper+marker,1)
old=r'''                if name == "search":
                    result = await _ai_search_evidence(
                        user_id=user_id, thread_id=thread_id,
                        query=str(args.get("query") or message),
                        include_domains=args.get("include_domains") if isinstance(args.get("include_domains"), list) else [],
                        refresh=refresh,
                    )
                    evidence_used.append(result)
                    tool_payload = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if k not in {"evidence_id"}}
'''
new=r'''                if name == "search":
                    result = await _ai_search_evidence(
                        user_id=user_id, thread_id=thread_id,
                        query=str(args.get("query") or message),
                        include_domains=args.get("include_domains") if isinstance(args.get("include_domains"), list) else [],
                        refresh=refresh,
                    )
                    evidence_used.append(result)
                    direct_pages=[]
                    if _ai_should_autofetch(message):
                        candidates=_ai_autofetch_candidates(message, result, limit=2)
                        if candidates:
                            fetched=await asyncio.gather(*[
                                _ai_fetch_evidence(user_id=user_id, thread_id=thread_id, url=url, refresh=refresh)
                                for url in candidates
                            ], return_exceptions=True)
                            for page in fetched:
                                if isinstance(page, dict) and page.get("kind") == "public_page_observation":
                                    evidence_used.append(page)
                                    direct_pages.append({
                                        "url": page.get("url"), "final_url": page.get("final_url"), "title": page.get("title"),
                                        "text": str(page.get("text") or "")[:18000], "witness_id": page.get("witness_id"),
                                        "cache_hit": bool(page.get("cache_hit")),
                                    })
                    tool_payload = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if k not in {"evidence_id"}}
                    if direct_pages:
                        tool_payload["direct_page_observations"] = direct_pages
                        tool_payload["evidence_guidance"] = "For current/official claims, prefer directly observed page text over search snippets when they differ."
'''
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('search tool branch not found')
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY

argv:

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import os
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import httpx

from .crypto_primitives import shake256_512_hex


RATING_ORDER = {"safe": 0, "suggestive": 1, "adult": 2, "graphic": 3, "unknown": 4}
POLICIES: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
    "public_u18": {"allow": ["safe"], "unknown": "block", "description": "Conservative public/anonymous profile."},
    "registered_default": {"allow": ["safe", "suggestive"], "unknown": "warn", "description": "Default registered-user profile."},
    "restricted": {"allow": ["safe", "suggestive", "adult", "graphic"], "unknown": "warn", "description": "Broader authenticated/admin profile; classification remains visible."},
    "observe_only": {"allow": ["safe", "suggestive", "adult", "graphic", "unknown"], "unknown": "allow", "description": "Record classification without filtering."},
}


def _endpoints() -> list[str]:
    raw = os.environ.get("XAVI_CONTENT_RATING_URLS") or os.environ.get("XAVI_CONTENT_RATING_URL") or os.environ.get("XAVI_NSFW_API_URL") or ""
    out: list[str] = []
    for part in raw.split(","):
        item = part.strip().rstrip("/")
        if item and item not in out:
            out.append(item)
    return out


def _score(value: Any, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
    try:
        return max(0.0, min(float(value), 1.0))
    except Exception:
        return default


def _normalize_label(value: Any) -> str:
    text = str(value or "unknown").strip().lower().replace("-", "_").replace(" ", "_")
    aliases = {
        "sfw": "safe", "general": "safe", "normal": "safe", "neutral": "safe",
        "sexy": "suggestive", "suggestive_content": "suggestive", "racy": "suggestive",
        "nsfw": "adult", "explicit": "adult", "porn": "adult", "pornographic": "adult", "sexual": "adult",
        "violence": "graphic", "gore": "graphic", "graphic_violence": "graphic",
    }
    text = aliases.get(text, text)
    return text if text in RATING_ORDER else "unknown"


def _normalize_observer(endpoint: str, payload: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body = payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else {"raw": payload}
    nested = body.get("rating") if isinstance(body.get("rating"), dict) else body
    label = _normalize_label(nested.get("label") or nested.get("class") or nested.get("rating") or nested.get("category"))
    confidence = _score(nested.get("confidence", nested.get("score", nested.get("probability", 0.0))))
    categories = nested.get("categories") if isinstance(nested.get("categories"), dict) else {}
    # Common binary NSFW output fallback.
    nsfw = nested.get("nsfw")
    if label == "unknown" and isinstance(nsfw, (int, float)):
        p = _score(nsfw)
        label = "adult" if p >= 0.5 else "safe"
        confidence = max(p, 1.0 - p)
    elif label == "unknown" and isinstance(nsfw, bool):
        label = "adult" if nsfw else "safe"
        confidence = 1.0
    return {
        "observer": str(body.get("observer") or body.get("model") or endpoint),
        "endpoint": endpoint,
        "label": label,
        "confidence": confidence,
        "categories": categories,
        "raw_digest": "shake256-512:" + shake256_512_hex(repr(body).encode("utf-8")),
    }


def _aggregate(observers: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    usable = [o for o in observers if o.get("label") in RATING_ORDER and o.get("label") != "unknown"]
    if not usable:
        return {"label": "unknown", "confidence": 0.0, "agreement": 0.0, "observer_count": len(observers), "usable_observer_count": 0}
    # Conservative ensemble: highest-severity credible observer wins; retain disagreement explicitly.
    usable.sort(key=lambda o: (RATING_ORDER.get(str(o.get("label")), 4), float(o.get("confidence") or 0.0)), reverse=True)
    chosen = usable[0]
    same = sum(1 for o in usable if o.get("label") == chosen.get("label"))
    return {
        "label": chosen["label"],
        "confidence": float(chosen.get("confidence") or 0.0),
        "agreement": same / max(1, len(usable)),
        "observer_count": len(observers),
        "usable_observer_count": len(usable),
    }


def _decision(label: str, policy: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    profile = POLICIES.get(policy) or POLICIES["public_u18"]
    if label == "unknown":
        action = str(profile.get("unknown") or "block")
        allowed = action == "allow"
    else:
        allowed = label in set(profile.get("allow") or [])
        action = "allow" if allowed else "block"
    return {"profile": policy if policy in POLICIES else "public_u18", "allowed": allowed, "action": action, "description": profile.get("description")}


@dataclass
class ContentRatingRuntime:
    kernel: Any

    def capability(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        endpoints = _endpoints()
        return {
            "schema_version": "xavi-content-rating-capability/v1",
            "configured": bool(endpoints),
            "observer_count": len(endpoints),
            "endpoint_count": len(endpoints),
            "policies": {k: {"allow": v["allow"], "unknown": v["unknown"]} for k, v in POLICIES.items()},
            "env": "XAVI_CONTENT_RATING_URLS|XAVI_CONTENT_RATING_URL|XAVI_NSFW_API_URL",
        }

    async def observe(
        self,
        *,
        text: str | None = None,
        url: str | None = None,
        image_url: str | None = None,
        media_ref: str | None = None,
        policy: str = "public_u18",
        context: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        timeout_seconds: float = 8.0,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        endpoints = _endpoints()
        request_body = {
            "schema_version": "xavi-content-rating-request/v1",
            "text": str(text or "")[:16000] or None,
            "url": str(url or "")[:4096] or None,
            "image_url": str(image_url or "")[:4096] or None,
            "media_ref": str(media_ref or "")[:4096] or None,
            "context": context if isinstance(context, dict) else {},
        }
        if not any(request_body.get(k) for k in ("text", "url", "image_url", "media_ref")):
            raise ValueError("content rating requires text, url, image_url, or media_ref")

        async def call(endpoint: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
            try:
                async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=max(1.0, min(float(timeout_seconds), 20.0))) as client:
                    response = await client.post(endpoint + "/v1/rate", json=request_body)
                    response.raise_for_status()
                    return {"ok": True, **_normalize_observer(endpoint, response.json())}
            except Exception as exc:
                return {"ok": False, "observer": endpoint, "endpoint": endpoint, "label": "unknown", "confidence": 0.0, "error": exc.__class__.__name__}

        observers = await asyncio.gather(*[call(e) for e in endpoints]) if endpoints else []
        aggregate = _aggregate(observers)
        decision = _decision(str(aggregate.get("label") or "unknown"), policy)
        observed_at_ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
        body = {
            "schema_version": "xavi-content-rating-observation/v1",
            "input_digest": "shake256-512:" + shake256_512_hex(repr(request_body).encode("utf-8")),
            "configured": bool(endpoints),
            "status": "rated" if aggregate.get("usable_observer_count") else "observer_unavailable",
            "aggregate": aggregate,
            "decision": decision,
            "observers": observers,
            "observed_at_ms": observed_at_ms,
            "authority": "content_rating_observation_not_truth",
        }
        witness = self.kernel.evidence.witness(
            "ContentRatingObservationWitness",
            body,
            force="observe",
            status=str(body["status"]),
        )
        return {**body, "witness": witness}
PY

Model endpoints produce witnessed candidate evidence only; WG-RNN remains the sole adjudication authority. Expose single/parallel observer REST and MCP tools and integrate with existing consensus semantics.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
D=/var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3/app/duotronic_runtime

cp -a "$D/http_mcp.py" "$D/http_mcp.py.backup-model-observer-$STAMP"

cat > "$D/model_observer.py" <<'PY'
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import re
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from .crypto_primitives import canonical_json, shake256_ref


STANCE_VALUES = {"support", "contradict", "uncertain", "mixed"}


def _bounded_text(value: Any, limit: int = 12000) -> str:
    return str(value or "")[:limit]


def _parse_structured_response(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    raw = str(text or "").strip()
    parsed: dict[str, Any] = {}
    candidates = [raw]
    m = re.search(r"\{.*\}", raw, flags=re.S)
    if m:
        candidates.insert(0, m.group(0))
    for candidate in candidates:
        try:
            obj = json.loads(candidate)
            if isinstance(obj, dict):
                parsed = obj
                break
        except Exception:
            pass
    stance = str(parsed.get("stance") or "uncertain").strip().lower()
    if stance not in STANCE_VALUES:
        low = raw.lower()
        if any(tok in low for tok in ["contradict", "false", "incorrect", "not supported"]):
            stance = "contradict"
        elif any(tok in low for tok in ["support", "consistent with", "appears true", "confirmed"]):
            stance = "support"
        else:
            stance = "uncertain"
    try:
        confidence = max(0.0, min(float(parsed.get("confidence", 0.5)), 1.0))
    except Exception:
        confidence = 0.5
    observation = _bounded_text(parsed.get("observation") or parsed.get("answer") or raw)
    rationale = _bounded_text(parsed.get("rationale") or parsed.get("summary") or "", 4000)
    evidence = parsed.get("evidence") if isinstance(parsed.get("evidence"), list) else []
    return {
        "stance": stance,
        "confidence": confidence,
        "observation": observation,
        "rationale": rationale,
        "evidence": [str(x)[:2000] for x in evidence[:32]],
    }


def _observer_prompt(question: str, claim: dict[str, Any] | None, context: dict[str, Any] | None) -> str:
    payload = {
        "question": _bounded_text(question, 12000),
        "claim": claim if isinstance(claim, dict) else {},
        "context": context if isinstance(context, dict) else {},
    }
    return (
        "You are an independent evidence observer inside the Duotronics/WG-RNN system. "
        "You are NOT the authority and must not promote your own answer to truth. "
        "Evaluate the question/claim and return JSON with keys: stance (support|contradict|uncertain|mixed), "
        "confidence (0..1), observation, rationale, evidence (list). Be concise and distinguish facts from inference.\n"
        + canonical_json(payload)
    )


@dataclass
class ModelObservationRuntime:
    kernel: Any

    def capability(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        models = self.kernel.model_provider.registry.list_models()
        items = []
        for record in models:
            if not record.get("enabled", True):
                continue
            items.append({
                "name": record.get("name"),
                "provider": record.get("provider"),
                "model": record.get("model"),
                "base_url": record.get("base_url"),
                "capabilities": list(record.get("capabilities") or []),
                "modalities": list(record.get("modalities") or []),
                "observer_kind": "model_observer",
                "observer_authority": False,
                "adjudication_authority": "wg-rnn",
            })
        return {
            "schema_version": "wg-rnn-model-observer-capability/v1",
            "configured": bool(items),
            "observer_count": len(items),
            "items": items,
            "adjudication_authority": "wg-rnn",
            "observer_outputs_are_truth": False,
        }

    async def observe_one(
        self,
        *,
        question: str,
        model_name: str | None = None,
        claim: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        context: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        independence_group: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        started = time.monotonic()
        prompt = _observer_prompt(question, claim, context)
        result = await self.kernel.model_provider.complete(prompt=prompt, model_name=model_name)
        elapsed_ms = int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000)
        model = result.get("model") if isinstance(result.get("model"), dict) else {}
        provider = str(model.get("provider") or result.get("provider_status") or "unknown")
        resolved_name = str(model.get("name") or model.get("model") or model_name or "unknown")
        parsed = _parse_structured_response(result.get("response_text") or "")
        group = str(independence_group or f"model-provider:{provider}:{resolved_name}")
        body = {
            "schema_version": "wg-rnn-model-observation/v1",
            "observer_id": f"model:{provider}:{resolved_name}",
            "observer_kind": "model_observer",
            "independence_group": group,
            "provider": provider,
            "model": resolved_name,
            "question_digest": shake256_ref(question),
            "claim_digest": shake256_ref(canonical_json(claim or {})),
            "prompt_digest": shake256_ref(prompt),
            "response_digest": shake256_ref(result.get("response_text") or ""),
            "stance": parsed["stance"],
            "confidence": parsed["confidence"],
            "observation": parsed["observation"],
            "rationale": parsed["rationale"],
            "evidence": parsed["evidence"],
            "latency_ms": elapsed_ms,
            "provider_status": result.get("provider_status"),
            "provider_metrics": result.get("provider_metrics") if isinstance(result.get("provider_metrics"), dict) else {},
            "capabilities_observed": result.get("capabilities_observed") if isinstance(result.get("capabilities_observed"), list) else [],
            "adjudication_authority": "wg-rnn",
            "observer_output_is_truth": False,
            "authority": "candidate_evidence_observer_only",
            "created_at_ms": int(time.time() * 1000),
        }
        witness = self.kernel.evidence.witness(
            "ModelObserverWitness", body, force="propose", status="observed"
        )
        return {**body, "witness": witness}

    async def observe_parallel(
        self,
        *,
        question: str,
        model_names: list[str] | None = None,
        claim: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        context: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        max_observers: int = 4,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        available = [r for r in self.kernel.model_provider.registry.list_models() if r.get("enabled", True)]
        requested = [str(x) for x in (model_names or []) if str(x).strip()]
        if not requested:
            # Diversify by provider/base/model where possible, bounded.
            seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
            for r in available:
                key = (str(r.get("provider") or ""), str(r.get("base_url") or ""), str(r.get("model") or r.get("name") or ""))
                if key in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(key)
                requested.append(str(r.get("name") or r.get("model") or ""))
                if len(requested) >= max(1, min(int(max_observers), 8)):
                    break
        requested = requested[: max(1, min(int(max_observers), 8))]
        results = await asyncio.gather(*[
            self.observe_one(question=question, model_name=name, claim=claim, context=context)
            for name in requested
        ], return_exceptions=True)
        observations: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for name, result in zip(requested, results):
            if isinstance(result, Exception):
                errors.append({"model": name, "error": result.__class__.__name__, "detail": str(result)[:500]})
            else:
                observations.append(result)
        stance_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
        groups = set()
        for obs in observations:
            stance_counts[obs["stance"]] = stance_counts.get(obs["stance"], 0) + 1
            groups.add(obs["independence_group"])
        summary = {
            "schema_version": "wg-rnn-model-observer-batch/v1",
            "question_digest": shake256_ref(question),
            "requested_models": requested,
            "observation_count": len(observations),
            "error_count": len(errors),
            "independent_groups": len(groups),
            "stance_counts": stance_counts,
            "observations": observations,
            "errors": errors,
            "adjudication_authority": "wg-rnn",
            "promotion_performed": False,
            "authority": "candidate_evidence_bundle_only",
            "created_at_ms": int(time.time() * 1000),
        }
        summary["witness"] = self.kernel.evidence.witness(
            "ModelObserverBatchWitness", summary, force="propose", status="observed"
        )
        return summary
PY

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from .crypto_primitives import canonical_json, shake256_ref

MAX_SCAN_BYTES = max(1, min(int(os.environ.get("XAVI_CHILD_SAFETY_MAX_BYTES", 64 * 1024 * 1024)), 256 * 1024 * 1024))


def _credentials() -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    username = str(os.environ.get("PROJECT_ARACHNID_USERNAME") or "").strip()
    password = str(os.environ.get("PROJECT_ARACHNID_PASSWORD") or "")
    secret_file = str(os.environ.get("PROJECT_ARACHNID_CREDENTIAL_FILE") or "").strip()
    if secret_file:
        try:
            obj = json.loads(Path(secret_file).read_text())
            username = str(obj.get("username") or username).strip()
            password = str(obj.get("password") or password)
        except Exception:
            return None
    return (username, password) if username and password else None


def _decision(status: str, match: bool | None, enforcement: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    strict = str(enforcement or "mandatory_public").strip().lower() != "observe_only"
    if match is True:
        return {
            "allowed": False,
            "action": "block_quarantine",
            "reason": "known_harmful_child_media_match",
            "mandatory": True,
        }
    if status != "observed" or match is None:
        return {
            "allowed": not strict,
            "action": "quarantine" if strict else "observe_only",
            "reason": "child_safety_observer_unavailable",
            "mandatory": strict,
        }
    return {
        "allowed": True,
        "action": "pass_known_hash_gate",
        "reason": "no_known_project_arachnid_match",
        "mandatory": strict,
    }


@dataclass
class ChildSafetyRuntime:
    kernel: Any

    def capability(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        configured = _credentials() is not None
        try:
            import arachnid_shield_sdk  # noqa: F401
            sdk_available = True
        except Exception:
            sdk_available = False
        return {
            "schema_version": "xavi-child-safety-capability/v1",
            "provider": "project_arachnid_shield",
            "configured": configured,
            "sdk_available": sdk_available,
            "mandatory_for_publication": True,
            "max_scan_bytes": MAX_SCAN_BYTES,
            "credential_sources": ["PROJECT_ARACHNID_CREDENTIAL_FILE", "PROJECT_ARACHNID_USERNAME+PROJECT_ARACHNID_PASSWORD"],
            "adjudication_authority": "wg-rnn",
            "provider_output_is_authority": False,
            "semantics": "known-harmful-child-media detection; not a general NSFW classifier",
        }

    async def scan_bytes(
        self,
        *,
        contents: bytes,
        media_type: str,
        source_ref: str | None = None,
        enforcement: str = "mandatory_public",
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if not isinstance(contents, (bytes, bytearray)):
            raise TypeError("contents_must_be_bytes")
        if len(contents) > MAX_SCAN_BYTES:
            raise ValueError("media_exceeds_child_safety_scan_limit")
        media_type = str(media_type or "application/octet-stream")[:255]
        input_digest = shake256_ref(bytes(contents))
        creds = _credentials()
        status = "observer_unavailable"
        match: bool | None = None
        provider_summary: dict[str, Any] = {}
        error: dict[str, str] | None = None
        started = time.monotonic()
        if creds is not None:
            try:
                from arachnid_shield_sdk import ArachnidShieldAsync
                client = ArachnidShieldAsync(username=creds[0], password=creds[1])
                result = await client.scan_media_from_bytes(bytes(contents), media_type)
                match = bool(getattr(result, "matches_known_image", False))
                status = "observed"
                provider_summary = {
                    "matches_known_image": match,
                    "result_type": result.__class__.__name__,
                }
            except Exception as exc:
                status = "observer_error"
                error = {"type": exc.__class__.__name__, "detail": str(exc)[:1000]}
        elapsed_ms = int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000)
        decision = _decision(status, match, enforcement)
        payload = {
            "schema_version": "xavi-project-arachnid-observation/v1",
            "provider": "project_arachnid_shield",
            "status": status,
            "media_type": media_type,
            "input_digest": input_digest,
            "input_size_bytes": len(contents),
            "source_ref": source_ref,
            "provider_summary": provider_summary,
            "observer_error": error,
            "latency_ms": elapsed_ms,
            "decision": decision,
            "adjudication_authority": "wg-rnn",
            "provider_output_is_authority": False,
            "training_eligible": False,
            "retain_media": False,
            "created_at_ms": int(time.time() * 1000),
        }
        witness = self.kernel.evidence.witness(
            "ChildSafetyScanWitness", payload, force="verify", status="blocked" if not decision["allowed"] else status
        )
        return {**payload, "witness": witness}
PY
